searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/TrainFuelGuiController.client.luau Step 1: Write TrainFuelGuiController.client.luau  Smooth drain comes free from per-frame prediction; the displayed value uses frame-rate-independent exponential smoothing toward the predicted value so refuel jumps ease in (cleaner than driving a MotionMaster tween that the per-frame prediction would fight).  --!strict --!optimize 2 -- ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ -- │ TrainFuelGuiController │ -- │ Programmatic HUD fuel bar + status label. Predicts fuel locally each │ -- │ frame from the last TrainStateSync snapshot (rate + serverTime), so the │ -- │ drain glides with zero extra packets. Displayed value eases toward the │ -- │ prediction (exponential smoothing) so refuel jumps look smooth. │ -- └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ local Players = game:GetService("Players") local RunService = game:GetService("RunService") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local TrainConfig = require(Shared.Configs:WaitForChild("TrainConfig")) local Signals = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Signals")) local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") :: PlayerGui -- Latest authoritative snapshot. local snap = { fuel = TrainConfig.MAX_FUEL, rate = 0, isBraked = false, isStalled = false, serverTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), } local RUNNING_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120) local BRAKED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(230, 180, 70) local STALLED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60) local SMOOTH_K = 8 -- higher = snappier easing -- ── Build UI ── local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui") gui.Name = "TrainFuelGui" gui.ResetOnSpawn = false gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling gui.Parent = PlayerGui local container = Instance.new("Frame") container.Name = "FuelContainer" container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1) container.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.97) container.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 26) container.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25) container.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 container.BorderSizePixel = 0 container.Parent = gui local containerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") containerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) containerCorner.Parent = container local bar = Instance.new("Frame") bar.Name = "FuelBar" bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5) bar.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5) bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) bar.BackgroundColor3 = RUNNING_COLOR bar.BorderSizePixel = 0 bar.Parent = container local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") barCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) barCorner.Parent = bar local label = Instance.new("TextLabel") label.Name = "FuelLabel" label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) label.BackgroundTransparency = 1 label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold label.TextSize = 14 label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) label.Text = "FUEL 100%" label.ZIndex = 2 label.Parent = container -- ── Prediction + render ── local function predictedFuel(): number local elapsed = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - snap.serverTime return math.clamp(snap.fuel - snap.rate * elapsed, 0, TrainConfig.MAX_FUEL) end local displayedFuel = TrainConfig.MAX_FUEL Signals.OnTrainStateChanged:Connect(function(fuel, rate, isBraked, isStalled, serverTime) snap.fuel = fuel snap.rate = rate snap.isBraked = isBraked snap.isStalled = isStalled snap.serverTime = serverTime end) RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number) local target = predictedFuel() -- Frame-rate-independent exponential smoothing. local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-dt * SMOOTH_K) displayedFuel += (target - displayedFuel) * alpha local pct = displayedFuel / TrainConfig.MAX_FUEL bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(pct, 0, 1), 1) local roundedPct = math.floor(pct * 100 + 0.5) if snap.isStalled then bar.BackgroundColor3 = STALLED_COLOR label.Text = "OUT OF FUEL" elseif snap.isBraked then bar.BackgroundColor3 = BRAKED_COLOR label.Text = ("BRAKED %d%%"):format(roundedPct) else bar.BackgroundColor3 = RUNNING_COLOR label.Text = ("FUEL %d%%"):format(roundedPct) end end)    Step 2: Self-review  Confirm: prediction uses workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - snap.serverTime; displayed value eases via 1 - math.exp(-dt * k) (frame-rate independent); bar width clamped 0..1; status label reflects stalled/braked/running; no WaitForChild on a pre-built GUI instance (UI is built in code). searchDocs.title: Task 6: Documentation​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: Documentations/Project-Maintenance-Guide.md Step 1: Add three rows to the Networking Map table  After the BroadcastPlaceablePoof row (currently the last row, line ~76):  | TrainStateSync | S->All | RemoteEvent | Train fuel: broadcast fuel/rate/braked/stalled + serverTime on each event; also sent to a joining player. Clients predict the bar locally. | | ReqRefuelTrain | C->S (response) | RemoteFunction | Train fuel: feed Energy junk into the engine (smallest-first, up to cap); returns success, fuelAdded, reason code | | ReqToggleBrake | C->S (response) | RemoteFunction | Train fuel: toggle the brake lever (stop/resume); returns success, resulting isBraked, reason code |    Step 2: Add a row to the Signals Map table  After the OnPlaceableMoved row (line ~100):  | `OnTrainStateChanged` | TrainClient (on TrainStateSync) | TrainFuelGuiController | Fuel HUD update (fuel, rate, isBraked, isStalled, serverTime) | | `SetTrainState` | TrainFuelManager (on running-state flip) | JunkService | Slows junk spawn/speed when braked or stalled (reused by the fuel system) |    Step 3: Add a row to the Config Map table  After the ProximityPickupConfig row (line ~114):  | TrainConfig | Max fuel, running/stopped drain rates, game-over delay, proximity tolerance, engine/lever tags + prompt part names, brake action text, per-tier recharge values |    Step 4: Add a Train Fuel System section  Add a new ## Train Fuel System section near the other system sections (e.g. before ## Recommended Update Process):  ## Train Fuel System Global, server-wide fuel (0–100). Authoritative state lives in `ServerStorage/SharedModules/TrainFuelManager.luau` (loaded by `ServerScriptService/TrainFuelSystemLoader.server.luau`). Fuel is computed algebraically from the last event — there is no per-frame loop. Each event (refuel, brake toggle, stall, resume, init) snapshots fuel, switches the drain rate, broadcasts `TrainStateSync`, and reschedules the next transition via a nonce-guarded `task.delay`. - **Running** drains `RUNNING_DRAIN_PER_SEC` (full tank ≈ 10 min). **Braked** drains `STOPPED_DRAIN_PER_SEC` (5× slower). **Stalled** (fuel 0) drains nothing. - Braking and stalling fire the existing `Signals.SetTrainState(false)`, which `JunkService` consumes to slow the floating junk. Resuming/refueling fires `true`. - **Refuel:** players feed collected **Energy** Tools (Tier attribute 1–5) at the engine's `RefuelPromptPart` prompt. The server consumes them smallest-recharge-first and stops at the cap, preserving the player's stockpile. Values in `TrainConfig.TierRecharge`. - **Brake:** a separate `TrainBrakeLever`-tagged model's `BrakePromptPart` prompt toggles stop/resume. Locked out while stalled. - **Out of fuel:** at 0 the train stalls (junk slows like braked); after `GAME_OVER_DELAY` (180 s) without refuel, a placeholder `print` fires (real game-over is a TODO). Refueling above 0 cancels the countdown and resumes. - **HUD:** `TrainFuelGuiController` builds a bar in code and predicts fuel locally from the last snapshot's rate + serverTime. **Models (authored in Studio, tag-gated):** an engine `Model` tagged `TrainEngine` with a `PrimaryPart` and a child BasePart `RefuelPromptPart` holding a `ProximityPrompt`; a `Model` tagged `TrainBrakeLever` with a `PrimaryPart` and a child BasePart `BrakePromptPart` holding a `ProximityPrompt`. Prompt `MaxActivationDistance` and the refuel prompt's text are set in Studio; the script only sets the lever prompt's `ActionText`.    Step 5: Self-review  Confirm: table rows match each table's column count and format; the new section's facts match TrainConfig values (180 s, 5× slower, 1–5 tiers); model expectations match the tag/part names in TrainConfig.   Step 6: Commit  git add Documentations/Project-Maintenance-Guide.md git commit -m "docs: document train fuel system in maintenance guide"

searchDocs.title: Final verification (Studio, user-driven — optional)​
searchDocs.content: With live Rojo sync running and temporary tagged placeholder Models (a part with PrimaryPart, child RefuelPromptPart/BrakePromptPart + a ProximityPrompt, tagged TrainEngine/TrainBrakeLever):  Fuel bar starts at 100% and drains to ~90% over ~1 min running.Collect Energy junk via GrabHook, stand by the engine, trigger the refuel prompt: smallest-tier energy is consumed first, only up to the cap; toast shows Refueled +N; stockpile beyond the cap is preserved.Trigger the lever prompt: junk visibly slows, bar color turns amber, drain slows; ActionText flips Stop/Resume.Drain to 0 (or temporarily raise RUNNING_DRAIN_PER_SEC): bar turns red "OUT OF FUEL", junk slows, lever prompt is denied with a toast.Lower GAME_OVER_DELAY to ~10 s to confirm the placeholder [TrainFuel] GAME OVER prints once, and that refueling before it cancels the print.Join a second client: its HUD initializes to the current shared fuel level.

searchDocs.title: Task 4: [P2] Single source of truth for ghost-lock state​
searchDocs.content: Both BuildModeGuiController and PlacementClient track their own isGhostLocked, kept in sync only by a signal. Make PlacementClient authoritative and have the GUI render a broadcast lock state.  Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Signals/init.luau (add OnGhostLockChanged) Modify: src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/PlacementClient.client.luau Modify: src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/BuildModeGuiController.client.luau Step 1: Add the broadcast signal  In Signals/init.luau, in the Grid Placement System section:  	-- Fires (isLocked: boolean) when ghost-lock state changes. PlacementClient is the -- authority; BuildModeGuiController renders the icon from this. OnGhostLockChanged = Signal() :: Signal.Signal<boolean>,    Step 2: PlacementClient owns the state and broadcasts  Replace the RequestGhostLockToggle handler:  Signals.RequestGhostLockToggle:Connect(function() isGhostLocked = not isGhostLocked Signals.OnGhostLockChanged:Fire(isGhostLocked) end)   In both doCancel and unequipTool (the build-mode exit paths), reset the lock afterplacement:SetBuildMode(false):  	isGhostLocked = false Signals.OnGhostLockChanged:Fire(false)    Step 3: BuildModeGuiController renders, no local logic state  Remove the local isGhostLocked declaration and the two inline toggles. The lock button and the Lkey just request the toggle; the icon updates from the broadcast:  lockButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Signals.RequestGhostLockToggle:Fire() end)   	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.L then Signals.RequestGhostLockToggle:Fire() end   Add a consumer that drives the icon, and simplify the OnBuildModeChanged reset (the lock reset is now broadcast by PlacementClient, so the GUI just reacts):  Signals.OnGhostLockChanged:Connect(function(isLocked: boolean) lockButtonIcon.Image = if isLocked then Icons.GhostLocked else Icons.GhostUnlocked end)   In OnBuildModeChanged, drop the isGhostLocked = false line (state now lives in PlacementClient); keep the GUI-visibility logic. The icon will be set to unlocked by the OnGhostLockChanged(false)PlacementClient fires on exit. searchDocs.title: Task 10: [PP3] Share the drop landing-detection loop​
searchDocs.content: DroppedToolService and CraftMaterialDropService each contain a near-identical "poll until on a tagged surface and at rest, or timeout" loop. Extract it.  Files:  Create: src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/DropLandingHelper.luau Modify: src/ServerScriptService/DroppedToolService.server.luau Modify: src/ServerScriptService/CraftMaterialDropService.server.luau Step 1: Create the shared helper  --!strict local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local ProximityPickupConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Configs:WaitForChild("ProximityPickupConfig")) local DROPPABLE_SURFACE_TAG = "DroppableSurface" local DropLandingHelper = {} -- Polls until `handle` is touching a DroppableSurface part AND at rest, or until it is gone / -- times out. Returns the outcome so callers can decide what to do. export type LandingResult = "landed" | "gone" | "timeout" function DropLandingHelper.waitForLanding(handle: BasePart): LandingResult local startTime = os.clock() while true do task.wait(ProximityPickupConfig.DROP_POLL_INTERVAL) if not handle.Parent then return "gone" end if os.clock() - startTime > ProximityPickupConfig.DROP_LANDING_TIMEOUT then return "timeout" end local onSurface = false for _, part in ipairs(handle:GetTouchingParts()) do if CollectionService:HasTag(part, DROPPABLE_SURFACE_TAG) then onSurface = true break end end if not onSurface then continue end if handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude >= ProximityPickupConfig.SETTLED_VELOCITY_THRESHOLD then continue end return "landed" end end return DropLandingHelper    Step 2: Use it in DroppedToolService  Replace the body of startLandingLoop(tool, handle) so the polling loop is the helper:  local DropLandingHelper = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("DropLandingHelper")) local function startLandingLoop(tool: Tool, handle: BasePart) task.spawn(function() local result = DropLandingHelper.waitForLanding(handle) if result ~= "landed" then return -- gone or never reached a surface end if tool.Parent ~= workspace then return -- re-parented by another system before we could register it end if CollectionService:HasTag(tool, "PickupItem") then return -- already registered by another system end handle.Anchored = true handle.CFrame = CFrame.new(handle.Position) -- identity rotation for clean HoverEffect spin local metadata: { [string]: any } = { ItemType = tool:GetAttribute("ItemType"), ItemTier = tool:GetAttribute("ItemTier"), } ProximityPickupServer.RegisterItem(tool, metadata, function(player: Player, _meta: { [string]: any }) tool.Parent = player.Backpack end, true) end) end   (ServerStorage is already required at the top of the file.)   Step 3: Use it in CraftMaterialDropService  Replace the polling portion of its startLandingLoop (keep the untrackHandle bookkeeping):  local DropLandingHelper = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("DropLandingHelper")) local function startLandingLoop(player: Player, handle: BasePart, pickupCallback: (Player, { [string]: any }) -> ()) local itemType = handle:GetAttribute("ItemType") :: string task.spawn(function() local result = DropLandingHelper.waitForLanding(handle) if result == "gone" then untrackHandle(player, handle) return end if result == "timeout" then untrackHandle(player, handle) if handle.Parent then handle:Destroy() end return end -- landed if CollectionService:HasTag(handle, "PickupItem") then untrackHandle(player, handle) return end handle.Anchored = true handle.CanCollide = false handle.CFrame = CFrame.new(handle.Position) ProximityPickupServer.RegisterItem(handle, { ItemType = itemType, MaterialType = itemType, Quantity = 1, }, pickupCallback, false) if not handle.Parent then untrackHandle(player, handle) return -- merged away by _TryMerge end CollectionService:AddTag(handle, "CraftMaterial") untrackHandle(player, handle) end) end    Step 4: Studio verification  Drop a material with the in-game drop (G), and Backspace-drop a craft-material Tool. Expected: both land on a tagged surface, freeze upright, and become collectable; timeouts/world-falls clean up the handle — same behavior as before, now via the shared helper.   Step 5: Commit  git add src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/DropLandingHelper.luau src/ServerScriptService/DroppedToolService.server.luau src/ServerScriptService/CraftMaterialDropService.server.luau git commit -m "refactor(drops): share drop landing-detection loop (PP3)"

searchDocs.title: Task 14: [CAM1] Frame-rate-independent character rotation​
searchDocs.content: ThirdPersonCameraController rotates the character with a fixed per-frame alpha, so turn speed scales with FPS. Use exponential smoothing with the render delta.  Files:  Modify: src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ThirdPersonCameraController.client.luau Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/CameraConfig.luau Step 1: Re-tune RotationLerpSpeed as a per-second rate  In CameraConfig.luau, change RotationLerpSpeed = 0.4 to a rate value and note the new meaning:  	-- ThirdPersonCamera (default) ThirdPersonOffset = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.3, 0), RotationLerpSpeed = 12, -- per-second smoothing rate (used as 1 - exp(-rate*dt)); higher = snappier OffsetTweenDuration = 0.2,    Step 2: Use the render delta in the rotation lerp  Add the dt parameter to the bound render-step callback and use it for the alpha:  RunService:BindToRenderStep("ThirdPersonCameraUpdate", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)   and the rotation block:  	-- Rotate character to face movement direction local moveDir = humanoid.MoveDirection if moveDir.Magnitude > 0.1 then local targetYaw = math.atan2(-moveDir.X, -moveDir.Z) local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, targetYaw, 0) local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-CameraConfig.RotationLerpSpeed * dt) hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame, alpha) end    Step 3: Studio verification + tune  Play in ThirdPerson mode and move around. Expected: character rotates smoothly to face movement. Compare feel at high and capped FPS (Settings → reduce FPS) — turn speed should now feel consistent. Tune RotationLerpSpeed (8–16) to taste.   Step 4: Commit  git add src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ThirdPersonCameraController.client.luau src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/CameraConfig.luau git commit -m "fix(camera): frame-rate-independent character rotation (CAM1)"

searchDocs.title: Task 3: Server — ramp state, odometer, distance-based despawn, speed broadcast​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ServerScriptService/JunkService.server.luau Step 1: Add ramp state and odometer near the dynamic game state  Replace the CurrentState block (lines 45-50) so the speed is driven by a ramp. After the existing CurrentState table, add module-level ramp + odometer state:  -- [[ DYNAMIC GAME STATE ]] local CurrentState = { SpawnRate = JunkConfig.DEFAULT_SPAWN_RATE, IsSpawning = false, -- off until the train is first un-braked (SetTrainStarted) } -- Shared linear junk speed (ramped). Both server and client integrate the same -- smoothstep ramp so distance-based despawn stays aligned across machines. local currentSpeed = JunkConfig.DEFAULT_JUNK_SPEED local rampFrom = JunkConfig.DEFAULT_JUNK_SPEED local rampTo = JunkConfig.DEFAULT_JUNK_SPEED local rampStart = os.clock() -- Global distance integrator. Each junk records the odometer value at spawn; -- it despawns when (junkOdometer - spawnOdometer) exceeds DESPAWN_DISTANCE. local junkOdometer = 0   Note: CurrentState.Speed is removed; all speed reads now use currentSpeed.   Step 2: Add the shared ramp helper  After the ramp state declarations, add:  -- Advance currentSpeed toward rampTo using smoothstep over SPEED_RAMP_DURATION. local function advanceSpeed() local duration = JunkConfig.SPEED_RAMP_DURATION if duration <= 0 then currentSpeed = rampTo return end local alpha = math.clamp((os.clock() - rampStart) / duration, 0, 1) local smooth = alpha * alpha * (3 - 2 * alpha) currentSpeed = rampFrom + (rampTo - rampFrom) * smooth end    Step 3: Rewrite SetTrainState to start a ramp and broadcast  Replace the existing SetTrainState function (lines 57-68) with:  local function SetTrainState(isMoving: boolean) isTrainMoving = isMoving advanceSpeed() -- snapshot the live speed before retargeting rampFrom = currentSpeed if isMoving then rampTo = JunkConfig.DEFAULT_JUNK_SPEED CurrentState.SpawnRate = JunkConfig.DEFAULT_SPAWN_RATE print("JunkService: Train Moving - Spawns Resumed") else rampTo = JunkConfig.STOPPED_JUNK_SPEED CurrentState.SpawnRate = JunkConfig.STOPPED_SPAWN_RATE print("JunkService: Train Stopped - Spawns Slowed Down") end rampStart = os.clock() Packets.SetJunkSpeed:Fire(rampTo) end    Step 4: Sync speed to late joiners  Add a Players.PlayerAdded handler near the other player lifecycle code (the existing Players.PlayerRemoving is around line 280). Add above or below it:  Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) advanceSpeed() Packets.SetJunkSpeed:FireClient(player, currentSpeed) end)    Step 5: Store spawnOdometer on spawn and drop the spawn-time speed arg + task.delay cleanup  In the spawn loop (lines 293-348), update the activeJunks[id] insertion to record the odometer, remove the per-junk lifetime task.delay, and drop the speed arg from the fire. Replace the body from activeJunks[id] = { through the task.delay(lifeTime, ...) block with:   activeJunks[id] = { Tier = junkData.Tier, Type = junkData.Type, Yield = junkData.Yield, ModelName = junkData.ModelName, Collected = false, Owner = nil, SpawnOdometer = junkOdometer, } currentCount += 1 SpawnJunkEvent:Fire(id, junkData.ModelName, startPos)   Also add SpawnOdometer: number, to the JunkState type definition (lines 94-103).   Step 6: Drive the ramp + odometer and despawn on distance in the Heartbeat loop  Replace the existing Heartbeat connection (lines 285-291) with:  game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime) if isTrainMoving then distanceTravelled += (TRAIN_SPEED * deltaTime) end -- Advance the shared speed ramp and the global junk odometer. advanceSpeed() junkOdometer += currentSpeed * deltaTime -- Distance-based despawn: retire any junk that has travelled past DESPAWN_DISTANCE. for id, junk in activeJunks do if (junkOdometer - junk.SpawnOdometer) > JunkConfig.DESPAWN_DISTANCE then activeJunks[id] = nil currentCount -= 1 end end -- TODO: Give EXP to player every something meters/studs end)    Step 7: Studio verification  Sync. Toggle the brake; server console prints the stop/resume messages. No errors about MAX_LIFETIME_CAP or CurrentState.Speed. searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/JunkController.client.luau Step 1: Add module-level ramp state  After the local activeJunks / junkMap declarations (around lines 87-91), add:  -- Shared linear junk speed (ramped to match the server). First SetJunkSpeed -- receipt snaps; later receipts ramp smoothly via smoothstep. local currentSpeed = JunkConfig.DEFAULT_JUNK_SPEED local rampFrom = JunkConfig.DEFAULT_JUNK_SPEED local rampTo = JunkConfig.DEFAULT_JUNK_SPEED local rampStart = os.clock() local hasReceivedSpeed = false    Step 2: Add the SetJunkSpeed handler  After the ramp state, add:  Packets.SetJunkSpeed.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(targetSpeed: number) if not hasReceivedSpeed then -- First value: snap to it (covers late joiners / initial sync). hasReceivedSpeed = true currentSpeed = targetSpeed rampFrom = targetSpeed rampTo = targetSpeed rampStart = os.clock() return end rampFrom = currentSpeed rampTo = targetSpeed rampStart = os.clock() end)    Step 3: Remove the per-junk Speed field from the type and spawn handler  In the ActiveJunk type (lines 78-85), delete the Speed: number, line.  In the SpawnJunkEvent.OnClientEvent handler (lines 93-122), change the signature to drop speed:  SpawnJunkEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(id, modelName, startPos)   and remove Speed = speed, from the entry table construction (lines 111-118).   Step 4: Add the ramp helper and use shared speed in the simulation loop  Add this helper just above the RunService.PreSimulation:Connect block (line 259):  -- Advance currentSpeed toward rampTo using smoothstep over SPEED_RAMP_DURATION. local function advanceSpeed() local duration = JunkConfig.SPEED_RAMP_DURATION if duration <= 0 then currentSpeed = rampTo return end local alpha = math.clamp((os.clock() - rampStart) / duration, 0, 1) local smooth = alpha * alpha * (3 - 2 * alpha) currentSpeed = rampFrom + (rampTo - rampFrom) * smooth end   Then replace the PreSimulation loop body (lines 259-275) so it advances the speed once per frame and moves every junk by the shared currentSpeed:  RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt) advanceSpeed() local moveAmount = currentSpeed * dt for i = #activeJunks, 1, -1 do local data = activeJunks[i] local direction = JunkConfig.MOVE_DIRECTION local cf = data.Model:GetPivot() local newCF = (cf + direction * moveAmount) * CFrame.Angles(data.RotSpeed.X * dt, data.RotSpeed.Y * dt, data.RotSpeed.Z * dt) data.Model:PivotTo(newCF) data.DistanceTraveled += moveAmount if data.DistanceTraveled > JunkConfig.DESPAWN_DISTANCE then RemoveJunkLocal(data.Id) end end end)    Step 5: Studio verification (the core acceptance test)  Sync and playtest with the train running. Let several junk spread across the field, then toggle the brake. Expected: all visible junk — not just newly spawned ones — smoothly decelerate together over ~1.5 s to the stopped speed. Un-brake: all junk smoothly accelerate back together. The illusion of the whole train slowing/speeding holds; no junk moves at a stale speed. Confirm junk still despawns at the far edge and is collectible right up until it disappears (no ghost junk). This controller creates no UI; it only drives the existing -- instances. If these names change in Studio, the WaitForChild calls will -- hang -- keep them in sync with the asset. local gui = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("TrainFuelGui") local mainContainer = gui:WaitForChild("MainContainer") local fuelBarContainer = mainContainer:WaitForChild("FuelBarContainer") local iconTextContainer = mainContainer:WaitForChild("FuelBarIconTextContainer") local bar = fuelBarContainer:WaitForChild("FuelBar") :: Frame local label = iconTextContainer:WaitForChild("FuelText") :: TextLabel    Step 2: Update the RenderStepped loop to use scale-based bar fill and percent-only text  Find the current render loop (lines ~99–119):  RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number) local target = predictedFuel() -- Frame-rate-independent exponential smoothing. local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-dt * SMOOTH_K) displayedFuel += (target - displayedFuel) * alpha local pct = displayedFuel / TrainConfig.MAX_FUEL bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(pct, 0, 1), 1) local roundedPct = math.floor(pct * 100 + 0.5) if snap.isStalled then bar.BackgroundColor3 = STALLED_COLOR label.Text = "OUT OF FUEL" elseif snap.isBraked then bar.BackgroundColor3 = BRAKED_COLOR label.Text = ("BRAKED %d%%"):format(roundedPct) else bar.BackgroundColor3 = RUNNING_COLOR label.Text = ("FUEL %d%%"):format(roundedPct) end end)   Replace it with:  RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number) local target = predictedFuel() -- Frame-rate-independent exponential smoothing. local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-dt * SMOOTH_K) displayedFuel += (target - displayedFuel) * alpha local pct = math.clamp(displayedFuel / TrainConfig.MAX_FUEL, 0, 1) -- FuelBar fills horizontally within FuelBarContainer; keep full height. bar.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0) -- Percent-only text; state is conveyed by bar color. local roundedPct = math.floor(pct * 100 + 0.5) label.Text = ("%d%%"):format(roundedPct) -- State-based bar color (preserved behavior). if snap.isStalled then bar.BackgroundColor3 = STALLED_COLOR elseif snap.isBraked then bar.BackgroundColor3 = BRAKED_COLOR else bar.BackgroundColor3 = RUNNING_COLOR end end)    Step 3: Confirm no UI-creation code remains  Run: git grep -n "Instance.new" -- src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/TrainFuelGuiController.client.luauExpected: no output (zero matches). The controller must not create any instances. Step 4: Sanity-read the file  Read the whole file top to bottom. Confirm:  The header comment, services, requires, snap table, color constants, SMOOTH_K, predictedFuel(), displayedFuel, and the Signals.OnTrainStateChanged:Connect(...) block are all still present and unchanged. PlayerGui is still defined (line ~21) and is now used by the reference-resolution block. bar and label are the only references the render loop touches. No leftover references to container, containerCorner, barCorner, or the old gui = Instance.new(...). searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/CameraConfig.luau Step 1: Replace the config body  Replace the entire return { ... } table so it adds the spring tuning and removes the two dead fields (TurnResponsiveness, OffsetTweenDuration). OffsetSpringOmega = 22, -- natural frequency OffsetSpringZeta = 0.75, -- damping ratio -- CameraBoom (shared) BoomEnabled = true, BoomBuffer = 0.5, BoomSmoothingSpeed = 10, CameraMinZoomDistance = 6, ShootingCameraMaxZoomDistance = 9, ThirdPersonCameraMaxZoomDistance = 9, }    Step 2: Verify no remaining references to removed fields  Run a content search for the two removed fields across src/:  TurnResponsiveness — expect zero matches in src/ (only docs may mention it).OffsetTweenDuration — expect matches only in ThirdPersonCameraController.client.luau (deleted in Task 2). Removes TurnResponsiveness (unreferenced) and OffsetTweenDuration (replaced by the spring; last consumer is deleted in the controller consolidation). EOF )"

searchDocs.title: Task 2: Create the unified CameraController and delete the two old controllers​
searchDocs.content: This is an atomic swap: create the new controller and delete both old ones in a single commit, so the synced game never has two controllers double-binding LeftAlt, RenderStep, the reticle, or the RequestShootingCamera listener.  Files:  Create: src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/CameraController.client.luau Delete: src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ThirdPersonCameraController.client.luau Delete: src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ShootingCameraController.client.luau Step 1: Write the new controller  Create src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/CameraController.client.luau with this exact content:  --!strict --!optimize 2 --!native local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService") local Players = game:GetService("Players") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local RunService = game:GetService("RunService") local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService") local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SharedModules") local CameraConfig = require(SharedModules.Configs.CameraConfig) local MotionMaster = require(SharedModules.MotionMaster) local Signals = require(SharedModules.Signals) local player = Players.LocalPlayer assert(player, "LocalPlayer is nil") local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") :: PlayerGui local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera assert(camera, "CurrentCamera is nil") -- ── Reticle (shown only in aim mode; replaces the locked cursor icon) ───────── local reticleGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui") reticleGui.Name = "AimReticle" reticleGui.ResetOnSpawn = false reticleGui.Parent = playerGui local reticleImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel") reticleImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1 reticleImage.Image = CameraConfig.ReticleImage reticleImage.Size = UDim2.fromScale(CameraConfig.ReticleScale, CameraConfig.ReticleScale) reticleImage.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) reticleImage.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5) reticleImage.Visible = false reticleImage.Parent = reticleGui local aspectRatio = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint") aspectRatio.AspectRatio = 1 aspectRatio.DominantAxis = Enum.DominantAxis.Height aspectRatio.Parent = reticleImage -- ── State ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Two orthogonal booleans. aim wins: while aimMode is true, freeLookMode is inert. local aimMode = false -- driven by Signals.RequestShootingCamera (tools / systems) local freeLookMode = false -- LeftAlt toggle: free mouse + AutoRotate (non-aim only) local guiRequestsMouse = false -- cursor-reveal request from a GUI (non-aim only) local humanoid: Humanoid? = nil local hrp: BasePart? = nil local offsetSpring: any = nil -- MotionMaster SpringDriver bound to humanoid.CameraOffset local function targetOffset(): Vector3 if aimMode then return CameraConfig.ShootingOffset end return CameraConfig.ThirdPersonOffset end -- Centralizes spring target, reticle, mouse behaviour, cursor, and AutoRotate -- for the current (aimMode, freeLookMode) state. Called on every state change. local function applyState() reticleImage.Visible = aimMode if offsetSpring then offsetSpring:SetTarget(targetOffset()) end if not humanoid then return end if aimMode then humanoid.AutoRotate = false UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false elseif freeLookMode then humanoid.AutoRotate = true UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true else humanoid.AutoRotate = false UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = guiRequestsMouse end end -- ── Character lifecycle ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── local function onCharacterAdded(character: Model) humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart -- SpringDriver binds to a specific humanoid; recreate per character. offsetSpring = MotionMaster.Spring(humanoid, "CameraOffset", { Omega = CameraConfig.OffsetSpringOmega, Zeta = CameraConfig.OffsetSpringZeta, }) applyState() end if player.Character then task.spawn(onCharacterAdded, player.Character) end player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded) player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() if offsetSpring then offsetSpring:Destroy() offsetSpring = nil end humanoid = nil hrp = nil end) -- ── Signal wiring ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Programmatic aim entry/exit (GrabHook on equip, PlacementClient on build entry). Signals.RequestShootingCamera:Connect(function(state: boolean?) local enable = if type(state) == "boolean" then state else not aimMode if enable == aimMode then return end aimMode = enable applyState() -- Broadcast for CameraBoomController (switches its max-zoom mode). Signals.OnShootingCameraToggled:Fire(aimMode) end) -- Cursor-reveal request from a future cursor-needing GUI (ignored while aiming). Signals.RequestMouseIcon:Connect(function(visible: boolean) guiRequestsMouse = visible applyState() end) -- LeftAlt toggles free-mouse vs locked third-person; no-op while aiming. ContextActionService:BindAction("ToggleCameraMode", function(_, inputState, _) if inputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end if aimMode then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end freeLookMode = not freeLookMode applyState() return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end, false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt) -- ── Per-frame: character facing + defensive re-assert ─────────────────────── RunService:BindToRenderStep("CameraUpdate", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt) if not humanoid or not hrp then return end -- Free-mouse default mode: Roblox default camera + AutoRotate handle everything; -- the spring keeps driving CameraOffset on its own connection. if not aimMode and freeLookMode then return end -- Aim and locked third-person both lock the mouse to centre and disable AutoRotate. -- Cursor stays hidden unless a GUI requested it in locked (non-aim) mode. humanoid.AutoRotate = false if UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter end local cursorShouldShow = (not aimMode) and guiRequestsMouse if UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled ~= cursorShouldShow then UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = cursorShouldShow end if humanoid.Sit then return end local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-CameraConfig.RotationLerpSpeed * dt) if aimMode then -- Face camera yaw (shoulder / aim). local _, yaw = camera.CFrame:ToOrientation() local goal = CFrame.new(hrp.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame:Lerp(goal, alpha) else -- Face movement direction (locked third person). local moveDir = humanoid.MoveDirection if moveDir.Magnitude > 0.1 then local yaw = math.atan2(-moveDir.X, -moveDir.Z) local goal = CFrame.new(hrp.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame:Lerp(goal, alpha) end end end)    Step 2: Delete the two superseded controllers  git rm "src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ThirdPersonCameraController.client.luau" git rm "src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ShootingCameraController.client.luau"    Step 3: Logic review (no runner — read with fresh eyes)  Confirm each of these by reading the new file:  RequestShootingCamera listener fires OnShootingCameraToggled on every real state change (so CameraBoomController still switches zoom mode). ✔ matches old ShootingCameraController:61. Aim mode shows the reticle and hides the cursor; non-aim never shows the reticle. ✔ Spring target is ShootingOffset in aim, ThirdPersonOffset otherwise — never zero (matches old ThirdPersonCameraController which kept ThirdPersonOffset in both sub-modes). ✔ offsetSpring:Destroy() is called on CharacterRemoving (no leaked render connection). ✔ LeftAlt is a no-op while aiming; otherwise toggles freeLookMode. ✔ No reference remains to SmoothShiftLock, MotionMaster.Create, TweenService, or OffsetTweenDuration. ✔ Step 4: Confirm nothing else references the deleted scripts  Content-search src/ for ShootingCameraController and ThirdPersonCameraController — expect zero matches in src/ (scripts are not required by name anywhere). Docs still referencing them are handled in Task 4.   Step 5: Commit  git add "src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/CameraController.client.luau" git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF' refactor(camera): unify third-person + aim cameras into CameraController Single mode-aware controller (aimMode / freeLookMode). Spring-drives humanoid.CameraOffset via MotionMaster between the two offsets, faces camera yaw in aim and movement direction otherwise. Replaces ThirdPersonCameraController and the SmoothShiftLock-based ShootingCameraController; external signal API (RequestShootingCamera / OnShootingCameraToggled / RequestMouseIcon) unchanged. EOF )"

searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Signals/init.luau Modify: Documentations/Project-Maintenance-Guide.md Step 1: Fix the stale Signals comment  In src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Signals/init.luau, replace:  	-- NOTE: consumed by ThirdPersonCameraController but no producer yet — cursor-reveal for a -- future cursor-needing GUI. Until something fires this, the camera never reveals the cursor.   with:  	-- NOTE: consumed by CameraController but no producer yet — cursor-reveal for a -- future cursor-needing GUI. Until something fires this, the camera never reveals the cursor.    Step 2: Maintenance Guide — overview line (line ~5)  Replace:  Endless Journey is a Roblox game inspired by Void Train, using a client/server architecture with shared modules. Core systems are placement (grid + free), stamina/sprint, junk spawning and collection, grabhook traversal/collection visuals, ThirdPersonCamera / ShootingCamera system, and replicated sound.   with:  Endless Journey is a Roblox game inspired by Void Train, using a client/server architecture with shared modules. Core systems are placement (grid + free), stamina/sprint, junk spawning and collection, grabhook traversal/collection visuals, the unified CameraController (third-person + aim modes), and replicated sound.    Step 3: Maintenance Guide — client scripts list (line ~14)  Replace ThirdPersonCameraController, ShootingCameraController, CameraBoomController with CameraController, CameraBoomController in the "Build/UI control" line.   Step 4: Maintenance Guide — camera behaviour summary (line ~37)  Replace:   - ThirdPersonCamera is the default: mouse locked centre, character rotates to movement direction. ShootingCamera (SmoothShiftLock engine) activates programmatically via Signals.RequestShootingCamera (GrabHook on equip; PlacementClient on build mode entry). CameraBoom shared occlusion + zoom clamp active in both modes.   with:   - CameraController is the single client camera. Default (third-person) mode: mouse locked centre, character rotates to movement direction; LeftAlt toggles a free-mouse sub-mode. Aim mode activates programmatically via Signals.RequestShootingCamera (GrabHook on equip; PlacementClient on build mode entry) — shoulder offset, reticle, character faces the camera. A MotionMaster spring eases humanoid.CameraOffset between modes. CameraBoom shared occlusion + zoom clamp active in both modes. Mouse locked centre, AutoRotate off, character rotates to movement direction (Humanoid.MoveDirection). Suspends on Signals.OnShootingCameraToggled(true); re-engages on false. - Maintenance notes: - Tuning: ThirdPersonOffset and RotationLerpSpeed in CameraConfig. - `src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ShootingCameraController.client.luau` - Glue for the vendored SmoothShiftLock package. searchDocs.title: Task 5: Studio verification (human-run)​
searchDocs.content: No automated runner exists; the human syncs via rojo serve and checks in Studio. Run through the spec's checklist:   Default spawn → third-person offset; character faces movement direction; mouse locked centre. LeftAlt → free mouse + cursor + AutoRotate; LeftAlt again → locked third-person. Equip GrabHook / aim → reticle appears, shoulder offset eases in (no snap), character faces camera yaw, cursor hidden. Release aim → offset eases back to third-person, reticle hides, prior LeftAlt state restored. Enter build mode (PlacementClient) → aim disengages cleanly. Respawn while aiming and while in third-person → no errors, offset spring resumes (driver recreated). CameraBoom still clamps zoom against walls in both modes (OnShootingCameraToggled still drives it).

searchDocs.title: Task 1: Central config SoundConfig.luau​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/SoundConfig.luau Step 1: Write the config module  --!strict -- Central configuration + registry for all game audio (SFX, BGM, ambience). -- Single source of truth: edit IDs/volumes/pitch here, not in feature configs. local SoundConfig = {} export type SoundDef = { Id: string, Volume: number?, Pitch: number?, PitchRange: { number }?, -- {min, max}; random pitch per play (overrides Pitch) Looped: boolean?, Group: string?, -- "SFX" | "BGM" | "Ambience"; default "SFX" Replicate: boolean?, -- positional broadcast to other clients allowed Debounce: number?, -- min seconds between plays of this name (anti-spam) } export type PlaylistDef = { Tracks: { string }, Shuffle: boolean?, Gap: number?, -- seconds between tracks Volume: number?, Crossfade: number?, -- seconds } -- Default effective volume per bus (multiplies through Master). 0..1 (engine allows up to 10). SoundConfig.GroupVolumes = { Master = 1, SFX = 1, BGM = 0.6, Ambience = 0.5, } SoundConfig.Sfx = { PlacementPlace = { Id = "rbxassetid://116021254194480" }, PlacementRotate = { Id = "" }, PlaceableMove = { Id = "" }, PlaceableStash = { Id = "" }, ProximityPickup = { Id = "rbxassetid://91026773425948", Volume = 0.2, PitchRange = { 0.92, 1.06 }, Debounce = 0.1 }, GrabHookFire = { Id = "rbxassetid://70375067578450", Volume = 0.5, PitchRange = { 1.0, 1.0 }, Replicate = true }, GrabHookLoop = { Id = "rbxassetid://83230748776604", Volume = 0.5, Looped = true, Replicate = true }, GrabHookCooldown = { Id = "rbxassetid://93475294170115", Volume = 1.0 }, } :: { [string]: SoundDef } SoundConfig.Music = { -- Tracks empty for now -> PlayMusic no-ops until real IDs are added. Playlists = { Default = { Tracks = {}, Shuffle = true, Gap = 1.0, Volume = 0.6, Crossfade = 1.5 }, } :: { [string]: PlaylistDef }, } SoundConfig.Ambience = { Beds = { -- TrainHum = { Id = "", Volume = 0.4 }, } :: { [string]: SoundDef }, Autostart = {} :: { string }, -- bed names to fade in on Init } -- Set of sound IDs that may be relayed positionally to other clients. function SoundConfig.GetReplicatedIds(): { [string]: true } local ids: { [string]: true } = {} for _, def in SoundConfig.Sfx do if def.Replicate and type(def.Id) == "string" and def.Id ~= "" then ids[def.Id] = true end end return ids end -- All non-empty asset IDs (for preloading). function SoundConfig.GetPreloadIds(): { string } local ids = {} for _, def in SoundConfig.Sfx do if type(def.Id) == "string" and def.Id ~= "" then table.insert(ids, def.Id) end end for _, bed in SoundConfig.Ambience.Beds do if type(bed.Id) == "string" and bed.Id ~= "" then table.insert(ids, bed.Id) end end for _, playlist in SoundConfig.Music.Playlists do for _, id in playlist.Tracks do if id ~= "" then table.insert(ids, id) end end end return ids end return SoundConfig    Step 2: Verify — sync; in Studio command bar runprint(require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Configs.SoundConfig).GetReplicatedIds())Expected: a table containing the GrabHook fire + loop IDs as keys. Step 3: Commit (Haiku): feat(sound): add central SoundConfig registry

searchDocs.title: Task 2: Groups.luau (volume buses)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/SoundManager/Groups.luau Step 1: Write the module  --!strict -- Owns the SoundGroup bus hierarchy: Master -> {SFX, BGM, Ambience}. -- SoundGroups nest via the `.SoundGroup` property; SoundGroup.Volume multiplies. -- (Verified against the Roblox Engine API: "SoundGroups can be nested".) local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SoundConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Configs.SoundConfig) local Groups = {} local BUS_NAMES = { "SFX", "BGM", "Ambience" } local master: SoundGroup? = nil local buses: { [string]: SoundGroup } = {} local function getOrCreate(name: string): SoundGroup local existing = SoundService:FindFirstChild(name) if existing and existing:IsA("SoundGroup") then return existing end local g = Instance.new("SoundGroup") g.Name = name g.Parent = SoundService return g end local function ensure() if master then return end master = getOrCreate("Master") (master :: SoundGroup).Volume = SoundConfig.GroupVolumes.Master or 1 for _, name in BUS_NAMES do local bus = getOrCreate(name) bus.Volume = SoundConfig.GroupVolumes[name] or 1 bus.SoundGroup = master buses[name] = bus end end function Groups.Ensure() ensure() end -- Returns the SoundGroup for a bus name ("SFX" when nil/unknown). function Groups.Get(name: string?): SoundGroup ensure() return buses[name or "SFX"] or buses.SFX end function Groups.SetVolume(name: string, volume: number) ensure() if name == "Master" then (master :: SoundGroup).Volume = volume return end local bus = buses[name] if bus then bus.Volume = volume end end function Groups.GetVolume(name: string): number ensure() if name == "Master" then return (master :: SoundGroup).Volume end local bus = buses[name] return if bus then bus.Volume else 0 end return Groups    Step 2: Verify — sync; in Studio runrequire(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.SoundManager.Groups).Ensure()then via MCP search_game_tree (or the Explorer) confirm SoundService now has Master, SFX, BGM, Ambience SoundGroups, and SFX.SoundGroup == Master. Step 3: Commit (Haiku): feat(sound): add SoundGroup volume buses

searchDocs.title: Task 3: Pool.luau (positional sound pooling)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/SoundManager/Pool.luau  This moves the pooling that currently lives in SoundController.client.luau (Task 8 removes it from there).   Step 1: Write the module  --!strict -- Pooled instances for positional one-shot SFX: a hidden anchored part to -- carry the Sound, a reusable Sound, and an optional PitchShiftSoundEffect. local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local InstancePool = require(SharedModules.GenericPoolInstance) local ObjectPool = require(SharedModules.GenericPoolObject) local Pool = {} local MAX_SIZE = 20 local INITIAL = 5 local EXPAND = 5 local staticPartPool local soundPool local pitchPool local function ensure() if staticPartPool then return end local template = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StaticPart") assert(template:IsA("Part"), "StaticPart template is invalid") local poolLocation = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Pools") staticPartPool = InstancePool.new(template, INITIAL, MAX_SIZE, EXPAND, poolLocation) soundPool = ObjectPool.new(Instance, { "Sound" }, 0, MAX_SIZE, EXPAND) pitchPool = ObjectPool.new(Instance, { "PitchShiftSoundEffect" }, 0, MAX_SIZE, EXPAND) end function Pool.Ensure() ensure() end -- Acquire a part positioned at `position` with a Sound parented to it. function Pool.Acquire(position: Vector3): (Part, Sound) ensure() local part = staticPartPool:RetrieveObject(CFrame.new(position)) local sound = soundPool:RetrieveObject() part.Parent = workspace sound.Parent = part return part, sound end function Pool.AcquirePitch(): PitchShiftSoundEffect ensure() return pitchPool:RetrieveObject() end -- Return a part + sound (+optional pitch effect) to their pools. function Pool.Release(part: Part, sound: Sound, pitch: PitchShiftSoundEffect?) ensure() if pitch then pitchPool:InsertObject(pitch) end task.defer(function() soundPool:InsertObject(sound) task.defer(function() staticPartPool:InsertObject(part) end) end) end return Pool    Step 2: Verify — sync; confirm no Luau errors in Output. (Functional check happens in Task 4.) Step 3: Commit (Haiku): feat(sound): add positional sound pool

searchDocs.title: Task 4: SFX.luau (one-shots, positional, looped, replication)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/SoundManager/SFX.luau Step 1: Write the module  --!strict local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local SoundConfig = require(SharedModules.Configs.SoundConfig) local Packets = require(SharedModules.Packets) local MotionMaster = require(SharedModules.MotionMaster) local Groups = require(script.Parent.Groups) local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool) local SFX = {} export type PlayOptions = { Volume: number?, Pitch: number?, PitchRange: { number }?, Replicate: boolean?, Debounce: number?, Position: Vector3?, -- used by PlayLooped's replicate-on-start FadeIn: number?, -- PlayLooped: fade from 0 to target over N seconds } export type LoopHandle = { Sound: Sound, FadeTo: (self: LoopHandle, volume: number, duration: number?) -> (), Stop: (self: LoopHandle, fadeDuration: number?) -> (), Destroy: (self: LoopHandle) -> (), } local lastPlayed: { [string]: number } = {} local function getDef(name: string): SoundConfig.SoundDef? local def = SoundConfig.Sfx[name] if not def then warn(("[SoundManager] Unknown SFX '%s'"):format(tostring(name))) end return def end local function passesDebounce(name: string, def: SoundConfig.SoundDef, opts: PlayOptions?): boolean local window = (opts and opts.Debounce) or def.Debounce if not window or window <= 0 then return true end local now = os.clock() local last = lastPlayed[name] if last and (now - last) < window then return false end lastPlayed[name] = now return true end local function resolvePitch(def: SoundConfig.SoundDef, opts: PlayOptions?): number if opts and opts.Pitch then return opts.Pitch end local range = (opts and opts.PitchRange) or def.PitchRange if range and #range == 2 then return range[1] + math.random() * (range[2] - range[1]) end return def.Pitch or 1.0 end local function shouldReplicate(def: SoundConfig.SoundDef, opts: PlayOptions?): boolean if opts and opts.Replicate ~= nil then return opts.Replicate end return def.Replicate == true end -- 2D one-shot (transient; uses PlaybackSpeed for pitch). function SFX.Play(name: string, opts: PlayOptions?) local def = getDef(name) if not def or def.Id == "" then return end if not passesDebounce(name, def, opts) then return end local sound = Instance.new("Sound") sound.SoundId = def.Id sound.Volume = (opts and opts.Volume) or def.Volume or 0.5 sound.PlaybackSpeed = resolvePitch(def, opts) sound.SoundGroup = Groups.Get(def.Group) sound.Parent = SoundService sound:Play() sound.Ended:Once(function() sound:Destroy() end) end -- Internal: pooled positional play (pitch via PitchShiftSoundEffect, matching the old SoundController). local function playPositional(id: string, position: Vector3, volume: number, pitch: number) local part, sound = Pool.Acquire(position) sound.SoundId = id sound.Volume = volume sound.PlaybackSpeed = 1.0 sound.SoundGroup = Groups.Get("SFX") local pitchEffect: PitchShiftSoundEffect? = nil if pitch and pitch ~= 1.0 then pitchEffect = Pool.AcquirePitch() ;(pitchEffect :: PitchShiftSoundEffect).Octave = pitch ;(pitchEffect :: PitchShiftSoundEffect).Parent = sound end sound:Play() if not sound.IsLoaded then sound.Loaded:Wait() end task.delay(sound.TimeLength + 0.05, function() Pool.Release(part, sound, pitchEffect) end) end -- Positional one-shot played locally; opts.Replicate (or def.Replicate) ALSO broadcasts. function SFX.PlayAt(name: string, position: Vector3, opts: PlayOptions?) local def = getDef(name) if not def or def.Id == "" then return end if not passesDebounce(name, def, opts) then return end local volume = (opts and opts.Volume) or def.Volume or 0.5 local pitch = resolvePitch(def, opts) task.spawn(playPositional, def.Id, position, volume, pitch) if shouldReplicate(def, opts) then Packets.ReplicateSoundAtLocation:Fire({ Location = position, SoundConfig = { Id = def.Id, Volume = volume, Pitch = pitch }, }) end end -- Looped sound with a control handle (used by GrabHook's grapple loop). function SFX.PlayLooped(name: string, opts: PlayOptions?): LoopHandle? local def = getDef(name) if not def or def.Id == "" then return nil end local targetVolume = (opts and opts.Volume) or def.Volume or 0.5 local fadeIn = opts and opts.FadeIn local sound = Instance.new("Sound") sound.SoundId = def.Id sound.Looped = true sound.PlaybackSpeed = resolvePitch(def, opts) sound.SoundGroup = Groups.Get(def.Group) sound.Volume = if fadeIn and fadeIn > 0 then 0 else targetVolume sound.Parent = SoundService sound:Play() if fadeIn and fadeIn > 0 then MotionMaster.Play(sound, { Volume = targetVolume }, { Duration = fadeIn }) end -- Parity with prior behavior: fire a single positional play to other clients on start. if shouldReplicate(def, opts) and opts and opts.Position then Packets.ReplicateSoundAtLocation:Fire({ Location = opts.Position, SoundConfig = { Id = def.Id, Volume = targetVolume, Pitch = 1.0 }, }) end local handle = {} :: LoopHandle handle.Sound = sound function handle:FadeTo(volume: number, duration: number?) if duration and duration > 0 then MotionMaster.Play(sound, { Volume = volume }, { Duration = duration }) else sound.Volume = volume end end function handle:Stop(fadeDuration: number?) if fadeDuration and fadeDuration > 0 then MotionMaster.Play(sound, { Volume = 0 }, { Duration = fadeDuration }) task.delay(fadeDuration, function() if sound.Parent then sound:Stop() sound:Destroy() end end) else sound:Stop() sound:Destroy() end end function handle:Destroy() sound:Destroy() end return handle end -- Receive replicated positional sounds from other players. function SFX.ConnectReplication() Packets.ReplicateSoundAtLocation.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data) if typeof(data) ~= "table" or typeof(data.SoundConfig) ~= "table" then return end local cfg = data.SoundConfig if type(cfg.Id) ~= "string" or cfg.Id == "" then return end local position = data.Location or Vector3.zero task.spawn(playPositional, cfg.Id, position, cfg.Volume or 0.5, cfg.Pitch or 1.0) end) end return SFX    Step 2: Verify — sync; in Studio runlocal SM = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.SoundManager.SFX); SM.Play("GrabHookCooldown")Expected: cooldown sound audible, no errors. (Full integration verified after Task 7.) Step 3: Commit (Haiku): feat(sound): add SFX playback + replication module

searchDocs.title: Task 5: Music.luau (playlist / shuffle BGM)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/SoundManager/Music.luau Step 1: Write the module  --!strict local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local SoundConfig = require(SharedModules.Configs.SoundConfig) local MotionMaster = require(SharedModules.MotionMaster) local Groups = require(script.Parent.Groups) local Music = {} local currentPlaylistName: string? = nil local order: { string } = {} local index = 0 local currentSound: Sound? = nil local generation = 0 -- bumping invalidates pending async advances local function buildOrder(playlist: SoundConfig.PlaylistDef): { string } local tracks = table.clone(playlist.Tracks) if playlist.Shuffle then for i = #tracks, 2, -1 do local j = math.random(i) tracks[i], tracks[j] = tracks[j], tracks[i] end end return tracks end local function fadeOutAndDestroy(sound: Sound, fade: number) if fade > 0 then MotionMaster.Play(sound, { Volume = 0 }, { Duration = fade }) task.delay(fade, function() if sound.Parent then sound:Stop() sound:Destroy() end end) else sound:Stop() sound:Destroy() end end local function playIndex(playlist: SoundConfig.PlaylistDef, gen: number) if gen ~= generation or #order == 0 then return end index = (index % #order) + 1 local id = order[index] local previous = currentSound if id == "" then currentSound = nil if previous then fadeOutAndDestroy(previous, playlist.Crossfade or 0) end return end local target = playlist.Volume or 0.6 local crossfade = playlist.Crossfade or 0 local sound = Instance.new("Sound") sound.SoundId = id sound.Looped = false sound.SoundGroup = Groups.Get("BGM") sound.Volume = if crossfade > 0 then 0 else target sound.Parent = SoundService sound:Play() currentSound = sound if crossfade > 0 then MotionMaster.Play(sound, { Volume = target }, { Duration = crossfade }) if previous then fadeOutAndDestroy(previous, crossfade) end elseif previous then previous:Stop() previous:Destroy() end sound.Ended:Once(function() if gen ~= generation then return end task.delay(playlist.Gap or 0, function() playIndex(playlist, gen) end) end) end -- Start (or replace) the active playlist. No-op when the playlist has no tracks. function Music.Play(playlistName: string?) local name = playlistName or "Default" local playlist = SoundConfig.Music.Playlists[name] if not playlist then warn(("[SoundManager] Unknown playlist '%s'"):format(name)) return end if #playlist.Tracks == 0 then return end generation += 1 currentPlaylistName = name order = buildOrder(playlist) index = 0 playIndex(playlist, generation) end function Music.Skip() if not currentPlaylistName then return end local playlist = SoundConfig.Music.Playlists[currentPlaylistName] if not playlist then return end generation += 1 playIndex(playlist, generation) end function Music.Stop(fade: number?) generation += 1 currentPlaylistName = nil local sound = currentSound currentSound = nil if sound then fadeOutAndDestroy(sound, fade or 0) end end return Music    Step 2: Verify — sync; confirm no Luau errors. With empty Default.Tracks, Music.Play() is a no-op (correct). Full check in Task 7 with a temporary track ID. Step 3: Commit (Haiku): feat(sound): add playlist/shuffle music module

searchDocs.title: Task 6: Ambience.luau (global 2D beds)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/SoundManager/Ambience.luau Step 1: Write the module  --!strict local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local SoundConfig = require(SharedModules.Configs.SoundConfig) local MotionMaster = require(SharedModules.MotionMaster) local Groups = require(script.Parent.Groups) local Ambience = {} local DEFAULT_FADE = 1.0 local active: { [string]: Sound } = {} local function startBed(name: string, fade: number) if active[name] then return end local bed = SoundConfig.Ambience.Beds[name] if not bed or bed.Id == "" then return end local target = bed.Volume or 0.5 local sound = Instance.new("Sound") sound.SoundId = bed.Id sound.Looped = true sound.SoundGroup = Groups.Get("Ambience") sound.Volume = if fade > 0 then 0 else target sound.Parent = SoundService sound:Play() if fade > 0 then MotionMaster.Play(sound, { Volume = target }, { Duration = fade }) end active[name] = sound end local function stopBed(name: string, fade: number) local sound = active[name] if not sound then return end active[name] = nil if fade > 0 then MotionMaster.Play(sound, { Volume = 0 }, { Duration = fade }) task.delay(fade, function() if sound.Parent then sound:Stop() sound:Destroy() end end) else sound:Stop() sound:Destroy() end end function Ambience.Add(name: string, fade: number?) startBed(name, fade or DEFAULT_FADE) end function Ambience.Remove(name: string, fade: number?) stopBed(name, fade or DEFAULT_FADE) end -- Crossfade to exactly the given set of beds. function Ambience.Set(names: { string }, fade: number?) local f = if fade ~= nil then fade else DEFAULT_FADE local want: { [string]: true } = {} for _, n in names do want[n] = true end for name in active do if not want[name] then stopBed(name, f) end end for _, name in names do startBed(name, f) end end function Ambience.StopAll(fade: number?) local f = if fade ~= nil then fade else DEFAULT_FADE for name in active do stopBed(name, f) end end return Ambience    Step 2: Verify — sync; confirm no Luau errors. With no beds configured, Ambience.Set({}) is a no-op (correct). Step 3: Commit (Haiku): feat(sound): add global ambience bed module

searchDocs.title: Task 7: init.luau facade + SoundManager.Init()​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/SoundManager/init.luau Step 1: Write the facade  --!strict -- SoundManager: single entry point for all game audio (SFX, BGM, ambience). -- Call .Init() once from a client bootstrap; other client code/tools call the -- Play* / Music / Ambience / volume methods. Fades use MotionMaster. local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local SoundConfig = require(SharedModules.Configs.SoundConfig) local Groups = require(script.Groups) local Pool = require(script.Pool) local SFX = require(script.SFX) local Music = require(script.Music) local Ambience = require(script.Ambience) local SoundManager = {} export type PlayOptions = SFX.PlayOptions export type LoopHandle = SFX.LoopHandle local initialized = false function SoundManager.Init() if initialized then return end initialized = true Groups.Ensure() Pool.Ensure() SFX.ConnectReplication() -- Preload all configured audio assets. task.spawn(function() local ids = SoundConfig.GetPreloadIds() if #ids > 0 then ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(ids) end end) -- Autostart ambience beds (no-op when none configured). if #SoundConfig.Ambience.Autostart > 0 then Ambience.Set(SoundConfig.Ambience.Autostart, 0) end end -- SFX function SoundManager.PlaySFX(name: string, opts: PlayOptions?) SFX.Play(name, opts) end function SoundManager.PlaySFXAt(name: string, position: Vector3, opts: PlayOptions?) SFX.PlayAt(name, position, opts) end function SoundManager.PlayLooped(name: string, opts: PlayOptions?): LoopHandle? return SFX.PlayLooped(name, opts) end -- Music function SoundManager.PlayMusic(playlistName: string?) Music.Play(playlistName) end function SoundManager.SkipMusic() Music.Skip() end function SoundManager.StopMusic(fade: number?) Music.Stop(fade) end -- Ambience function SoundManager.SetAmbience(names: { string }, fade: number?) Ambience.Set(names, fade) end function SoundManager.AddAmbience(name: string, fade: number?) Ambience.Add(name, fade) end function SoundManager.RemoveAmbience(name: string, fade: number?) Ambience.Remove(name, fade) end function SoundManager.StopAmbience(fade: number?) Ambience.StopAll(fade) end -- Volume buses function SoundManager.SetVolume(group: string, volume: number) Groups.SetVolume(group, volume) end function SoundManager.GetVolume(group: string): number return Groups.GetVolume(group) end return SoundManager   Note: script.Groups/script.SFX/etc. resolve because Rojo maps the folder's init.luau to the SoundManager ModuleScript with the submodules as its children.   Step 2: Verify — sync; in Studio runlocal SM = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.SoundManager); SM.Init(); SM.PlaySFX("GrabHookCooldown"); SM.SetVolume("SFX", 0); SM.PlaySFX("ProximityPickup")Expected: first sound audible; after muting SFX the second is silent; no errors. searchDocs.title: Janitor API reference (used throughout)​
searchDocs.content: local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Janitor) local j = Janitor.new() -- create j:Add(instance.Event:Connect(fn), "Disconnect") -- connection (default cleanup is "Disconnect") j:Add(hoverHandle, "Stop") -- arbitrary object, calls :Stop() j:Add(part, "Destroy") -- instance j:Cleanup() -- run all cleanups; Janitor stays reusable j:Destroy() -- run all cleanups; Janitor no longer usable   The exported type is Janitor.Janitor. For a connection, "Disconnect" is Janitor's default for RBXScriptConnection, but this plan passes it explicitly for clarity.

Add a new subsection under the cross-cutting / shared-modules area (place it near the config/signals/packets material so it reads alongside the other project-wide conventions):  ### Cleanup / lifecycle (Janitor) Any scope that owns connections or instances (a per-character binding, a per-entity registration, a UI binding, a tool equip) MUST use **Janitor** (`ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Janitor`, Wally dep `howmanysmall/janitor`). Do **not** hand-roll `{ RBXScriptConnection }` arrays with manual disconnect loops. Pattern — one Janitor owns one lifecycle scope: ```lua local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Janitor) local janitor = Janitor.new() janitor:Add(inst.Event:Connect(fn), "Disconnect") janitor:Add(part, "Destroy") janitor:Cleanup() -- tear down, reuse (e.g. on respawn) janitor:Destroy() -- tear down, discard   Keyed collections store one Janitor per entry —{ [key]: { ..., cleaner: Janitor.Janitor } } — and unregister an entry withentry.cleaner:Destroy().  Exception: singleton top-level controller connections that live for the whole session (they never churn) do not need a Janitor.   (Adjust the surrounding heading level to match the document's existing structure.) - [ ] **Step 2: Commit the tracked doc** (Haiku) ```sh git add Documentations/Project-Maintenance-Guide.md git commit -m "docs(cleanup): document the Janitor lifecycle pattern"    Step 3: Add the local CLAUDE.md bullet (NOT committed)  CLAUDE.md is gitignored. Update it locally for future agent context but do not stage or commit it. In the "Cross-cutting modules" list, add a bullet:  - [Janitor](Packages/Janitor) (Wally `howmanysmall/janitor`) — the project's cleanup primitive. Any scope owning connections/instances uses a `Janitor`; **never hand-roll `{RBXScriptConnection}` arrays or manual disconnect loops**. One Janitor per lifecycle scope; keyed collections store one Janitor per entry. See the Janitor section in the Project-Maintenance-Guide. searchDocs.content: File	Changedocs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-02-sfx-pool-per-asset-design.md	already written — commit in Task 1 docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-02-sfx-pool-per-asset.md	this file — commit in Task 1 src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/SoundConfig.luau	add PoolInitial/PoolMax to SoundDef type and four high-freq entries src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/SoundManager/Pool.luau	replace shared Sound pool with per-asset sub-pools src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/SoundManager/SFX.luau	forward pool sizing from def; fix play ordering  Which sounds actually benefit: Only sounds played via SoundManager.PlaySFXAt go through the pool. GrabHookFire is the only high-frequency user of that path, so it is the only entry given explicit pool sizing. PlaySFXAt is also used by PlacementPlace, PlaceableMove, and PlaceableStash (low-frequency / currently empty IDs — default 1/5 is fine), and remote GrabHookLoop enters the pool on other clients via the replication receive (SFX.ConnectReplication → playPositional, default sizing). GrabHookCooldown and ProximityPickup use PlaySFX (2D, direct, no pool); local GrabHookLoop uses PlayLooped (direct). So GrabHookCooldown, ProximityPickup, and GrabHookLoop get no pool fields — they would be inert.

searchDocs.title: Task 3: Pool.luau — per-asset Sound sub-pools​
searchDocs.pageTitle: SFX Per-Asset Sound Pool Implementation Plan
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/SoundManager/Pool.luau (full rewrite) Step 1: Replace the file contents  Replace the entire file with:  --!strict -- Pooled instances for positional one-shot SFX. -- Sound instances are pooled per asset ID: SoundId never changes on acquire, -- so IsLoaded stays true and Play() fires without a reload delay. local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local InstancePool = require(SharedModules.GenericPoolInstance) local ObjectPool = require(SharedModules.GenericPoolObject) local Pool = {} local DEFAULT_INITIAL = 1 local DEFAULT_MAX = 5 local staticPartPool local soundSubPools: { [string]: ObjectPool.GenericPool } = {} local pitchPool local function ensure() if staticPartPool then return end local template = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StaticPart") assert(template:IsA("Part"), "StaticPart template is invalid") local poolLocation = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Pools") staticPartPool = InstancePool.new(template, 5, 20, 5, poolLocation) pitchPool = ObjectPool.new(Instance, { "PitchShiftSoundEffect" }, 0, 20, 5) end function Pool.Ensure() ensure() end local function getOrCreateSoundPool(assetId: string, initial: number?, max: number?): ObjectPool.GenericPool local sub = soundSubPools[assetId] if not sub then local mx = max or DEFAULT_MAX local init = math.min(initial or DEFAULT_INITIAL, mx) local expand = math.max(1, math.floor(mx / 10)) sub = ObjectPool.new(Instance, { "Sound" }, init, mx, expand, function(s: any) local snd: Sound = s :: Sound snd.SoundId = assetId end) soundSubPools[assetId] = sub end return sub end -- Acquire a part positioned at `position` with a Sound parented to it. -- The returned Sound already has SoundId = assetId and is likely already loaded. function Pool.Acquire(position: Vector3, assetId: string, initial: number?, max: number?): (Part, Sound) ensure() local sub = getOrCreateSoundPool(assetId, initial, max) local sound = sub:RetrieveObject() :: Sound if sound.SoundId ~= assetId then sound.SoundId = assetId end local part = staticPartPool:RetrieveObject(CFrame.new(position)) :: Part part.Parent = workspace sound.Parent = part return part, sound end function Pool.AcquirePitch(): PitchShiftSoundEffect ensure() return pitchPool:RetrieveObject() end -- Return a part + sound (+optional pitch effect) to their pools. function Pool.Release(part: Part, sound: Sound, pitch: PitchShiftSoundEffect?) ensure() if pitch then pitchPool:InsertObject(pitch) end task.defer(function() local sub = soundSubPools[sound.SoundId] if sub then sub:InsertObject(sound) end task.defer(function() staticPartPool:InsertObject(part) end) end) end return Pool   Notes on the expand formula: math.max(1, math.floor(mx / 10)) gives expand=1 for DEFAULT_MAX=5 and expand=1 for GrabHookFire's PoolMax=12 — both satisfy GenericPoolObject's requirement that expandSize ≤ maxSize. The insertFunction receives every Sound on initial allocation, pool expansion, and return, keeping SoundId correct in all cases. Part / pitch pools unchanged: staticPartPool keeps its current sizing (5 / 20 / 5) and pitchPool keeps (0 / 20 / 5) — matching the spec's "Part pool and PitchShiftSoundEffect pool remain unmodified." Only the shared Sound pool is replaced by per-asset sub-pools.   Step 2: Commit  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/SoundManager/Pool.luau git commit -m "feat(sound): per-asset Sound sub-pools to eliminate SoundId reload delay"

searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/SoundManager/SFX.luau:95-139 Step 1: Update playPositional — new signature, removed SoundId set, flipped load order  Current (SFX.luau:95-117):  -- Internal: pooled positional play (pitch via PitchShiftSoundEffect). local function playPositional(id: string, position: Vector3, volume: number, pitch: number) local part, sound = Pool.Acquire(position) sound.SoundId = id sound.Volume = volume sound.PlaybackSpeed = 1.0 sound.SoundGroup = Groups.Get("SFX") local pitchEffect: PitchShiftSoundEffect? = nil if pitch and pitch ~= 1.0 then local effect = Pool.AcquirePitch() effect.Octave = pitch effect.Parent = sound pitchEffect = effect end sound:Play() if not sound.IsLoaded then sound.Loaded:Wait() end task.delay(sound.TimeLength + 0.05, function() Pool.Release(part, sound, pitchEffect) end) end   Replace with:  -- Internal: pooled positional play (pitch via PitchShiftSoundEffect). local function playPositional(id: string, position: Vector3, volume: number, pitch: number, poolInitial: number?, poolMax: number?) local part, sound = Pool.Acquire(position, id, poolInitial, poolMax) sound.Volume = volume sound.PlaybackSpeed = 1.0 sound.SoundGroup = Groups.Get("SFX") local pitchEffect: PitchShiftSoundEffect? = nil if pitch and pitch ~= 1.0 then local effect = Pool.AcquirePitch() effect.Octave = pitch effect.Parent = sound pitchEffect = effect end if not sound.IsLoaded then sound.Loaded:Wait() end sound:Play() task.delay(sound.TimeLength + 0.05, function() Pool.Release(part, sound, pitchEffect) end) end   Changes from current:  Added poolInitial: number?, poolMax: number? trailing params Pool.Acquire(position, id, poolInitial, poolMax) — pool sets SoundId, so the explicit sound.SoundId = id line is removed sound.Loaded:Wait() moved to before sound:Play() — coroutine (already task.spawn'd) yields in background; plays immediately once ready Step 2: Update SFX.PlayAt — forward pool sizing from def  Current (SFX.luau:131):  	task.spawn(playPositional, def.Id, position, volume, pitch)   Replace with:  	task.spawn(playPositional, def.Id, position, volume, pitch, def.PoolInitial, def.PoolMax)   (Only this one line changes in SFX.PlayAt; the surrounding function body is unchanged.)
