searchDocs.title: Task 3: Add the track helper and route closeEntry through it (blocking-bug primitive)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau  Introduce the create→add→play helper and give it its first real use in closeEntry, where the close tween adopts the shared "sizeTween" index. This keeps the helper exercised before Task 4 wires the five entrance tweens.   Step 1: Define the track helper just below the module-scope locals  Place the helper near the top so it is in scope for every caller (resizeAll, closeEntry,show) — Luau local function is only visible to code that textually follows it, and resizeAllappears early in the file.  Find the module-scope locals block:  local initialized = false local player: Player local playerGui: Instance local managerJanitor: Janitor.Janitor local entries: { Entry } = {} local layoutCounter = 0 local pendingResize = false -- ── Settings helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────   Insert the helper between local pendingResize = false and the -- ── Settings helpers comment:  local initialized = false local player: Player local playerGui: Instance local managerJanitor: Janitor.Janitor local entries: { Entry } = {} local layoutCounter = 0 local pendingResize = false -- ── Tween helper ───────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Create → track in the janitor → play. MotionMaster's TweenObject:Play() -- returns nil, so the create/add/play steps must be separate (never -- `cleaner:Add(Create(...):Play(), ...)`). An optional janitor `index` lets a -- newer tween on the same property cancel/replace the prior one at that index. local function track(cleaner: Janitor.Janitor, tween, index: string?) cleaner:Add(tween, "Destroy", index) tween:Play() return tween end -- ── Settings helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────   (The managerJanitor: Janitor.Janitor annotation reflects Task 2's change — apply Task 2 first.)   Step 2: Convert closeEntry to use track with the "sizeTween" index  Replace the body of closeEntry:  local function closeEntry(entry: Entry) if closing[entry] then return end closing[entry] = true removeEntry(entry) local frame = entry.frame local closeTween = MotionMaster.Create(frame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }) -- Track the close tween so it stops if the entry cleaner is force-destroyed. entry.cleaner:Add(closeTween, "Destroy") closeTween:OnComplete(function() -- Leave closing[entry] = true permanently to block task.delay re-entry -- after the entry has been cleaned up. entry.cleaner:Destroy() end) closeTween:Play() end   with:  local function closeEntry(entry: Entry) if closing[entry] then return end closing[entry] = true removeEntry(entry) local frame = entry.frame -- Index "sizeTween": adopting the shared frame.Size slot cancels any in-flight -- intro/resize size tween so they don't fight the close-out shrink. local closeTween = track(entry.cleaner, MotionMaster.Create(frame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }), "sizeTween") closeTween:OnComplete(function() -- Leave closing[entry] = true permanently to block task.delay re-entry -- after the entry has been cleaned up. entry.cleaner:Destroy() end) end   Note: track already calls :Play(); attaching OnComplete immediately after is safe because completion fires at least one frame later (AnimDuration ≈ 0.33s).   Step 3: Verify type-check  Open the file with Luau LSP. Expected: no errors. track is now defined and used once.   Step 4: Commit  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau git commit -m "refactor(notifications): add track() helper; route closeEntry through it"

searchDocs.title: Task 4: Fix the blocking bug — route the five entrance tweens through track (🔴 blocking)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau  The five entrance animations currently call cleaner:Add(MotionMaster.Create(...):Play(), "Destroy"). Because :Play() returns nil, the first add throws and aborts show, leaking every notification. Route them all through track; give the frame-Size tween the "sizeTween" index and anOnComplete that clears entering.   Step 1: Replace the entrance-animation block  Find this block in show:  	-- Animations (#14): all via MotionMaster, tracked by the entry Janitor. cleaner:Add(MotionMaster.Create(textGradient, { Offset = Vector2.new(0, 0) }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.GradientSweepDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }):Play(), "Destroy") cleaner:Add(MotionMaster.Create(frame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sizeInfo.Width, sizeInfo.Height) }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }):Play(), "Destroy") cleaner:Add(MotionMaster.Create(icon, { ImageTransparency = 0 }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }):Play(), "Destroy") cleaner:Add(MotionMaster.Create(textLabel, { TextTransparency = 0 }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }):Play(), "Destroy") if timeFiller then cleaner:Add(MotionMaster.Create(timeFiller, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0) }, { Duration = notifTime, Model = "Linear", }):Play(), "Destroy") end   Replace it with:  	-- Animations (#14): all via MotionMaster, tracked by the entry Janitor. -- track() does create→add→play because TweenObject:Play() returns nil. track(cleaner, MotionMaster.Create(textGradient, { Offset = Vector2.new(0, 0) }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.GradientSweepDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, })) -- Intro size tween owns the shared "sizeTween" slot; its completion hands -- transparency control from the intro tweens to the Y-fade Heartbeat. local introSizeTween = track(cleaner, MotionMaster.Create(frame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sizeInfo.Width, sizeInfo.Height), }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }), "sizeTween") introSizeTween:OnComplete(function() entry.entering = false end) track(cleaner, MotionMaster.Create(icon, { ImageTransparency = 0 }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, })) track(cleaner, MotionMaster.Create(textLabel, { TextTransparency = 0 }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, })) if timeFiller then track(cleaner, MotionMaster.Create(timeFiller, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0) }, { Duration = notifTime, Model = "Linear", })) end   Note: the entry local is already declared above this block (the entry table literal withentering = true from Task 2), so entry.entering is in scope for the OnComplete closure.   Step 2: Verify type-check  Open the file with Luau LSP. Expected: no errors. introSizeTween is the value returned bytrack (the TweenObject), so :OnComplete is valid.   Step 3: Commit  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau git commit -m "fix(notifications): route entrance tweens through track(); fixes nil :Play() crash MotionMaster TweenObject:Play() returns nil, so cleaner:Add(Create(...):Play()) added nil and threw on the first entrance animation, aborting show() and leaking every notification. Create/add/play are now separate via track(). The intro size tween owns the shared sizeTween slot and clears entry.entering on completion."

searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau  While a toast is animating in, the Heartbeat must not overwrite the intro ImageTransparency /TextTransparency tweens. The toast sits at the bottom (t ≈ 0) during its intro, so skipping the Y-fade there is invisible.   Step 1: Early-return while entering  Find the top of updateEntryTransparency:  local function updateEntryTransparency(entry: Entry) local frame = entry.frame if not frame.Parent then return end   Replace it with:  local function updateEntryTransparency(entry: Entry) if entry.entering then return -- intro animation owns transparency until its size tween completes end local frame = entry.frame if not frame.Parent then return end    Step 2: Verify type-check  Open the file with Luau LSP. Expected: no errors.   Step 3: Commit  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau git commit -m "fix(notifications): Heartbeat Y-fade yields during intro animation"

searchDocs.title: Task 6: Track the resize size tween via the shared "sizeTween" index (🔵 nit)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau  resizeAll uses fire-and-forget MotionMaster.Play, which is untracked and can race the close tween. Route it through track with the "sizeTween" index so it is tracked and so a later close (or another resize) cancels it.   Step 1: Replace the resize tween call  Find this in resizeAll (inside the for _, entry in entries do loop):   MotionMaster.Play(frame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sizeInfo.Width, sizeInfo.Height) }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, })   Replace it with:   track(entry.cleaner, MotionMaster.Create(frame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sizeInfo.Width, sizeInfo.Height), }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }), "sizeTween")   Note: track was defined just below the module-scope locals in Task 3, so it is already in scope for resizeAll (which appears earlier in the file than closeEntry/show). No relocation needed.   Step 2: Verify type-check  Open the file with Luau LSP. Expected: no errors; track is in scope for resizeAll, closeEntry, and show. Confirm MotionMaster.Play( no longer appears in resizeAll:  git grep -n "MotionMaster.Play" -- src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau   Expected: no matches (all animation now goes through track + MotionMaster.Create).   Step 3: Commit  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau git commit -m "fix(notifications): track resize size tween via shared sizeTween index"

searchDocs.title: Task 7: Pass settings into ensureContainer (🔵 nit)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau  ensureContainer recomputes getScaled() only to read .Padding, but its sole caller showalready computed settings. Pass it through.   Step 1: Change the signature and use the parameter  Find the function signature and the layout-padding line in ensureContainer:  local function ensureContainer(): Frame   Change it to:  local function ensureContainer(settings): Frame   Then find, inside the same function:  	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, getScaled().Padding * 0.4)   Replace it with:  	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, settings.Padding * 0.4)    Step 2: Update the call site in show  Find in show:  	local container = ensureContainer()   Replace it with:  	local container = ensureContainer(settings)   settings is computed earlier in show (local settings = getScaled()), so it is in scope.   Step 3: Verify type-check  Open the file with Luau LSP. Expected: no errors. Confirm getScaled() no longer appears insideensureContainer:  git grep -n "getScaled" -- src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau   Expected: matches only in the getScaled definition, getScaled(). usages elsewhere, and theshow/resizeAll local settings = getScaled() lines — none inside ensureContainer.   Step 4: Commit  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau git commit -m "refactor(notifications): pass settings into ensureContainer; drop double getScaled"

searchDocs.title: Task 8: Rebind the ViewportSize listener when CurrentCamera changes (🟡 risk)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau  The Init-time ViewportSize connection binds the camera once; if CurrentCamera is replaced (respawn / camera swaps) resize silently stops. Add a bindCamera() that (re)connects under a janitor index and a CurrentCamera listener that rebinds.   Step 1: Define bindCamera in the resize section  Find the requestResize definition:  local function requestResize() if pendingResize then return end pendingResize = true task.defer(function() pendingResize = false resizeAll() end) end   Immediately after it, add:  -- Bind the ViewportSize listener to the current camera. Re-callable: the -- "cameraViewport" janitor index disconnects the previous camera's listener. local function bindCamera() local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera if not camera then return end managerJanitor:Add( camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(requestResize), "Disconnect", "cameraViewport" ) end   managerJanitor is a module-scope upvalue assigned in Init before bindCamera is ever called, so the closure resolves it correctly at call time.   Step 2: Replace the static connection in Init  Find in NotificationManager.Init:  	-- Debounced viewport resize (#10). managerJanitor:Add( Workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(requestResize), "Disconnect" )   Replace it with:  	-- Debounced viewport resize (#10), rebinding if CurrentCamera is replaced. managerJanitor:Add( Workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function() bindCamera() requestResize() end), "Disconnect" ) bindCamera()    Step 3: Verify type-check  Open the file with Luau LSP. Expected: no errors.   Step 4: Commit  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau git commit -m "fix(notifications): rebind ViewportSize listener on CurrentCamera change"

Remove it; breathing room comes from Padding. searchDocs.content: Files: none (verification only).  With Rojo synced and the game running in Studio, confirm the audit fixes hold. No commit.   Step 1: Entrance animation now plays (the blocking-bug fix)  In the command bar:  require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Signals).RequestNotification:Fire("Success", "Hello world", 3)   Expected: toast appears bottom-center, animates from size 0 up to full (previously it stayed invisible), icon + text fade in, gradient sweeps across the text, sound plays, time bar drains, auto-closes after 3s. Step 2: Concurrency cap  Fire 8 notifications in quick succession:  local S = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Signals) for i = 1, 8 do S.RequestNotification:Fire("Info", "Msg " .. i, 5) end   Expected: stack stays bounded at MaxConcurrent (5); oldest non-executed close early; no errors. Expected: toasts resize smoothly, no error spam, no visible size-tween fighting.   Step 4: executedFunction toast  require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Signals).RequestNotification:Fire( "Alert", "Working...", nil, function() task.wait(2) end )   Expected: toast stays ~2s until the function returns, then closes. No time bar.   Step 5: Clear all  Fire a few toasts, then:  require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Signals).RequestClearNotifications:Fire()   Expected: all close cleanly; no leaked frames under PlayerGui.NotificationGui.   Step 6: Respawn + height check  Reset the character (respawn) with toasts active, then fire another toast. Expected: resize still works after respawn (camera rebind), no duplicate NotificationGui. searchDocs.content: Spec coverage: 🔴 blocking → Task 4 (with the track primitive from Task 3); 🟡 stale camera → Task 8; 🟡 Heartbeat/intro → Tasks 2+4+5 (entering field, set, clear-on-complete, gate); 🔵 typed any → Task 2; 🔵 dead ScrollBarThickness → Task 1; 🔵 double getScaled → Task 7; 🔵 untracked resize tween → Task 6; ❓ lineHeight → Task 9. searchDocs.title: Task 4: Rewrite the module as NotificationManager​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Delete: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationHandler.luauCreate: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau  This is the core rewrite. It implements every audit fix: Init()-deferred LocalPlayer (#16), monotonic LayoutOrder (#2/#3), guarded name match (#4), real interpolated text size (#1), single shared dirty-checked Heartbeat with cached descendants (#6), optimized gradient sweep via Offset tween (#7, #8), os.clock() (#9), debounced resize (#10), font-metric line height (#11), MaxConcurrent cap (#12), SoundManager audio (#13), MotionMaster animation (#14), Janitor cleanup (#15), and the dead-code removals.   Step 1: Delete the old file  git rm src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationHandler.luau    Step 2: Create the new module  Create src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau:  --!strict -- NotificationManager: client toast notifications. -- Bootstrap with Init() once (see NotificationController.client). Trigger via -- Signals.RequestNotification / Signals.RequestClearNotifications. -- Audio -> SoundManager; animation -> MotionMaster; cleanup -> Janitor. local Players = game:GetService("Players") local TextService = game:GetService("TextService") local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService") local RunService = game:GetService("RunService") local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local NotificationConfig = require(SharedModules.Configs.NotificationConfig) local SoundManager = require(SharedModules.SoundManager) local MotionMaster = require(SharedModules.MotionMaster) local Signals = require(SharedModules.Signals) local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Janitor) local NotificationManager = {} type Entry = { frame: Frame, cleaner: any, -- Janitor.Janitor tagged: { Instance }, -- cached tagged descendants (transparency updates) baseTransparency: number, notifType: string, lastT: number, -- dirty-check cache for Y-fade transparency isExecuted: boolean, createdAt: number, -- os.clock() for oldest-first eviction } local initialized = false local player: Player local playerGui: Instance local managerJanitor: any local entries: { Entry } = {} local layoutCounter = 0 local pendingResize = false -- ── Settings helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────── local function getDevice() local isMobile = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled return isMobile and NotificationConfig.Device.Mobile or NotificationConfig.Device.Desktop end local function getScaled() local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera local viewport = camera.ViewportSize local fontScale = math.clamp(math.min(viewport.X, viewport.Y) / NotificationConfig.BaseScreenMin, 0.7, 1.3) local base = getDevice() return { MinTextSize = base.MinTextSize, MaxTextSize = base.MaxTextSize, ImageSize = base.ImageSize * fontScale, Padding = base.Padding * fontScale, WidthPercentage = base.WidthPercentage, MaxWidth = base.MaxWidth, Duration = base.Duration, CornerRadius = base.CornerRadius * fontScale, CanvasWidth = base.CanvasWidth * fontScale, FontScale = fontScale, } end -- ── Sizing (audit #1 real interpolated size, #11 font-metric line height) ── local function calcSize(settings, message: string) local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera local screenWidth = camera.ViewportSize.X local fixedWidth = math.min(screenWidth * settings.WidthPercentage, settings.MaxWidth) local textAvailWidth = fixedWidth - (settings.ImageSize + settings.CanvasWidth + settings.Padding * 3) local scaledMin = settings.MinTextSize * settings.FontScale local scaledMax = settings.MaxTextSize * settings.FontScale -- #1: interpolate toward max based on how much shorter than the line the -- message is; long messages stay near min, short messages grow toward max. local probe = TextService:GetTextSize(message, scaledMin, NotificationConfig.Font, Vector2.new(math.huge, math.huge)) local fitRatio = textAvailWidth > 0 and math.clamp(textAvailWidth / math.max(probe.X, 1), 0, 1) or 0 local textSize = math.round(math.clamp(scaledMin + (scaledMax - scaledMin) * fitRatio, scaledMin, scaledMax)) local bounds = TextService:GetTextSize(message, textSize, NotificationConfig.Font, Vector2.new(textAvailWidth, math.huge)) -- #11: line height from font size, not a throwaway GetTextSize("") call. local lineHeight = textSize local totalTextHeight = bounds.Y + lineHeight return { Width = fixedWidth, Height = math.ceil(math.max(totalTextHeight + settings.Padding, settings.ImageSize + settings.Padding)), TextSize = textSize, } end -- ── Y-position transparency (audit #6 dirty-checked + cached descendants) ── local function updateEntryTransparency(entry: Entry) local frame = entry.frame if not frame.Parent then return end local viewportHeight = Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y local startY = viewportHeight * NotificationConfig.FadeStartY local endY = viewportHeight * NotificationConfig.FadeEndY local frameBottomY = frame.AbsolutePosition.Y + frame.AbsoluteSize.Y local t = frameBottomY > startY and 0 or math.clamp((startY - frameBottomY) / (startY - endY), 0, 1) if math.abs(t - entry.lastT) < 1e-3 then return -- dirty-check: unchanged this frame end entry.lastT = t local base = entry.baseTransparency frame.BackgroundTransparency = base + t * (1 - base) for _, child in entry.tagged do if child:IsA("ImageLabel") then child.ImageTransparency = t elseif child:IsA("TextLabel") then child.TextTransparency = t elseif child:IsA("Frame") then child.BackgroundTransparency = t end end end -- ── Container ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── local function ensureContainer(): Frame local existing = playerGui:FindFirstChild("NotificationGui") if existing then local c = existing:FindFirstChild("MainContainer") if c and c:IsA("Frame") then return c end end local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui") screenGui.Name = "NotificationGui" screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false screenGui.Parent = playerGui managerJanitor:Add(screenGui, "Destroy") local container = Instance.new("Frame") container.Name = "MainContainer" container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1) container.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.97) container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) container.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y container.BackgroundTransparency = 1 container.Parent = screenGui local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout") layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, getScaled().Padding * 0.4) layout.Parent = container return container end -- ── Resize (audit #10 debounced) ───────────────────────────────── local function resizeAll() local existing = playerGui:FindFirstChild("NotificationGui") local container = existing and existing:FindFirstChild("MainContainer") if not container then return end local settings = getScaled() local layout = container:FindFirstChild("UIListLayout") if layout and layout:IsA("UIListLayout") then layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, settings.Padding * 0.4) end for _, entry in entries do local frame = entry.frame local textLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("MessageLabel") local message = (textLabel and textLabel:IsA("TextLabel")) and textLabel.Text or "" local sizeInfo = calcSize(settings, message) local corner = frame:FindFirstChild("UICorner") if corner and corner:IsA("UICorner") then corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, settings.CornerRadius) end local padding = frame:FindFirstChild("UIPadding") if padding and padding:IsA("UIPadding") then padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, settings.Padding) padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, settings.Padding) padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, settings.Padding * 0.5) padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, settings.Padding * 0.5) end local icon = frame:FindFirstChild("IconLabel") if icon and icon:IsA("ImageLabel") then icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(settings.ImageSize, settings.ImageSize) end local timeC = frame:FindFirstChild("TimeLeftContainer") if timeC and timeC:IsA("Frame") then timeC.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(settings.CanvasWidth, settings.ImageSize) end if textLabel and textLabel:IsA("TextLabel") then textLabel.TextSize = sizeInfo.TextSize textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(settings.ImageSize + settings.CanvasWidth + settings.Padding * 3), 1, 0) end MotionMaster.Play(frame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sizeInfo.Width, sizeInfo.Height) }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }) end end local function requestResize() if pendingResize then return end pendingResize = true task.defer(function() pendingResize = false resizeAll() end) end -- ── Close / clear (audit #15 per-entry Janitor) ────────────────── local function removeEntry(entry: Entry) local idx = table.find(entries, entry) if idx then table.remove(entries, idx) end end local function closeEntry(entry: Entry) if entry.cleaner:Get("closing") then return -- already closing end entry.cleaner:Add(true, nil, "closing") -- mark removeEntry(entry) local frame = entry.frame MotionMaster.Play(frame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }).OnComplete(function() entry.cleaner:Destroy() -- destroys frame + tweens + timers end) end -- ── Show ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── local function buildFrame(notifType: string, isExecuted: boolean, settings): Frame local frame = Instance.new("Frame") frame.BackgroundColor3 = NotificationConfig.Colors[notifType] frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5) frame.BackgroundTransparency = NotificationConfig.BaseTransparency[notifType] frame.ClipsDescendants = true frame.Name = notifType:sub(1, 1):upper() .. notifType:sub(2) .. "_Notification" -- #2/#3: monotonic counter; executed notifications get a high reserved band. layoutCounter += 1 frame.LayoutOrder = isExecuted and (1_000_000_000 + layoutCounter) or layoutCounter local corner = Instance.new("UICorner") corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, settings.CornerRadius) corner.Parent = frame local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout") layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder layout.Wraps = true layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, settings.Padding * 0.6) layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center layout.Parent = frame local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding") padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, settings.Padding) padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, settings.Padding) padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, settings.Padding * 0.5) padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, settings.Padding * 0.5) padding.Parent = frame return frame end local function show(notifType: string, message: string, duration: number?, executedFunction: (() -> ())?) -- Validation. if type(notifType) ~= "string" or type(message) ~= "string" then return end if duration ~= nil and type(duration) ~= "number" then return end if executedFunction ~= nil and type(executedFunction) ~= "function" then return end notifType = notifType:lower() if not table.find(NotificationConfig.Types, notifType) then return end local isExecuted = executedFunction ~= nil local settings = getScaled() local container = ensureContainer() local sizeInfo = calcSize(settings, message) -- #12: enforce concurrency cap by closing the oldest non-executed entry. while #entries >= NotificationConfig.MaxConcurrent do local oldest: Entry? = nil for _, e in entries do if not e.isExecuted and (oldest == nil or e.createdAt < oldest.createdAt) then oldest = e end end if oldest then closeEntry(oldest) else break -- all remaining are executed; don't force-close those end end local frame = buildFrame(notifType, isExecuted, settings) local cleaner = Janitor.new() cleaner:Add(frame, "Destroy") local tagged: { Instance } = {} -- Icon. local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel") icon.Image = NotificationConfig.ImageIds[notifType] icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(settings.ImageSize, settings.ImageSize) icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1 icon.ImageTransparency = 1 icon.LayoutOrder = 0 icon.Name = "IconLabel" icon.Parent = frame table.insert(tagged, icon) -- Time-left bar (only for timed notifications). local timeFiller: Frame? = nil if not isExecuted then local timeContainer = Instance.new("Frame") timeContainer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(settings.CanvasWidth, settings.ImageSize) timeContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(175, 175, 175) timeContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0 timeContainer.LayoutOrder = 1 timeContainer.Name = "TimeLeftContainer" table.insert(tagged, timeContainer) local filler = Instance.new("Frame") filler.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1) filler.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) filler.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1) filler.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) filler.BorderSizePixel = 0 filler.Name = "TimeLeftFiller" filler.Parent = timeContainer table.insert(tagged, filler) timeContainer.Parent = frame timeFiller = filler end -- Text. local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel") textLabel.Text = message textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(settings.ImageSize + settings.CanvasWidth + settings.Padding * 3), 1, 0) textLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5) textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1 textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) textLabel.Font = NotificationConfig.Font textLabel.TextSize = sizeInfo.TextSize textLabel.TextTransparency = 1 textLabel.TextWrapped = true textLabel.LayoutOrder = isExecuted and 1 or 2 textLabel.Name = "MessageLabel" textLabel.Parent = frame table.insert(tagged, textLabel) -- #7/#8: static gradient ramp + single Offset sweep (no per-frame rebuild). local textGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient") textGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0), }) textGradient.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0) textGradient.Parent = textLabel frame.Parent = container local entry: Entry = { frame = frame, cleaner = cleaner, tagged = tagged, baseTransparency = NotificationConfig.BaseTransparency[notifType], notifType = notifType, lastT = -1, -- force first update isExecuted = isExecuted, createdAt = os.clock(), } table.insert(entries, entry) -- Audio (#13). SoundManager.PlaySFX(NotificationConfig.SfxNames[notifType]) local notifTime = duration or settings.Duration -- Animations (#14): all via MotionMaster, tracked by the entry Janitor. cleaner:Add(MotionMaster.Create(textGradient, { Offset = Vector2.new(0, 0) }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.GradientSweepDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }):Play(), "Destroy") cleaner:Add(MotionMaster.Create(frame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sizeInfo.Width, sizeInfo.Height) }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }):Play(), "Destroy") cleaner:Add(MotionMaster.Create(icon, { ImageTransparency = 0 }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }):Play(), "Destroy") cleaner:Add(MotionMaster.Create(textLabel, { TextTransparency = 0 }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }):Play(), "Destroy") if timeFiller then cleaner:Add(MotionMaster.Create(timeFiller, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0) }, { Duration = notifTime, Model = "Linear", }):Play(), "Destroy") end -- Close scheduling. if isExecuted and executedFunction then local timeout = NotificationConfig.ExecutedFunctionTimeout local done = false task.spawn(function() pcall(executedFunction) done = true closeEntry(entry) end) if timeout then task.delay(timeout, function() if not done then closeEntry(entry) end end) end else task.delay(notifTime, function() closeEntry(entry) end) end end local function clearAll() -- Iterate a copy: closeEntry mutates `entries`. for _, entry in table.clone(entries) do closeEntry(entry) end end -- ── Public ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── function NotificationManager.Init() if initialized then return end initialized = true player = Players.LocalPlayer playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") managerJanitor = Janitor.new() -- Single shared transparency Heartbeat (#6). managerJanitor:Add(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() for _, entry in entries do updateEntryTransparency(entry) end end), "Disconnect") -- Debounced viewport resize (#10). managerJanitor:Add( Workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(requestResize), "Disconnect" ) -- Signal triggers (sole entry points). managerJanitor:Add(Signals.RequestNotification:Connect(show), "Disconnect") managerJanitor:Add(Signals.RequestClearNotifications:Connect(clearAll), "Disconnect") end return NotificationManager    Step 3: Verify type-check  Open the new file with Luau LSP. Expected: no errors. Pay attention to:  Janitor :Get/:Add(value, methodName, index) usage in closeEntry — confirm against Packages/Janitor API; the "closing" marker uses cleaner:Add(true, nil, "closing") then cleaner:Get("closing").MotionMaster.Create(...):Play() returns the TweenObject (chainable) so it can be added to the Janitor with "Destroy".  If the Janitor marker API differs, replace the marker with a plain boolean field on the Entry type (closing: boolean) set/checked directly — adjust Entry, closeEntry, and show accordingly.   Step 4: Verify in Studio  With Rojo synced, fire a test notification from the command bar:  require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Signals).RequestNotification:Fire("Success", "Hello world", 3)   Expected: a toast appears bottom-center, sound plays, text sweeps in, time bar drains, auto-closes after 3s.   Step 5: Commit  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau git commit -m "refactor(notifications): rewrite NotificationHandler as NotificationManager Routes audio through SoundManager, animation through MotionMaster, cleanup through Janitor; signal-triggered; single dirty-checked Heartbeat; fixes text-size clamp, LayoutOrder collisions, gradient rebuild leak, resize debounce, and adds a concurrency cap."

searchDocs.title: Task 1: Remove the position-based Y-fade machinery​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luauModify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/NotificationConfig.luau  The Y-fade was a "fade as it scrolls off the bottom" effect; it breaks at the top and is no longer wanted. Remove updateEntryTransparency, the shared Heartbeat, the RunService import, theentering/tagged/lastT/baseTransparency Entry fields and their uses, and theFadeStartY/FadeEndY config. The intro grow + icon/text fade-in + gradient sweep are independent and stay.   Step 1: Slim the Entry type  Replace:  type Entry = { frame: Frame, cleaner: Janitor.Janitor, tagged: { Instance }, -- cached tagged descendants (transparency updates) baseTransparency: number, notifType: string, lastT: number, -- dirty-check cache for Y-fade transparency isExecuted: boolean, createdAt: number, -- os.clock() for oldest-first eviction entering: boolean, -- true during the intro animation; Y-fade Heartbeat yields }   with:  type Entry = { frame: Frame, cleaner: Janitor.Janitor, notifType: string, isExecuted: boolean, createdAt: number, -- os.clock() for oldest-first eviction }    Step 2: Remove the now-unused RunService import  Replace:  local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService") local RunService = game:GetService("RunService") local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")   with:  local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService") local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")    Step 3: Delete the updateEntryTransparency function and its section header  Remove this whole block:  -- ── Y-position transparency (audit #6 dirty-checked + cached descendants) ── local function updateEntryTransparency(entry: Entry) if entry.entering then return -- intro animation owns transparency until its size tween completes end local frame = entry.frame if not frame.Parent then return end local viewportHeight = Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y local startY = viewportHeight * NotificationConfig.FadeStartY local endY = viewportHeight * NotificationConfig.FadeEndY local frameBottomY = frame.AbsolutePosition.Y + frame.AbsoluteSize.Y local t = frameBottomY > startY and 0 or math.clamp((startY - frameBottomY) / (startY - endY), 0, 1) if math.abs(t - entry.lastT) < 1e-3 then return -- dirty-check: unchanged this frame end entry.lastT = t local base = entry.baseTransparency frame.BackgroundTransparency = base + t * (1 - base) for _, child in entry.tagged do if child:IsA("ImageLabel") then child.ImageTransparency = t elseif child:IsA("TextLabel") then child.TextTransparency = t elseif child:IsA("Frame") then child.BackgroundTransparency = t end end end   (Leave the -- ── Container ── section header that follows it intact.)   Step 4: Remove the tagged local and its four inserts in show  Delete the declaration line:  	local tagged: { Instance } = {}   Delete the icon insert — change:  	icon.Name = "IconLabel" icon.Parent = frame table.insert(tagged, icon)   to:  	icon.Name = "IconLabel" icon.Parent = frame   Delete the time-container insert — change:   timeContainer.Name = "TimeLeftContainer" table.insert(tagged, timeContainer)   to:   timeContainer.Name = "TimeLeftContainer"   Delete the filler insert — change:   table.insert(tagged, filler) timeContainer.Parent = frame   to:   timeContainer.Parent = frame   Delete the text-label insert — change:  	textLabel.Parent = frame table.insert(tagged, textLabel)   to:  	textLabel.Parent = frame    Step 5: Slim the entry constructor in show  Replace:  	local entry: Entry = { frame = frame, cleaner = cleaner, tagged = tagged, baseTransparency = NotificationConfig.BaseTransparency[notifType], notifType = notifType, lastT = -1, -- force first update isExecuted = isExecuted, createdAt = os.clock(), entering = true, -- cleared when the intro size tween completes }   with:  	local entry: Entry = { frame = frame, cleaner = cleaner, notifType = notifType, isExecuted = isExecuted, createdAt = os.clock(), }    Step 6: Drop the entering-clearing OnComplete on the intro size tween  Replace:  	-- Intro size tween owns the shared "sizeTween" slot; its completion hands -- transparency control from the intro tweens to the Y-fade Heartbeat. local introSizeTween = track(cleaner, MotionMaster.Create(frame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sizeInfo.Width, sizeInfo.Height), }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }), "sizeTween") introSizeTween:OnComplete(function() entry.entering = false end)   with:  	-- Intro size tween owns the shared "sizeTween" slot so resize/close size -- tweens cancel it. track(cleaner, MotionMaster.Create(frame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sizeInfo.Width, sizeInfo.Height), }, { Duration = NotificationConfig.AnimDuration, Model = NotificationConfig.AnimEasing, }), "sizeTween")    Step 7: Remove the shared Heartbeat in Init  Replace:  	managerJanitor = Janitor.new() -- Single shared transparency Heartbeat (#6). managerJanitor:Add(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() for _, entry in entries do updateEntryTransparency(entry) end end), "Disconnect") -- Debounced viewport resize (#10), rebinding if CurrentCamera is replaced.   with:  	managerJanitor = Janitor.new() -- Debounced viewport resize (#10), rebinding if CurrentCamera is replaced.    Step 8: Remove FadeStartY / FadeEndY from the config  In NotificationConfig.luau, remove:  -- Y-position fade band (fraction of viewport height, measured from top). NotificationConfig.FadeStartY = 0.5 -- above this Y, notifications are fully faded NotificationConfig.FadeEndY = 0.3    Step 9: Verify type-check  Open both files with Luau LSP. Expected: no errors, no references to updateEntryTransparency,RunService, tagged, entering, lastT, baseTransparency, FadeStartY, or FadeEndY. Confirm with:  git grep -n -E "updateEntryTransparency|RunService|\.tagged|\.entering|\.lastT|baseTransparency|FadeStartY|FadeEndY" -- src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/NotificationConfig.luau   Expected: no matches.   Step 10: Commit  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau \ src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/NotificationConfig.luau git commit -m "refactor(notifications): remove bottom-stack Y-fade machinery"

container.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y container.BackgroundTransparency = 1 container.Parent = screenGui local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout") layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, settings.Padding * 0.4) layout.Parent = container   with:  	local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui") screenGui.Name = "NotificationGui" screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = false screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false screenGui.Parent = playerGui managerJanitor:Add(screenGui, "Destroy") local container = Instance.new("Frame") container.Name = "MainContainer" container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0) container.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, NotificationConfig.TopOffsetScale) container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) container.AutomaticSize layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, settings.Padding * 0.4) layout.Parent = container    Step 3: Invert LayoutOrder so the newest toast sorts to the top  In buildFrame, replace:  	-- #2/#3: monotonic counter; executed notifications get a high reserved band. layoutCounter += 1 frame.LayoutOrder = isExecuted and (1_000_000_000 + layoutCounter) or layoutCounter   with:  	-- #2/#3: monotonic counter, negated so the newest toast sorts first (top). -- Executed toasts keep a reserved band so they sit above timed toasts. layoutCounter += 1 frame.LayoutOrder = isExecuted and -(1_000_000_000 + layoutCounter) or -layoutCounter    Step 4: Verify type-check  Open both files with Luau LSP. Expected: no errors; NotificationConfig.TopOffsetScale resolves.   Step 5: Commit  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/NotificationConfig.luau \ src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau git commit -m "feat(notifications): top-anchor the toast stack, newest on top"

searchDocs.title: Task 3: Fixed font size + exact text-area width​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/NotificationConfig.luauModify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/NotificationManager/init.luau  Replace the dynamic font growth with one fixed size, and compute the text width by subtracting every horizontal contributor (frame UIPadding, icon, time-bar, layout gaps) so the measured wrap width equals the label's rendered width — eliminating the clip.   Step 1: Swap Min/MaxTextSize for a single TextSize in both device tables  In NotificationConfig.luau, replace the Mobile table:  	Mobile = { MinTextSize = 14, MaxTextSize = 24, ImageSize = 26, Padding = 10, WidthPercentage = 0.3, MaxWidth = 250, Duration = 4, CornerRadius = 8, CanvasWidth = 3, },   with:  	Mobile = { TextSize = 16, ImageSize = 26, Padding = 10, WidthPercentage = 0.3, MaxWidth = 250, Duration = 4, CornerRadius = 8, CanvasWidth = 3, },   Replace the Desktop table:  	Desktop = { MinTextSize = 24, MaxTextSize = 34, ImageSize = 36, Padding = 16, WidthPercentage = 0.3, MaxWidth = 500, Duration = 3, CornerRadius = 12, CanvasWidth = 5, },   with:  	Desktop = { TextSize = 22, ImageSize = 36, Padding = 16, WidthPercentage = 0.3, MaxWidth = 500, Duration = 3, CornerRadius = 12, CanvasWidth = 5, },    Step 2: Return a scaled TextSize from getScaled (drop Min/Max/FontScale)  In init.luau, replace:  	return { MinTextSize = base.MinTextSize, MaxTextSize = base.MaxTextSize, ImageSize = base.ImageSize * fontScale, Padding = base.Padding * fontScale, WidthPercentage = base.WidthPercentage, MaxWidth = base.MaxWidth, Duration = base.Duration, CornerRadius = base.CornerRadius * fontScale, CanvasWidth = base.CanvasWidth * fontScale, FontScale = fontScale, }   with:  	return { TextSize = base.TextSize * fontScale, ImageSize = base.ImageSize * fontScale, Padding = base.Padding * fontScale, WidthPercentage = base.WidthPercentage, MaxWidth = base.MaxWidth, Duration = base.Duration, CornerRadius = base.CornerRadius * fontScale, CanvasWidth = base.CanvasWidth * fontScale, }    Step 3: Rewrite calcSize for fixed font + exact width  Replace the entire calcSize function and its section header:  -- ── Sizing (audit #1 real interpolated size, #11 font-metric line height) ── local function calcSize(settings, message: string) local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera local screenWidth = camera.ViewportSize.X local fixedWidth = math.min(screenWidth * settings.WidthPercentage, settings.MaxWidth) local textAvailWidth = fixedWidth - (settings.ImageSize + settings.CanvasWidth + settings.Padding * 3) local scaledMin = settings.MinTextSize * settings.FontScale local scaledMax = settings.MaxTextSize * settings.FontScale -- #1: interpolate toward max based on how much shorter than the line the -- message is; long messages stay near min, short messages grow toward max. local probe = TextService:GetTextSize(message, scaledMin, NotificationConfig.Font, Vector2.new(math.huge, math.huge)) local fitRatio = textAvailWidth > 0 and math.clamp(textAvailWidth / math.max(probe.X, 1), 0, 1) or 0 local textSize = math.round(math.clamp(scaledMin + (scaledMax - scaledMin) * fitRatio, scaledMin, scaledMax)) local bounds = TextService:GetTextSize(message, textSize, NotificationConfig.Font, Vector2.new(textAvailWidth, math.huge)) -- bounds.Y already includes the full wrapped height; Padding provides breathing room. local totalTextHeight = bounds.Y return { Width = fixedWidth, Height = math.ceil(math.max(totalTextHeight + settings.Padding, settings.ImageSize + settings.Padding)), TextSize = textSize, } end   with:  -- ── Sizing (fixed font; measured text width == rendered width) ── local function calcSize(settings, message: string, isExecuted: boolean) local screenWidth = Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X local frameWidth = math.min(screenWidth * settings.WidthPercentage, settings.MaxWidth) -- Exact text area: subtract the frame UIPadding (both sides), the icon, the -- time bar (timed toasts only), and the UIListLayout gaps between items, so -- the wrap width we measure equals the width the label is actually given. local horizPadding = settings.Padding * 2 local gap = settings.Padding * 0.6 local reserved = settings.ImageSize + gap if not isExecuted then reserved += settings.CanvasWidth + gap end local textWidth = math.max(frameWidth - horizPadding - reserved, 1) local textSize = settings.TextSize local bounds = TextService:GetTextSize(message, textSize, NotificationConfig.Font, Vector2.new(textWidth, math.huge)) local height = math.ceil(math.max(bounds.Y, settings.ImageSize) + settings.Padding) return { Width = frameWidth, Height = height, TextSize = textSize, TextWidth = textWidth, } end    Step 4: Stop the frame's UIListLayout from wrapping items onto new rows  In searchDocs.title: Task 0: Provision the public docs repo + deploy key​
searchDocs.content: Step 1: Create the public docs repo  Create a new public repo Game-Dev-Neohermit/endless-journey-docs on GitHub (empty, no README needed). If a different name is chosen, update baseUrl/url in Task 2 and the external_repository in Task 24 to match.   Step 2: Generate an SSH deploy key  Run locally:  ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "endless-journey-docs-deploy" -f ./docs_deploy_key -N ""   This produces docs_deploy_key (private) and docs_deploy_key.pub (public). Do NOT commit these.   Step 3: Register the keys In endless-journey-docs → Settings → Deploy keys → Add deploy key → paste docs_deploy_key.pub, check "Allow write access". In Endless-Journey (private) → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret → name DOCS_DEPLOY_KEY, value = full contents of docs_deploy_key (private). Step 4: Enable Pages on the docs repo  In endless-journey-docs → Settings → Pages → Source = "Deploy from a branch", Branch = gh-pages / (root). searchDocs.title: Phase 3 — API annotation (hybrid set)​
searchDocs.content: Annotation format (moonwave): a --[=[ ... ]=] block with @class Name above the module table, @within Name blocks above each documented function with@param name type -- desc and @return type -- desc, optional @tag, and a realm tag @server or @client for realm-specific modules. Example: --[=[ @class SoundManager @client Single entry point for all client audio (SFX, BGM, ambience). ]=] local SoundManager = {} --[=[ Plays a 2D sound effect by name. @within SoundManager @param name string -- The SFX name from SoundConfig @param opts table? -- Optional overrides (volume, pitch) @tag audio ]=] function SoundManager.PlaySFX(name, opts) end For each module: add the @class block, then annotate its public functions (skip locals). After each task, run moonwave build and confirm the new class appears under the API sidebar with its functions. Annotations must not change runtime behavior — comments only.

searchDocs.title: Conventions for this plan (read before starting)​
searchDocs.content: No automated test suite; project prefs are skip Selene, skip rojo build, no auto-playtest. Each task ends with a manual Studio verification (sync via rojo serve, observe the result) then a commit. Commits use the Haiku model per project git preference.Every module keeps its existing header pragmas (--!strict, plus --!native on WeaponValidation) and --[=[ @class … ]=] doc-comment.This plan edits the files shipped in Plan 1 (feat/weapon-system). It does not add new files. ReqMeleeSwing stays payload-less; the server never trusts client aim or a client-sent combo index.Breaking change: MeleeWeaponConfig.SwingCooldown is removed; a single-swing weapon becomes a one-step combo.

searchDocs.content: Modify src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/WeaponTypes.luau -- combo types; rework MeleeWeaponConfig Modify src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/WeaponConfig.luau -- migrate ClassicSword to a 4-hit combo Modify src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/WeaponValidation.luau -- + resolveComboSwing, resolveStep Modify src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Signals/init.luau -- + WeaponComboChanged Modify src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/WeaponState.luau -- + per-weapon combo record + accessors Modify src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/MeleeHandler.luau -- buffered combo client Modify src/ServerScriptService/WeaponServer.server.luau -- combo authority

searchDocs.title: Task 1: Combo types in WeaponTypes​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/WeaponTypes.luau Step 1: Replace the file contents  --!strict --[=[ @class WeaponTypes Shared type definitions for the weapon system. Runtime value is an empty table; consumers use the exported types. Melee weapons are combo-driven: a `MeleeWeaponConfig` carries weapon-level defaults plus a `Combos` map keyed by input (`Primary` = LC; `Secondary` reserved for future RC). Later plans extend the union with Gun/Throwable/Placed variants. ]=] export type WeaponCategory = "Melee" | "Gun" | "Throwable" | "Placed" export type FireMode = "Hitscan" | "Projectile" export type DamageType = "Melee" | "Bullet" | "AOE" export type InputKind = "Primary" | "Secondary" export type BaseWeaponConfig = { Category: WeaponCategory, DisplayName: string, ToolName: string, Damage: number, -- melee: default per-hit damage (a step's Damage overrides it) DamageType: DamageType, HeadshotMultiplier: number?, } -- One hit in a combo. Only the two timing fields are required; the rest are -- optional overrides of the weapon-level defaults ("fill only what differs"). export type ComboStep = { Recovery: number, -- min seconds before the NEXT hit may execute (paces swing + server anti-exploit gate) ChainWindow: number, -- seconds after this hit to keep the combo alive; past it the next swing restarts at 1. -- INVARIANT: ChainWindow >= Recovery (non-final steps). Ignored on the final step. Damage: number?, Range: number?, HitboxSize: Vector3?, AnimId: string?, SwingSound: string?, ImpactSound: string?, } export type ComboDef = { Steps: { ComboStep }, -- ordered; combo length = #Steps ResetCooldown: number?, -- brief lockout after the finisher before restarting at hit 1 (default 0) } -- Effective per-hit values after applying weapon-default fallbacks. export type ResolvedStep = { Damage: number, Range: number, HitboxSize: Vector3, SwingSound: string, ImpactSound: string, AnimId: string?, } -- Authoritative + predicted combo progress. index 0 = no active combo. export type ComboState = { index: number, lastHitTime: number, } export type MeleeWeaponConfig = BaseWeaponConfig & { Category: "Melee", -- Weapon-level DEFAULTS, used by any step that omits its own value: Range: number, -- forward reach in studs (also hitbox depth) HitboxSize: Vector3, -- X = width, Y = height (Z ignored; depth comes from Range) SwingSound: string, -- SoundConfig.Sfx key ImpactSound: string, -- SoundConfig.Sfx key SwingAnimId: string?, -- optional rbxassetid for a swing AnimationTrack -- Combo strings keyed by input. Only Primary (LC) is read this iteration. Combos: { [InputKind]: ComboDef }, } -- Union expands in later plans (| GunWeaponConfig | ThrowableWeaponConfig | PlacedWeaponConfig). export type WeaponConfig = MeleeWeaponConfig return {}    Step 2: Verify (Studio)  Sync. Expected: no analyzer errors on the new types. (Callers update in later tasks; a transient "missing SwingCooldown" / "missing Combos" error on WeaponConfig.luau is expected until Task 2 — do Tasks 1 and 2 back-to-back if the analyzer noise is distracting.)   Step 3: Commit  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/WeaponTypes.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add combo types to WeaponTypes (ComboStep/ComboDef/ComboState)"

Expected: the analyzer accepts the literal against { [string]: Types.WeaponConfig } with no SwingCooldown/Combos errors. searchDocs.title: Task 3: Combo validator + step resolver​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/WeaponValidation.luau Step 1: Require WeaponTypes  At the top of the module, after the --[=[ … ]=] doc-comment and before local WeaponValidation = {}, add:  local Types = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes"))    Step 2: Append the two functions  Just before the final return WeaponValidation, add:  -- Decide which step THIS swing executes, and whether it's allowed right now. -- Pure; called by BOTH client (prediction, tolerance 0) and server (authority, -- small tolerance). `accepted == false` means "not yet" — the client buffers the -- click and the server drops the request. Advancement is independent of whether -- the swing hits anything. function WeaponValidation.resolveComboSwing( state: Types.ComboState, combo: Types.ComboDef, now: number, tolerance: number ): (number?, boolean) local steps = combo.Steps local count = #steps local idx = state.index local elapsed = now - state.lastHitTime if idx >= 1 and idx <= count then if idx >= count then -- Finished the full combo: restart at 1 once ResetCooldown elapses. if elapsed < ((combo.ResetCooldown or 0) - tolerance) then return nil, false end return 1, true end local step = steps[idx] if elapsed < (step.Recovery - tolerance) then return nil, false -- still in this hit's recovery end if elapsed > step.ChainWindow then return 1, true -- chain expired → fresh combo end return idx + 1, true -- continue the chain end return 1, true -- no active combo → start at hit 1 end -- Resolve a step's effective values, falling back to weapon-level defaults for -- any field the step omits. function WeaponValidation.resolveStep(config: Types.MeleeWeaponConfig, step: Types.ComboStep): Types.ResolvedStep return { Damage = step.Damage or config.Damage, Range = step.Range or config.Range, HitboxSize = step.HitboxSize or config.HitboxSize, SwingSound = step.SwingSound or config.SwingSound, ImpactSound = step.ImpactSound or config.ImpactSound, AnimId = step.AnimId or config.SwingAnimId, } end    Step 3: Verify (Studio)  Sync. Expected: no analyzer errors; resolveComboSwing and resolveStep resolve on require(WeaponValidation).   Step 4: Commit  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/WeaponValidation.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add resolveComboSwing + resolveStep shared combo logic"

searchDocs.title: Task 5: Combo state in WeaponState​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/WeaponState.luau Step 1: Extend the record type  Replace the Record type and the ensure helper so each player gets a combo map:  type Record = { lastFire: { [string]: number }, -- weaponName -> os.clock() of last swing/shot (retained for later gun plans) combo: { [string]: { index: number, lastHitTime: number } }, -- weaponName -> authoritative combo progress } local states: { [Player]: Record } = {} local WeaponState = {} local function ensure(player: Player): Record local record = states[player] if not record then record = { lastFire = {}, combo = {} } states[player] = record end return record end    Step 2: Add the combo accessors  Just before function WeaponState.Clear, add:  -- Returns a COPY of the player's combo progress for a weapon (defaults to a -- fresh, no-active-combo state) so callers can't mutate stored state directly. function WeaponState.GetCombo(player: Player, weaponName: string): { index: number, lastHitTime: number } local record = states[player] local current = record and record.combo[weaponName] if not current then return { index = 0, lastHitTime = -math.huge } end return { index = current.index, lastHitTime = current.lastHitTime } end function WeaponState.SetCombo(player: Player, weaponName: string, index: number, timestamp: number) ensure(player).combo[weaponName] = { index = index, lastHitTime = timestamp } end function WeaponState.ResetCombo(player: Player, weaponName: string) local record = states[player] if record then record.combo[weaponName] = nil end end   Clear/Initialize already drop the whole record on player leave, so combo state is cleaned automatically.   Step 3: Verify (Studio)  Sync. Expected: no analyzer errors.   Step 4: Commit  git add src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/WeaponState.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): track per-weapon combo state in WeaponState"

searchDocs.title: Task 6: Buffered combo client (MeleeHandler)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/MeleeHandler.luau  Replaces the module-level lastSwing clock with per-Tool combo state, adds input buffering and per-step prediction.   Step 1: Replace the file contents  --!strict --[=[ @class MeleeHandler @client Category handler for melee combo weapons. On left-click it runs the shared `resolveComboSwing` to pick the next combo step (buffering the click while the current hit is still in recovery), then predicts that step: plays its swing sound + optional animation, runs the step hitbox for an instant hitmarker (`Signals.WeaponLocalHit`), draws the debug box, fires `Signals.WeaponComboChanged`, and sends the payload-less `Packets.ReqMeleeSwing` for the server to apply authoritative damage. Combo state is per-equipped-Tool (cleared on unequip), so it resets correctly on respawn/weapon-switch. ]=] local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local WeaponValidation = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponValidation")) local WeaponTypes = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes")) local Packets = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Packets")) local Signals = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Signals")) local SoundManager = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("SoundManager")) local WeaponDebug = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponDebug")) local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages:WaitForChild("Janitor")) export type HandlerContext = { player: Player, character: Model, tool: Tool, config: WeaponTypes.WeaponConfig, janitor: Janitor.Janitor, -- scoped to this equipped Tool } local MeleeHandler = {} -- Per-equipped-Tool combo progress (prediction only). Cleared on unequip. local comboByTool: { [Tool]: WeaponTypes.ComboState } = {} local function getRootPart(character: Model): BasePart? return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? end -- Execute one predicted combo hit and tell the server to validate it. local function performStep(context: HandlerContext, stepIndex: number, now: number) local config = context.config :: WeaponTypes.MeleeWeaponConfig local combo = config.Combos.Primary if not combo then return end local step = combo.Steps[stepIndex] local resolved = WeaponValidation.resolveStep(config, step) comboByTool[context.tool] = { index = stepIndex, lastHitTime = now } local rootPart = getRootPart(context.character) if rootPart then SoundManager.PlaySFXAt(resolved.SwingSound, rootPart.Position, { Replicate = true }) end if resolved.AnimId then local humanoid = context.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") if animator then local anim = Instance.new("Animation") anim.AnimationId = resolved.AnimId local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim) track:Play() anim:Destroy() end end if rootPart then local hits = WeaponValidation.queryMeleeTargets(rootPart.CFrame, resolved.Range, resolved.HitboxSize, { context.character }) local boxCFrame, boxSize = WeaponValidation.meleeHitbox(rootPart.CFrame, resolved.Range, resolved.HitboxSize) WeaponDebug.DrawBox(boxCFrame, boxSize, #hits > 0) if #hits > 0 then Signals.WeaponLocalHit:Fire(hits[1]) end end Signals.WeaponComboChanged:Fire(config.ToolName, stepIndex, #combo.Steps) Packets.ReqMeleeSwing:Fire() end function MeleeHandler.OnEquip(context: HandlerContext) comboByTool[context.tool] = { index = 0, lastHitTime = -math.huge } end function MeleeHandler.OnActivate(context: HandlerContext) local config = context.config :: WeaponTypes.MeleeWeaponConfig local combo = config.Combos.Primary if not combo then return end local state = comboByTool[context.tool] if not state then return end local now = os.clock() local stepIndex, accepted = WeaponValidation.resolveComboSwing(state, combo, now, 0) if accepted and stepIndex then performStep(context, stepIndex, now) return end -- Busy: buffer ONE retry at the recovery/reset boundary. The keyed Janitor -- entry replaces (and cancels) any previously buffered retry. local steps = combo.Steps local waitUntil: number if state.index >= #steps then waitUntil = state.lastHitTime + (combo.ResetCooldown or 0) else waitUntil = state.lastHitTime + steps[state.index].Recovery end local delay = math.max(0, waitUntil - now) context.janitor:Add(task.delay(delay, function() local current = comboByTool[context.tool] if not current then return end local retryNow = os.clock() local retryIndex, retryOk = WeaponValidation.resolveComboSwing(current, combo, retryNow, 0) if retryOk and retryIndex then performStep(context, retryIndex, retryNow) end end), true, "comboRetry") end function MeleeHandler.OnUnequip(context: HandlerContext) comboByTool[context.tool] = nil end return MeleeHandler   context.janitor:Add(thread, true, "comboRetry") — adding a thread with method true makes the Janitor task.cancel it on cleanup, and the index key "comboRetry" means each new buffered retry cancels the previous one (keyed-Janitor pattern). No manual thread bookkeeping, no accumulation.   Step 2: Verify (Studio)  Sync. Expected: no analyzer errors; equipping/clicking the sword produces no client errors (full behavior verified in Task 8 once the server matches).   Step 3: Commit  git add src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/MeleeHandler.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): buffered combo prediction in MeleeHandler"

searchDocs.title: Task 7: Combo authority (WeaponServer)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ServerScriptService/WeaponServer.server.luau Step 1: Replace the onMeleeSwing handler  Replace the existing onMeleeSwing function (keep everything else — requires, WeaponState.Initialize(), getEquippedWeapon, and the Packets.ReqMeleeSwing.OnServerEvent:Connect(onMeleeSwing) line) with:  local TOLERANCE = 0.05 -- seconds of jitter slack so legit hits aren't dropped local function onMeleeSwing(player: Player) local _tool, config = getEquippedWeapon(player) if not config or config.Category ~= "Melee" then return end local melee = config :: WeaponTypes.MeleeWeaponConfig local combo = melee.Combos.Primary if not combo then return end local now = os.clock() local state = WeaponState.GetCombo(player, melee.ToolName) local stepIndex, accepted = WeaponValidation.resolveComboSwing(state, combo, now, TOLERANCE) if not accepted or not stepIndex then return -- too fast / out of window: drop end local character = player.Character local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? if not character or not rootPart then return end WeaponState.SetCombo(player, melee.ToolName, stepIndex, now) local step = combo.Steps[stepIndex] local resolved = WeaponValidation.resolveStep(melee, step) local targets = WeaponValidation.queryMeleeTargets(rootPart.CFrame, resolved.Range, resolved.HitboxSize, { character }) for _, model in targets do local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if humanoid then local applied = CombatService.ApplyToModel(model, humanoid, resolved.Damage, melee.DamageType, player) if applied then local hitRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? local pos = if hitRoot then hitRoot.Position else rootPart.Position Packets.WeaponImpact:Fire(pos, melee.ToolName) end end end end    Step 2: Verify (Studio)  Sync. Expected: no analyzer errors; on Play the server output is clean and WeaponServer runs.   Step 3: Commit  git add src/ServerScriptService/WeaponServer.server.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): combo-aware authoritative melee in WeaponServer"

searchDocs.title: Task 8: Studio end-to-end verification​
searchDocs.content: Reuses the Plan 1 Studio setup (the ClassicSword Tool in StarterPack and the Damageable dummy). No new instances required. Turn on the debug box first: set ENABLED = true in WeaponDebug.luau (already true from the earlier session) so you can see each step's hitbox.   Step 1: Combo damage ramp  Press Play, equip the sword, face the dummy (~7 studs) and land 4 quick LCs. Expected: damage applies 25, 25, 25, 45 (total 120); the 4th (finisher) is visibly slower and its debug box is larger (reaches ~10 studs — stand ~9 studs out to confirm only the finisher tags the dummy).   Step 2: Buffering feels smooth  Click LC faster than the swing cadence. Expected: hits still come out paced one per Recovery (no dropped-feeling inputs), and total damage over the burst never exceeds one full combo per ~1.5s — i.e. you cannot out-click the Recovery gate.   Step 3: Chain reset on pause  Land hit 1 or 2, then wait ~1s (past ChainWindow) and click again. Expected: the next hit is hit 1 (25 dmg), not a continuation.   Step 4: Post-combo cooldown  Land the full 4-hit combo, then immediately click. Expected: a brief pause (~0.25s ResetCooldown) before hit 1 lands again — you can't seamlessly loop finisher→hit 1 with zero gap.   Step 5: Anti-exploit (server gate)  In the client command bar, burst the packet:  local Packets = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Packets) for i = 1, 20 do Packets.ReqMeleeSwing:Fire() end   Expected: the dummy loses at most one hit's worth from the burst (the server's Recovery/tolerance gate rejects the spam), not 20 hits. Walking the combo to the finisher still requires the prior hits — the burst cannot jump straight to repeated 45-damage finishers.   Step 6: Respawn/switch resets combo  Land hit 2, reset your character (or unequip+re-equip), then swing. Expected: starts at hit 1.   Step 7: Record results (optional)  No source changes here.

searchDocs.title: Self-Review (completed during authoring)​
searchDocs.content: Spec coverage: ComboStep/ComboDef/ComboState/InputKind/ResolvedStep + MeleeWeaponConfig rework ✓ (Task 1); ClassicSword migration & SwingCooldown removal ✓ (Task 2); resolveComboSwing (buffer/advance/expire/finish+ResetCooldown branches) + resolveStep fallback ✓ (Task 3); WeaponComboChanged HUD signal ✓ (Task 4); per-weapon combo record + Get/Set/ResetCombo ✓ (Task 5); buffered client prediction, per-step anim/sound/hitbox/debug, per-Tool state replacing module-level clock ✓ (Task 6); server authority with TOLERANCE, per-step damage via CombatService, payload-less packet ✓ (Task 7); free movement = no WalkSpeed code ✓ (nothing touches it); verification of ramp/buffer/reset/cooldown/anti-exploit ✓ (Task 8). RC and per-step knockback are out of scope per spec §1.Placeholder scan: none — every step has complete code or an exact Studio action.Type consistency: resolveComboSwing(state, combo, now, tolerance) -> (number?, boolean) called identically in MeleeHandler (tolerance 0) and WeaponServer (tolerance TOLERANCE) ✓; resolveStep(config, step) -> ResolvedStep fields (Damage/Range/HitboxSize/SwingSound/ImpactSound/AnimId) consumed consistently both sides ✓; ComboState { index, lastHitTime } matches WeaponState.GetCombo return and comboByTool entries ✓; config.Combos.Primary (a ComboDef) .Steps/.ResetCooldown used consistently ✓; WeaponState.SetCombo(player, weaponName, index, timestamp) matches its caller ✓.

searchDocs.title: Conventions for this plan (read before starting)​
searchDocs.content: No automated test suite exists and project preferences are to skip Selene, skip rojo build, and not auto-playtest. Each task therefore ends with a manual Studio verification the developer performs (sync via rojo serve, observe the stated result), then a commit.Commits use the Haiku model per project git preference.File header style: every module starts with --!strict (and --!native/--!optimize 2 where the surrounding peers use them) plus a --[=[ @class … ]=] Moonwave doc-comment, matching existing SharedModules.Refinement from spec §10: ReqMeleeSwing carries no payload. The server swings from its own authoritative character CFrame and never trusts a client-supplied aim direction. (The spec's aimDir parameter is dropped as an anti-exploit tightening; later gun packets still carry origin/dir because the server needs the aim line for raycasts.)Weapon Tools are "dumb": just a Handle + a Name matching a WeaponConfig key. All behavior lives in the controller/handlers, not in a per-Tool script (unlike the older GrabHook).

searchDocs.title: Task 3: WeaponValidation (shared math + target resolution)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/WeaponValidation.luau Step 1: Write the module  --!strict --!native --[=[ @class WeaponValidation Pure-ish shared helpers run on BOTH client (prediction) and server (authority) so the two agree. Holds the fire-rate gate, the melee hitbox query, and part→Humanoid-model resolution. No networking; the only world access is the deterministic spatial query in `queryMeleeTargets`. ]=] local WeaponValidation = {} -- Fire-rate gate. Returns true when `cooldown` seconds have elapsed since the -- last fire/swing. `now` is an os.clock() timestamp. function WeaponValidation.canFire(lastFireTime: number, cooldown: number, now: number): boolean return (now - lastFireTime) >= cooldown end -- Resolve a hit part to the nearest ancestor Model that owns a Humanoid. function WeaponValidation.resolveHumanoidModel(part: Instance): (Model?, Humanoid?) local model = part:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model") while model do local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if humanoid then return model, humanoid end model = model:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model") end return nil, nil end -- Box query in front of `rootCFrame`. Returns the unique Humanoid-bearing -- Models overlapping the swing volume. `ignore` excludes the attacker's own -- character (and anything else the caller wants skipped). function WeaponValidation.queryMeleeTargets( rootCFrame: CFrame, range: number, hitboxSize: Vector3, ignore: { Instance } ): { Model } local center = rootCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -(range / 2)) local size = Vector3.new(hitboxSize.X, hitboxSize.Y, range) local params = OverlapParams.new() params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore params.MaxParts = 50 local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(center, size, params) local seen: { [Model]: true } = {} local result: { Model } = {} for _, part in parts do local model = WeaponValidation.resolveHumanoidModel(part) if model and not seen[model] then seen[model] = true table.insert(result, model) end end return result end return WeaponValidation    Step 2: Verify (Studio)  Sync. Expected: no analyzer errors. (Behavioral verification happens end-to-end in Task 10.)   Step 3: Commit  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/WeaponValidation.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add WeaponValidation (fire gate, melee hitbox, target resolution)"

No payload — the -- server infers the weapon from the equipped Tool and swings from its own -- authoritative character CFrame (client aim is never trusted). local ReqMeleeSwing = Packet("ReqMeleeSwing") -- Server → all Clients: a hit landed; render impact FX/sound at this point. local WeaponImpact = Packet( "WeaponImpact", Packet.Vector3F32, -- world hit position Packet.String -- weaponName (selects FX/sound) )   Then add both to the returned registry table (alongside the existing keys):  	ReqMeleeSwing = ReqMeleeSwing, WeaponImpact = WeaponImpact,    Step 2: Add the weapon signals  In Signals/init.luau, before the closing } of the returned table, add:  	-- Weapon System (Client Side) — consumed by the user's HUD (see spec §11). -- Fired by WeaponController on Tool equip/unequip. WeaponEquipped = Signal() :: Signal.Signal<string, string>, -- (weaponName, category) WeaponUnequipped = Signal() :: Signal.Signal<string>, -- (weaponName) -- Fired by a client handler when its predicted attack hits a damageable -- target, so the HUD can show a hitmarker. Damage remains server-authoritative. WeaponLocalHit = Signal() :: Signal.Signal<Model>, -- (targetModel)    Step 3: Add the melee sounds  In SoundConfig.luau, inside the SoundConfig.Sfx = { … } table, add (ids left blank for the developer to fill; SoundManager skips pre-warm while Id == ""):  	MeleeSwing = { Id = "", Volume = 0.5, PitchRange = { 0.95, 1.05 }, Replicate = true, PoolInitial = 2, PoolMax = 8, }, MeleeImpact = { Id = "", Volume = 0.6, PitchRange = { 0.95, 1.05 }, Replicate = true, PoolInitial = 2, PoolMax = 8, },    Step 4: Verify (Studio)  Sync.
