searchDocs.title: Task 5: CombatService (server damage router)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/CombatService.luau Step 1: Write the module  --!strict --[=[ @class CombatService @server Single server-side damage router. Resolves a hit (part or Model) to a target and routes damage: a Player's character goes through `HealthManager` (keeps the HUD-tracked record correct); a Model tagged `Damageable` with a Humanoid takes direct Humanoid damage. Anything else is ignored. This is the ONLY place weapon code applies damage. Damageable NPC contract: a Model containing a Humanoid, tagged with the CollectionService tag `"Damageable"`. Enemy AI/spawning is supplied elsewhere; this module only deals damage. ]=] local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService") local Players = game:GetService("Players") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local WeaponValidation = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponValidation")) local WeaponTypes = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes")) local HealthManager = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("HealthManager")) local DAMAGEABLE_TAG = "Damageable" local CombatService = {} -- Apply `amount` damage to a resolved Humanoid-bearing Model. Returns true if -- damage was routed to a valid target. function CombatService.ApplyToModel( model: Model, humanoid: Humanoid, amount: number, attackType: WeaponTypes.DamageType, source: Player?, aoeVariant: ("Gas" | "Explosion")? ): boolean if amount <= 0 then return false end local targetPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) if targetPlayer then HealthManager.ApplyDamage(targetPlayer, amount, attackType, source, aoeVariant) return true end if CollectionService:HasTag(model, DAMAGEABLE_TAG) then if humanoid.Health > 0 then humanoid:TakeDamage(amount) end return true end return false end -- Convenience: resolve a hit part then route damage. function CombatService.ApplyToPart( part: Instance, amount: number, attackType: WeaponTypes.DamageType, source: Player?, aoeVariant: ("Gas" | "Explosion")? ): boolean local model, humanoid = WeaponValidation.resolveHumanoidModel(part) if not model or not humanoid then return false end return CombatService.ApplyToModel(model, humanoid, amount, attackType, source, aoeVariant) end return CombatService   Note: HealthManager.ApplyDamage(target, amount, attackType, source, aoeVariant) already exists with the signature (Player, number, AttackType, Player?, AOEVariant?) and validates the attack type internally.   Step 2: Verify (Studio)  Sync. Expected: no analyzer errors; CombatService resolves under ServerStorage/SharedModules.   Step 3: Commit  git add src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/CombatService.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add CombatService damage router + Damageable contract"

searchDocs.title: Task 6: WeaponState (server per-player cooldowns)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/WeaponState.luau Step 1: Write the module  --!strict --[=[ @class WeaponState @server Authoritative per-player weapon state. Plan 1 tracks last-fire timestamps per weapon name for server-side fire-rate gating. Later plans extend the record with ammo (`{ mag, reserve }`) and reload timing. Call `WeaponState.Initialize()` once from a server bootstrap to clear state on player leave. ]=] local Players = game:GetService("Players") type Record = { lastFire: { [string]: number }, -- weaponName -> os.clock() of last swing/shot } local states: { [Player]: Record } = {} local WeaponState = {} local function ensure(player: Player): Record local record = states[player] if not record then record = { lastFire = {} } states[player] = record end return record end function WeaponState.GetLastFire(player: Player, weaponName: string): number local record = states[player] if not record then return -math.huge end return record.lastFire[weaponName] or -math.huge end function WeaponState.SetLastFire(player: Player, weaponName: string, timestamp: number) ensure(player).lastFire[weaponName] = timestamp end function WeaponState.Clear(player: Player) states[player] = nil end function WeaponState.Initialize() Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) WeaponState.Clear(player) end) end return WeaponState    Step 2: Verify (Studio)  Sync. Expected: no analyzer errors.   Step 3: Commit  git add src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/WeaponState.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add WeaponState server cooldown tracking"

searchDocs.title: Task 7: MeleeHandler (client)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/MeleeHandler.luau  The handler implements a fixed interface the WeaponController calls. HandlerContext is defined here and reused by future handlers.   Step 1: Write the module  --!strict --[=[ @class MeleeHandler @client Category handler for melee weapons. On activate it gates locally on the swing cooldown, plays the swing sound (and optional swing animation), predicts the hitbox for an immediate hitmarker via `Signals.WeaponLocalHit`, and sends `Packets.ReqMeleeSwing` for the server to apply authoritative damage. Owns no per-shot connections; the controller passes a Janitor scoped to the equipped Tool. ]=] local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local WeaponValidation = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponValidation")) local WeaponTypes = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes")) local Packets = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Packets")) local Signals = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Signals")) local SoundManager = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("SoundManager")) local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages:WaitForChild("Janitor")) export type HandlerContext = { player: Player, character: Model, tool: Tool, config: WeaponTypes.WeaponConfig, janitor: Janitor.Janitor, -- scoped to this equipped Tool } local MeleeHandler = {} -- Per-character local cooldown clock, keyed by weapon name. Cleared implicitly -- when the module's consumers drop (new character = new controller scope). local lastSwing: { [string]: number } = {} local function getRootPart(character: Model): BasePart? return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? end function MeleeHandler.OnEquip(_context: HandlerContext) -- No equip-time setup for melee in Plan 1. end function MeleeHandler.OnActivate(context: HandlerContext) local config = context.config :: WeaponTypes.MeleeWeaponConfig local now = os.clock() if not WeaponValidation.canFire(lastSwing[config.ToolName] or -math.huge, config.SwingCooldown, now) then return end lastSwing[config.ToolName] = now -- Swing sound (positional, replicated to others). local rootPart = getRootPart(context.character) if rootPart then SoundManager.PlaySFXAt(config.SwingSound, rootPart.Position, { Replicate = true }) end -- Optional swing animation via Animator (skeletal anim, not MotionMaster). if config.SwingAnimId then local humanoid = context.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") if animator then local anim = Instance.new("Animation") anim.AnimationId = config.SwingAnimId local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim) track:Play() anim:Destroy() end end -- Local hit prediction → hitmarker. Damage is server-authoritative. if rootPart then local hits = WeaponValidation.queryMeleeTargets(rootPart.CFrame, config.Range, config.HitboxSize, { context.character }) if #hits > 0 then Signals.WeaponLocalHit:Fire(hits[1]) end end -- Tell the server to validate + apply damage. Packets.ReqMeleeSwing:Fire() end function MeleeHandler.OnUnequip(_context: HandlerContext) -- No teardown beyond the controller's Janitor in Plan 1. end return MeleeHandler   The handler module path under WeaponHandlers/ becomes a Folder containing a ModuleScript named MeleeHandler in the DataModel — required by the controller via script.Parent.WeaponHandlers.MeleeHandler.   Step 2: Verify (Studio)  Sync. Expected: no analyzer errors; StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/MeleeHandler exists as a ModuleScript.   Step 3: Commit  git add src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/MeleeHandler.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add client MeleeHandler"

searchDocs.title: Task 8: WeaponController (client bootstrap)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponController.client.luau  Watches the character (not the Backpack) for equipped Tools — a Tool parented to the character means "equipped", which sidesteps the known Backpack-replacement churn on respawn.   Step 1: Write the controller  --!strict --[=[ @class WeaponController @client Bootstrap that drives every equipped weapon. Watches the local character for Tool equip (Tool parented to character) / unequip (removed), looks up the Tool's `WeaponConfig` entry by name, and dispatches to the category handler. Connects `Tool.Activated` to the handler's `OnActivate`. One Janitor per equipped Tool; one per character. Fires `Signals.WeaponEquipped/Unequipped` for the HUD. ]=] local Players = game:GetService("Players") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local WeaponConfig = require(SharedModules.Configs:WaitForChild("WeaponConfig")) local Signals = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Signals")) local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages:WaitForChild("Janitor")) local MeleeHandler = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("WeaponHandlers"):WaitForChild("MeleeHandler")) type Handler = { OnEquip: (MeleeHandler.HandlerContext) -> (), OnActivate: (MeleeHandler.HandlerContext) -> (), OnUnequip: (MeleeHandler.HandlerContext) -> (), } local HANDLERS: { [string]: Handler } = { Melee = MeleeHandler, -- Gun / Throwable / Placed handlers added in later plans. } local player = Players.LocalPlayer local function onToolEquipped(character: Model, tool: Tool, characterJanitor: Janitor.Janitor) local config = WeaponConfig[tool.Name] if not config then return -- not a managed weapon end local handler = HANDLERS[config.Category] if not handler then return end local toolJanitor = Janitor.new() local context: MeleeHandler.HandlerContext = { player = player, character = character, tool = tool, config = config, janitor = toolJanitor, } handler.OnEquip(context) toolJanitor:Add(tool.Activated:Connect(function() handler.OnActivate(context) end), "Disconnect") Signals.WeaponEquipped:Fire(tool.Name, config.Category) -- Tool removed from the character = unequipped (or destroyed). toolJanitor:Add(tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function() if tool.Parent ~= character then handler.OnUnequip(context) Signals.WeaponUnequipped:Fire(tool.Name) characterJanitor:Remove(tool) -- triggers toolJanitor cleanup end end), "Disconnect") -- Register the tool's janitor under the character scope, keyed by the Tool, -- so character teardown cleans any still-equipped weapon. characterJanitor:Add(toolJanitor, "Destroy", tool) end local function onCharacterAdded(character: Model) local characterJanitor = Janitor.new() characterJanitor:Add(character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child) if child:IsA("Tool") then onToolEquipped(character, child, characterJanitor) end end), "Disconnect") -- Handle a Tool already equipped at spawn. for _, child in character:GetChildren() do if child:IsA("Tool") then onToolEquipped(character, child, characterJanitor) end end character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function() if not character:IsDescendantOf(game) then characterJanitor:Destroy() end end) end if player.Character then onCharacterAdded(player.Character) end player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)   characterJanitor:Add(toolJanitor, "Destroy", tool) keys the tool's Janitor by the Tool instance, so characterJanitor:Remove(tool) on unequip both removes it from the character scope and destroys it (running Tool.Activated cleanup). This is the keyed-Janitor pattern from the project's Janitor reference.   Step 2: Verify (Studio)  Sync. Expected: no analyzer errors; StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponController is a LocalScript that runs without error on play (check the client output is clean).   Step 3: Commit  git add src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponController.client.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add client WeaponController (Tool dispatch)"

searchDocs.title: Task 9: WeaponServer (authoritative melee)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ServerScriptService/WeaponServer.server.luau Step 1: Write the server script  --!strict --[=[ @class WeaponServer @server Authoritative weapon server. Plan 1 handles `ReqMeleeSwing`: it infers the weapon from the requester's equipped Tool, gates the swing on the server-side cooldown (`WeaponState`), re-runs the melee hitbox from the server's character CFrame, and routes damage through `CombatService`. Broadcasts `WeaponImpact` per hit so all clients render impact FX. Never trusts client aim or client-claimed hits. ]=] local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local WeaponConfig = require(SharedModules.Configs:WaitForChild("WeaponConfig")) local WeaponValidation = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponValidation")) local WeaponTypes = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes")) local Packets = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Packets")) local CombatService = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("CombatService")) local WeaponState = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponState")) WeaponState.Initialize() local function getEquippedWeapon(player: Player): (Tool?, WeaponTypes.WeaponConfig?) local character = player.Character if not character then return nil, nil end local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") if not tool then return nil, nil end return tool, WeaponConfig[tool.Name] end local function onMeleeSwing(player: Player) local _tool, config = getEquippedWeapon(player) if not config or config.Category ~= "Melee" then return end local melee = config :: WeaponTypes.MeleeWeaponConfig -- Server-authoritative cooldown gate. local now = os.clock() if not WeaponValidation.canFire(WeaponState.GetLastFire(player, melee.ToolName), melee.SwingCooldown, now) then return end local character = player.Character local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? if not character or not rootPart then return end WeaponState.SetLastFire(player, melee.ToolName, now) local targets = WeaponValidation.queryMeleeTargets(rootPart.CFrame, melee.Range, melee.HitboxSize, { character }) for _, model in targets do local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if humanoid then local applied = CombatService.ApplyToModel(model, humanoid, melee.Damage, melee.DamageType, player) if applied then local hitRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? local pos = if hitRoot then hitRoot.Position else rootPart.Position Packets.WeaponImpact:Fire(pos, melee.ToolName) end end end end Packets.ReqMeleeSwing.OnServerEvent:Connect(onMeleeSwing)    Step 2: Verify (Studio)  Sync. Expected: no analyzer errors; on play, the server output is clean and WeaponServer runs (no missing-require warnings).   Step 3: Commit  git add src/ServerScriptService/WeaponServer.server.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add WeaponServer authoritative melee handling"

searchDocs.title: Task 10: Studio setup + end-to-end verification​
searchDocs.content: No code committed from this repo (Tool/dummy are DataModel instances the developer builds in Studio per the project's MCP preference). This task proves the whole slice works.   Step 1: Build the ClassicSword Tool  In Studio: create a Tool named exactly ClassicSword with a Part child named Handle (e.g. a thin block). Set Tool.RequiresHandle = true (default). Place the Tool in StarterPack so the player spawns with it.   Step 2: Build a Damageable dummy  Insert a rig (Build Rig / any R15 or R6 Model with a Humanoid and HumanoidRootPart) into Workspace, a few studs in front of spawn. Add the CollectionService tag Damageable to the dummy Model (Studio → View → Tags, or run once in the command bar: game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(workspace.Dummy, "Damageable")). Set its Humanoid.MaxHealth/Health to e.g. 100 and add a Humanoid health display if desired.   Step 3: Play-test the happy path  Press Play. Equip the ClassicSword (it auto-equips from StarterPack or press its hotbar slot). Face the dummy within ~8 studs and activate (click). Expected:  The dummy's Humanoid health drops by 35 per swing. Swinging again within 0.6s does nothing (cooldown); after 0.6s it works. A second player/character is also damaged if standing in front (player path routes through HealthManager — its HUD health value drops). Step 4: Verify the anti-exploit gate  In the command bar (client context), fire the packet rapidly to confirm the server rejects over-rate swings:  local Packets = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Packets) for i = 1, 10 do Packets.ReqMeleeSwing:Fire() end   Expected: the dummy loses at most 35 (one swing's worth) from the burst, not 350 — the server cooldown drops the extras.   Step 5: Verify out-of-range does nothing  Stand >8 studs from the dummy and swing. Expected: no health change.   Step 6: Commit verification notes (optional)  If you keep a manual test log, record the results. No source changes here.

searchDocs.content: Files: Modify src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/WeaponValidation.luau   Step 1: Before the final return WeaponValidation, add:  -- Apply a random spread cone to an aim direction. `spreadDegrees` is the max -- half-angle. Returns a unit direction. Used client-side for visuals/feel; the -- server raycasts with the client-supplied direction (range-capped) and does its -- own line-of-sight, so spread is cosmetic, not a trust boundary. function WeaponValidation.applySpread(direction: Vector3, spreadDegrees: number): Vector3 if spreadDegrees <= 0 then return direction.Unit end local unit = direction.Unit -- Build an orthonormal basis around `unit`. local up = math.abs(unit.Y) < 0.99 and Vector3.yAxis or Vector3.xAxis local right = unit:Cross(up).Unit local realUp = right:Cross(unit).Unit local angle = math.rad(spreadDegrees) * math.sqrt(math.random()) local theta = math.random() * math.pi * 2 local offset = (right * math.cos(theta) + realUp * math.sin(theta)) * math.tan(angle) return (unit + offset).Unit end -- True if `hitPos` is within `maxDistance` studs of `origin`. function WeaponValidation.isWithinRange(origin: Vector3, hitPos: Vector3, maxDistance: number): boolean return (hitPos - origin).Magnitude <= maxDistance end -- Pure ammo transition: consume one round. Returns the new magazine count. function WeaponValidation.ammoAfterShot(mag: number): number return math.max(0, mag - 1) end -- Pure ammo transition: reload. Moves rounds from reserve into the magazine up to -- `magazineSize`. Returns (newMag, newReserve). function WeaponValidation.ammoAfterReload(mag: number, reserve: number, magazineSize: number): (number, number) local needed = math.max(0, magazineSize - mag) local moved = math.min(needed, reserve) return mag + moved, reserve - moved end    Step 2 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors. Response: accepted + reload seconds. local ReqReloadWeapon = Packet("ReqReloadWeapon"):Response( Packet.Boolean8, -- accepted Packet.NumberF32 -- reloadTime (0 if rejected) ) -- Server → all Clients: a shot was fired; render tracer/impact for non-shooters. local WeaponFired = Packet( "WeaponFired", Packet.Instance :: Player, -- shooter Packet.String, -- weaponName Packet.Vector3F32, -- origin (muzzle) Packet.Vector3F32, -- endpoint (hit position or max-range point) Packet.Boolean8 -- isHit ) -- Server → owning Client: authoritative ammo state for the HUD. local WeaponAmmoSync = Packet( "WeaponAmmoSync", Packet.String, -- weaponName Packet.NumberU16, -- mag Packet.NumberU16 -- reserve )   Add to the returned registry table:  	ReqFireWeapon = ReqFireWeapon, ReqReloadWeapon = ReqReloadWeapon, WeaponFired = WeaponFired, WeaponAmmoSync = WeaponAmmoSync,    Step 2 (signals): In Signals/init.luau, in the Weapon System block, add:  	-- (weaponName, mag, reserve) — fired on local prediction AND on server sync. WeaponAmmoChanged = Signal() :: Signal.Signal<string, number, number>, -- (weaponName, reloadTime) / (weaponName) WeaponReloadStarted = Signal() :: Signal.Signal<string, number>, WeaponReloadComplete = Signal() :: Signal.Signal<string>,    Step 3 (sounds): In SoundConfig.Sfx, add (ids blank for the dev to fill):  	PistolFire = { Id = "", Volume = 0.5, PitchRange = { 0.97, 1.03 }, Replicate = true, PoolInitial = 4, PoolMax = 16 }, SMGFire = { Id = "", Volume = 0.45, PitchRange = { 0.97, 1.03 }, Replicate = true, PoolInitial = 6, PoolMax = 24 }, ARFire = { Id = "", Volume = 0.5, PitchRange = { 0.97, 1.03 }, Replicate = true, PoolInitial = 6, PoolMax = 24 }, SRFire = { Id = "", Volume = 0.7, PitchRange = { 0.99, 1.01 }, Replicate = true, PoolInitial = 2, PoolMax = 8 }, GunReload = { Id = "", Volume = 0.5, Replicate = true, PoolInitial = 2, PoolMax = 8 }, GunDry = { Id = "", Volume = 0.4 }, BulletImpact = { Id = "", Volume = 0.4, PitchRange = { 0.95, 1.05 }, Replicate = true, PoolInitial = 4, PoolMax = 16 },    Step 4 (verify): Sync; in the command bar print(require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Packets).ReqFireWeapon) prints a table; no analyzer errors. Step 5 (commit):  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Packets/init.luau \ src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Signals/init.luau \ src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/SoundConfig.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): register gun packets, ammo/reload signals, gun sounds"

searchDocs.title: Task 5: WeaponState — ammo + reload timing​
searchDocs.pageTitle: Weapon System — Plan 2: Hitscan Guns + Ammo/Reload
searchDocs.content: Files: Modify src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/WeaponState.luau   Step 1: Replace the Record type and add ammo helpers. Change:  type Record = { lastFire: { [string]: number }, -- weaponName -> os.clock() of last swing/shot }   to:  type AmmoEntry = { mag: number, reserve: number, reloadEndsAt: number, -- os.clock() when an in-progress reload finishes; 0 = not reloading } type Record = { lastFire: { [string]: number }, -- weaponName -> os.clock() of last swing/shot ammo: { [string]: AmmoEntry }, -- weaponName -> ammo entry }   Update ensure to initialize ammo:  local function ensure(player: Player): Record local record = states[player] if not record then record = { lastFire = {}, ammo = {} } states[player] = record end return record end    Step 2: Before function WeaponState.Initialize(), add:  -- Initialize ammo for a weapon if not already present (called on equip). function WeaponState.EnsureAmmo(player: Player, weaponName: string, magazineSize: number, reserveMax: number) local record = ensure(player) if not record.ammo[weaponName] then record.ammo[weaponName] = { mag = magazineSize, reserve = reserveMax, reloadEndsAt = 0 } end end function WeaponState.GetAmmo(player: Player, weaponName: string): (number, number) local record = states[player] local entry = record and record.ammo[weaponName] if not entry then return 0, 0 end return entry.mag, entry.reserve end function WeaponState.SetAmmo(player: Player, weaponName: string, mag: number, reserve: number) local entry = ensure(player).ammo[weaponName] if entry then entry.mag = mag entry.reserve = reserve end end -- True if a reload is in progress for this weapon. function WeaponState.IsReloading(player: Player, weaponName: string, now: number): boolean local record = states[player] local entry = record and record.ammo[weaponName] return entry ~= nil and entry.reloadEndsAt > now end function WeaponState.SetReloadEnd(player: Player, weaponName: string, endsAt: number) local entry = ensure(player).ammo[weaponName] if entry then entry.reloadEndsAt = endsAt end end    Step 3 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors. Step 4 (commit):  git add src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/WeaponState.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add ammo + reload state to WeaponState"

searchDocs.title: Task 6: GunHandler (client)​
searchDocs.pageTitle: Weapon System — Plan 2: Hitscan Guns + Ammo/Reload
searchDocs.content: Files: Create src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/GunHandler.luau  Predicts firing/ammo, draws the shooter's own tracer + muzzle flash, handles the automatic fire loop and reload. Local ammo is a module table reconciled by WeaponAmmoSync.   Step 1: Write the module:  --!strict --[=[ @class GunHandler @client Category handler for hitscan guns. Predicts fire-rate and ammo for snappy feel, draws the shooter's tracer/muzzle FX, and sends `ReqFireWeapon` for the server to apply authoritative damage. Supports semi and automatic fire (held via OnActivate/OnDeactivate) and reload (OnReload). Local ammo is reconciled by the server's `WeaponAmmoSync`. ]=] local Players = game:GetService("Players") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local RunService = game:GetService("RunService") local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local WeaponValidation = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponValidation")) local WeaponTypes = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes")) local Packets = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Packets")) local Signals = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Signals")) local SoundManager = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("SoundManager")) local MotionMaster = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("MotionMaster")) local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages:WaitForChild("Janitor")) -- Reuse the Plan 1 handler context shape. local MeleeHandler = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MeleeHandler")) export type HandlerContext = MeleeHandler.HandlerContext local player = Players.LocalPlayer -- Module-level predicted ammo, keyed by weapon name. Reconciled by WeaponAmmoSync. local localAmmo: { [string]: { mag: number, reserve: number } } = {} local lastShot: { [string]: number } = {} local firingTokens: { [string]: number } = {} -- cancels the auto-fire loop on release -- One-time connection: server ammo authority overrides local prediction. do Packets.WeaponAmmoSync.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(weaponName: string, mag: number, reserve: number) localAmmo[weaponName] = { mag = mag, reserve = reserve } Signals.WeaponAmmoChanged:Fire(weaponName, mag, reserve) end) end local GunHandler = {} local function getMuzzle(tool: Tool): (Vector3, BasePart?) local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") :: BasePart? if not handle then local character = player.Character local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? return (root and root.Position) or Vector3.zero, nil end local muzzle = handle:FindFirstChild("Muzzle") :: Attachment? if muzzle then return muzzle.WorldPosition, handle end return handle.Position, handle end -- Aim point under the crosshair (screen center), via a camera raycast. local function getAimPoint(ignore: { Instance }, maxDistance: number): Vector3 local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera local viewport = camera.ViewportSize local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(viewport.X / 2, viewport.Y / 2) local params = RaycastParams.new() params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore local result = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * maxDistance, params) return result and result.Position or (ray.Origin + ray.Direction * maxDistance) end local function spawnTracer(from: Vector3, to: Vector3) local distance = (to - from).Magnitude if distance < 1 then return end local tracer = Instance.new("Part") tracer.Anchored = true tracer.CanCollide = false tracer.CanQuery = false tracer.CanTouch = false tracer.Material = Enum.Material.Neon tracer.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 150) tracer.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, distance) tracer.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from, to) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -distance / 2) tracer.Parent = workspace MotionMaster.Play(tracer, { Transparency = 1 }, { Duration = 0.08, Model = "EaseOutQuad" }) task.delay(0.12, function() tracer:Destroy() end) end local function fireOnce(context: HandlerContext) local config = context.config :: WeaponTypes.GunWeaponConfig local now = os.clock() local interval = 60 / config.RPM if not WeaponValidation.canFire(lastShot[config.ToolName] or -math.huge, interval, now) then return end local ammo = localAmmo[config.ToolName] if not ammo or ammo.mag <= 0 then SoundManager.PlaySFX(config.DrySound) return end lastShot[config.ToolName] = now ammo.mag = WeaponValidation.ammoAfterShot(ammo.mag) Signals.WeaponAmmoChanged:Fire(config.ToolName, ammo.mag, ammo.reserve) local character = context.character local origin, handle = getMuzzle(context.tool) local aimPoint = getAimPoint({ character }, config.MaxDistance) local direction = WeaponValidation.applySpread((aimPoint - origin), config.Spread) -- Local visuals + fire sound (replicated so others hear it). if handle then SoundManager.PlaySFXAt(config.FireSound, handle.Position, { Replicate = true }) end -- Predict the hit for tracer endpoint + hitmarker. local params = RaycastParams.new() params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character } local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * config.MaxDistance, params) local endpoint = result and result.Position or (origin + direction * config.MaxDistance) spawnTracer(origin, endpoint) if result then local model = WeaponValidation.resolveHumanoidModel(result.Instance) if model then Signals.WeaponLocalHit:Fire(model) end end Packets.ReqFireWeapon:Fire(origin, direction) end function GunHandler.OnEquip(_context: HandlerContext) -- Initial ammo arrives via WeaponAmmoSync from the server on equip. end function GunHandler.OnActivate(context: HandlerContext) local config = context.config :: WeaponTypes.GunWeaponConfig if not config.Automatic then fireOnce(context) return end -- Automatic: loop until OnDeactivate bumps the token. firingTokens[config.ToolName] = (firingTokens[config.ToolName] or 0) + 1 local token = firingTokens[config.ToolName] task.spawn(function() while firingTokens[config.ToolName] == token do fireOnce(context) RunService.Heartbeat:Wait() end end) end function GunHandler.OnDeactivate(context: HandlerContext) local config = context.config :: WeaponTypes.GunWeaponConfig firingTokens[config.ToolName] = (firingTokens[config.ToolName] or 0) + 1 -- cancel loop end function GunHandler.OnReload(context: HandlerContext) local config = context.config :: WeaponTypes.GunWeaponConfig local ammo = localAmmo[config.ToolName] if not ammo or ammo.mag >= config.MagazineSize or ammo.reserve <= 0 then return end Signals.WeaponReloadStarted:Fire(config.ToolName, config.ReloadTime) SoundManager.PlaySFX(config.ReloadSound) Packets.ReqReloadWeapon:Fire():andThen(function(accepted: boolean, reloadTime: number) if not accepted then Signals.WeaponReloadComplete:Fire(config.ToolName) return end task.delay(reloadTime, function() -- Server sends authoritative WeaponAmmoSync at completion; predict here too. local current = localAmmo[config.ToolName] if current then local newMag, newReserve = WeaponValidation.ammoAfterReload(current.mag, current.reserve, config.MagazineSize) current.mag, current.reserve = newMag, newReserve Signals.WeaponAmmoChanged:Fire(config.ToolName, newMag, newReserve) end Signals.WeaponReloadComplete:Fire(config.ToolName) end) end) end function GunHandler.OnUnequip(context: HandlerContext) local config = context.config :: WeaponTypes.GunWeaponConfig firingTokens[config.ToolName] = (firingTokens[config.ToolName] or 0) + 1 -- stop any loop end return GunHandler   Packets.ReqReloadWeapon:Fire():andThen(...) follows the project's :Response(...) packet pattern (the request returns a promise-like with andThen). If the local Packet library returns the values directly instead, replace with local accepted, reloadTime = Packets.ReqReloadWeapon:Fire(). Confirm against Packets/Packet usage in ReqShredderStart when implementing.   Step 2 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors. Behavior verified in Task 10. Step 3 (commit):  git add src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/GunHandler.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add client GunHandler (hitscan, ammo, reload)"

searchDocs.title: Task 7: WeaponEffectsController (replicated FX receiver)​
searchDocs.pageTitle: Weapon System — Plan 2: Hitscan Guns + Ammo/Reload
searchDocs.content: Files: Create src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponEffectsController.client.luau  Single client receiver for replicated combat FX. Renders other players' tracers (WeaponFired) and everyone's melee impact (WeaponImpact, broadcast in Plan 1 but previously unhandled). Plays positional impact sounds.   Step 1: Write the controller:  --!strict --[=[ @class WeaponEffectsController @client Receives replicated combat-FX packets and renders them for the local player: tracers for OTHER players' shots (`WeaponFired`), and impact FX/sound for all melee/gun hits (`WeaponImpact`). The shooter draws its own tracer locally in GunHandler, so `WeaponFired` is ignored for the local player to avoid doubles. ]=] local Players = game:GetService("Players") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local Packets = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Packets")) local WeaponConfig = require(SharedModules.Configs:WaitForChild("WeaponConfig")) local SoundManager = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("SoundManager")) local MotionMaster = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("MotionMaster")) local player = Players.LocalPlayer local function spawnTracer(from: Vector3, to: Vector3) local distance = (to - from).Magnitude if distance < 1 then return end local tracer = Instance.new("Part") tracer.Anchored = true tracer.CanCollide = false tracer.CanQuery = false tracer.CanTouch = false tracer.Material = Enum.Material.Neon tracer.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 150) tracer.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, distance) tracer.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from, to) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -distance / 2) tracer.Parent = workspace MotionMaster.Play(tracer, { Transparency = 1 }, { Duration = 0.08, Model = "EaseOutQuad" }) task.delay(0.12, function() tracer:Destroy() end) end local function spawnImpactSpark(position: Vector3) local spark = Instance.new("Part") spark.Anchored = true spark.CanCollide = false spark.CanQuery = false spark.CanTouch = false spark.Material = Enum.Material.Neon spark.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 90) spark.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4) spark.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) spark.Parent = workspace MotionMaster.Play(spark, { Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2) }, { Duration = 0.15, Model = "EaseOutQuad" }) task.delay(0.2, function() spark:Destroy() end) end -- Other players' shots → tracer + impact (the shooter handles its own locally). Packets.WeaponFired.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(shooter: Player, weaponName: string, origin: Vector3, endpoint: Vector3, isHit: boolean) if shooter == player then return end spawnTracer(origin, endpoint) if isHit then spawnImpactSpark(endpoint) local config = WeaponConfig[weaponName] if config and (config :: any).ImpactSound then SoundManager.PlaySFXAt((config :: any).ImpactSound, endpoint) end end end) -- Melee/other impact broadcasts (Plan 1) → impact FX + sound for everyone. Packets.WeaponImpact.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3, weaponName: string) spawnImpactSpark(position) local config = WeaponConfig[weaponName] local impactSound = config and (config :: any).ImpactSound if impactSound then SoundManager.PlaySFXAt(impactSound, position) end end)    Step 2 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors; client output clean on play. Step 3 (commit):  git add src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponEffectsController.client.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add WeaponEffectsController for replicated FX"

searchDocs.content: Files: Modify src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponController.client.luau   Step 1: Add the service + handler requires near the top (after the existing requires):  local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService") local GunHandler = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("WeaponHandlers"):WaitForChild("GunHandler"))    Step 2: Replace the Handler type and HANDLERS map with:  type Handler = { OnEquip: (MeleeHandler.HandlerContext) -> (), OnActivate: (MeleeHandler.HandlerContext) -> (), OnDeactivate: ((MeleeHandler.HandlerContext) -> ())?, OnReload: ((MeleeHandler.HandlerContext) -> ())?, OnUnequip: (MeleeHandler.HandlerContext) -> (), } local HANDLERS: { [string]: Handler } = { Melee = MeleeHandler, Gun = GunHandler, -- Throwable / Placed handlers added in later plans. }    Step 3: In onToolEquipped, replace the single Tool.Activated connection block with the activate + deactivate + reload wiring:  	handler.OnEquip(context) toolJanitor:Add(tool.Activated:Connect(function() handler.OnActivate(context) end), "Disconnect") if handler.OnDeactivate then toolJanitor:Add(tool.Deactivated:Connect(function() (handler.OnDeactivate :: (MeleeHandler.HandlerContext) -> ())(context) end), "Disconnect") end if handler.OnReload then toolJanitor:Add(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed) if gameProcessed then return end if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then (handler.OnReload :: (MeleeHandler.HandlerContext) -> ())(context) end end), "Disconnect") end Signals.WeaponEquipped:Fire(tool.Name, config.Category)    Step 4 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors; equip a gun (Task 10 setup) and confirm no client errors on equip/click/R. searchDocs.title: Task 9: WeaponServer — ammo init, authoritative fire + reload​
searchDocs.pageTitle: Weapon System — Plan 2: Hitscan Guns + Ammo/Reload
searchDocs.content: Files: Modify src/ServerScriptService/WeaponServer.server.luau   Step 1: Add Players and RunService-free wiring. After the existing requires, add:  local Players = game:GetService("Players") local WeaponValidation_unused = nil -- (WeaponValidation already required in Plan 1)   (If Players is already required, skip it. WeaponValidation is already required from Plan 1.)  Add a constant near the top of the script body:  local MAX_ORIGIN_DISTANCE = 14 -- studs: claimed muzzle origin must be near the character    Step 2: Add ammo-on-equip. After WeaponState.Initialize(), add:  -- Initialize ammo + push an initial WeaponAmmoSync whenever a gun is equipped -- (Tool parented to the character). local function onToolEquipped(plr: Player, tool: Tool) local config = WeaponConfig[tool.Name] if not config or config.Category ~= "Gun" then return end local gun = config :: WeaponTypes.GunWeaponConfig WeaponState.EnsureAmmo(plr, gun.ToolName, gun.MagazineSize, gun.ReserveMax) local mag, reserve = WeaponState.GetAmmo(plr, gun.ToolName) Packets.WeaponAmmoSync:FireClient(plr, gun.ToolName, mag, reserve) end local function watchCharacter(plr: Player, character: Model) character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child) if child:IsA("Tool") then onToolEquipped(plr, child) end end) for _, child in character:GetChildren() do if child:IsA("Tool") then onToolEquipped(plr, child) end end end Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr) plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character) watchCharacter(plr, character) end) if plr.Character then watchCharacter(plr, plr.Character) end end) for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character) watchCharacter(plr, character) end) if plr.Character then watchCharacter(plr, plr.Character) end end    Step 3: Add the authoritative fire handler (hitscan). After the onMeleeSwing function and its connect, add:  local function onFireWeapon(player: Player, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3) local _tool, config = getEquippedWeapon(player) if not config or config.Category ~= "Gun" then return end local gun = config :: WeaponTypes.GunWeaponConfig if gun.FireMode ~= "Hitscan" then return -- projectile guns (rocket) handled in Plan 3 end local now = os.clock() local interval = 60 / gun.RPM if not WeaponValidation.canFire(WeaponState.GetLastFire(player, gun.ToolName), interval, now) then return end if WeaponState.IsReloading(player, gun.ToolName, now) then return end local mag, reserve = WeaponState.GetAmmo(player, gun.ToolName) if mag <= 0 then return end local character = player.Character local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? if not character or not root then return end -- Anti-exploit: claimed muzzle origin must be near the character. if (origin - root.Position).Magnitude > MAX_ORIGIN_DISTANCE then return end WeaponState.SetLastFire(player, gun.ToolName, now) WeaponState.SetAmmo(player, gun.ToolName, WeaponValidation.ammoAfterShot(mag), reserve) -- Authoritative raycast (server's hit wins; range-capped; ignores the shooter). local params = RaycastParams.new() params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character } local unit = direction.Unit local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, unit * gun.MaxDistance, params) local endpoint = origin + unit * gun.MaxDistance local isHit = false if result then endpoint = result.Position local model, humanoid = WeaponValidation.resolveHumanoidModel(result.Instance) if model and humanoid then local amount = gun.Damage if result.Instance.Name == "Head" then amount *= (gun.HeadshotMultiplier or 1) end isHit = CombatService.ApplyToModel(model, humanoid, amount, gun.DamageType, player) end end Packets.WeaponFired:Fire(player, gun.ToolName, origin, endpoint, isHit) local newMag, newReserve = WeaponState.GetAmmo(player, gun.ToolName) Packets.WeaponAmmoSync:FireClient(player, gun.ToolName, newMag, newReserve) end Packets.ReqFireWeapon.OnServerEvent:Connect(onFireWeapon)    Step 4: Add the reload handler. After the fire handler, add:  local function onReloadWeapon(player: Player): (boolean, number) local _tool, config = getEquippedWeapon(player) if not config or config.Category ~= "Gun" then return false, 0 end local gun = config :: WeaponTypes.GunWeaponConfig local now = os.clock() if WeaponState.IsReloading(player, gun.ToolName, now) then return false, 0 end local mag, reserve = WeaponState.GetAmmo(player, gun.ToolName) if mag >= gun.MagazineSize or reserve <= 0 then return false, 0 end WeaponState.SetReloadEnd(player, gun.ToolName, now + gun.ReloadTime) task.delay(gun.ReloadTime, function() local curMag, curReserve = WeaponState.GetAmmo(player, gun.ToolName) local newMag, newReserve = WeaponValidation.ammoAfterReload(curMag, curReserve, gun.MagazineSize) WeaponState.SetAmmo(player, gun.ToolName, newMag, newReserve) WeaponState.SetReloadEnd(player, gun.ToolName, 0) Packets.WeaponAmmoSync:FireClient(player, gun.ToolName, newMag, newReserve) end) return true, gun.ReloadTime end Packets.ReqReloadWeapon.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player) return onReloadWeapon(player) end   OnServerInvoke is the response-packet handler for a :Response(...) packet. Confirm the exact handler name against how ReqShredderStart:Response(...) is answered server-side in ShredderServer; if that file uses .OnServerEvent + a manual reply, mirror that pattern instead.   Step 5 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors; server output clean on play. Step 6 (commit):  git add src/ServerScriptService/WeaponServer.server.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): authoritative hitscan fire + reload + ammo-on-equip"

searchDocs.title: Task 10: Studio setup + end-to-end verification​
searchDocs.pageTitle: Weapon System — Plan 2: Hitscan Guns + Ammo/Reload
searchDocs.content: Step 1: Build four Tools named exactly Pistol, SMG, AR, SR, each with a Part named Handle. Optionally add an Attachment named Muzzle at the barrel tip of each Handle (else the Handle position is used). Place all four in StarterPack (alongside ClassicSword from Plan 1). Step 2: Ensure the Plan 1 Damageable-tagged dummy still exists in Workspace with a Head part (use a standard rig so headshots register). Step 3 (semi-auto + ammo): Play, equip Pistol. Click to fire. Expected: tracer to crosshair target; dummy loses 18 (32 on a Head hit: 18×1.8). Mag counts down from 12 (watch via print on Signals.WeaponAmmoChanged, or temporarily print in WeaponServer). At 0 mag, clicking plays the dry sound and deals no damage. Step 4 (reload): Press R. After 1.4s, mag refills from reserve; firing resumes. Step 5 (automatic): Equip SMG or AR; hold the mouse button. Expected: continuous fire at the configured RPM; releasing stops it; mag drains and reloads. Step 6 (sniper + range): Equip SR; hit the dummy at long range (within 2000 studs). Expected: 90 damage (225 on headshot). Beyond MaxDistance, no hit. Step 7 (anti-exploit rate): In the client command bar, spam fire and confirm the server rate-limits:  local P = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Packets) for i = 1, 30 do P.ReqFireWeapon:Fire(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector) end   Expected: damage/ammo consumed is bounded by the fire-rate + magazine, not 30 instant hits.   Step 8 (two-player PvP path): With a second player/character in front, confirm hits route through HealthManager (their synced health drops), proving the router handles both target kinds.

searchDocs.title: Task 5: PlacedHandler (client)​
searchDocs.content: Files: Create src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/PlacedHandler.luau   Step 1: Write the module:  --!strict --[=[ @class PlacedHandler @client Category handler for placed explosives (C4). On activate it raycasts under the crosshair to a nearby surface and requests placement; the server validates and spawns the (replicated) prop. Detonation is triggered by the controller's detonate input, which calls OnDetonate → `ReqDetonateC4`. ]=] local Players = game:GetService("Players") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local WeaponTypes = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes")) local Packets = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Packets")) local SoundManager = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("SoundManager")) local MeleeHandler = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MeleeHandler")) export type HandlerContext = MeleeHandler.HandlerContext local player = Players.LocalPlayer local PlacedHandler = {} function PlacedHandler.OnEquip(_context: HandlerContext) end function PlacedHandler.OnActivate(context: HandlerContext) local config = context.config :: WeaponTypes.PlacedWeaponConfig local character = context.character local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera local viewport = camera.ViewportSize local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(viewport.X / 2, viewport.Y / 2) local params = RaycastParams.new() params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character } local result = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * (config.PlaceRange + 6), params) if not result then return end Packets.ReqPlaceC4:Fire(result.Position, result.Normal):andThen(function(success: boolean, _reason: number) if success then SoundManager.PlaySFXAt(config.PlaceSound, result.Position, { Replicate = true }) end end) end -- Called by WeaponController on the detonate input. function PlacedHandler.OnDetonate(_context: HandlerContext) Packets.ReqDetonateC4:Fire() end function PlacedHandler.OnUnequip(_context: HandlerContext) end return PlacedHandler   Same :Response note as Plan 2: if the local Packet returns values directly instead of an andThen chain, use local success, reason = Packets.ReqPlaceC4:Fire(...). Confirm against ReqShredderStart usage.   Step 2 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors. Step 3 (commit):  git add src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/PlacedHandler.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add client PlacedHandler (C4)"

searchDocs.title: Task 8: C4Server (placement + detonation authority)​
searchDocs.content: Files: Create src/ServerScriptService/C4Server.server.luau   Step 1: Write the server script:  --!strict --[=[ @class C4Server @server Authoritative C4 placement and detonation. On `ReqPlaceC4` it validates the placement point is within `PlaceRange` of the player and enforces `MaxActive`, then spawns a server-owned prop (which replicates to all clients) and records it with an arm time. On `ReqDetonateC4` it detonates every armed charge for that player via `CombatService.ApplyAOE` + `Packets.ExplosionAt`, destroying the props. Reuses the shared combat + state modules. ]=] local Players = game:GetService("Players") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local WeaponConfig = require(SharedModules.Configs:WaitForChild("WeaponConfig")) local WeaponTypes = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes")) local Packets = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Packets")) local CombatService = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("CombatService")) local WeaponState = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponState")) local propsFolder = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("WeaponProps") -- Spawned C4 props live here so they replicate and stay out of harm's filtering. local placedFolder = Instance.new("Folder") placedFolder.Name = "PlacedC4" placedFolder.Parent = workspace local REASON_OK = 0 local REASON_OUT_OF_RANGE = 1 local REASON_MAX_ACTIVE = 2 local REASON_INVALID = 3 local function getEquippedC4(player: Player): WeaponTypes.PlacedWeaponConfig? local character = player.Character local tool = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") if not tool then return nil end local config = WeaponConfig[tool.Name] if config and config.Category == "Placed" then return config :: WeaponTypes.PlacedWeaponConfig end return nil end local function onPlaceC4(player: Player, position: Vector3, normal: Vector3): (boolean, number) local config = getEquippedC4(player) if not config then return false, REASON_INVALID end local character = player.Character local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? if not character or not root then return false, REASON_INVALID end if (position - root.Position).Magnitude > config.PlaceRange then return false, REASON_OUT_OF_RANGE end if WeaponState.GetPlacedCount(player) >= config.MaxActive then return false, REASON_MAX_ACTIVE end local template = propsFolder:FindFirstChild(config.PropName) if not template or not template:IsA("Model") then warn("[C4Server] Missing prop template:", config.PropName) return false, REASON_INVALID end local prop = template:Clone() :: Model -- Orient the prop flat against the surface (normal = up). prop:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAlong(position, normal)) prop:AddTag("PlacedC4") prop.Parent = placedFolder WeaponState.AddPlaced(player, prop, os.clock() + config.ArmDelay) Packets.C4Placed:Fire(position) return true, REASON_OK end local function onDetonateC4(player: Player) local config = getEquippedC4(player) -- Allow detonation even if the player swapped tools: use C4 config from registry directly. local c4 = config or (WeaponConfig.C4 :: WeaponTypes.PlacedWeaponConfig) local now = os.clock() local charges = WeaponState.TakeAllPlaced(player) for _, charge in charges do if charge.model and charge.model.Parent and now >= charge.armedAt then local center = charge.model:GetPivot().Position CombatService.ApplyAOE(center, c4.AOERadius, c4.AOEDamage, "AOE", player, {}) Packets.ExplosionAt:Fire(center, c4.AOERadius, "C4") charge.model:Destroy() elseif charge.model and charge.model.Parent then -- Not yet armed: put it back so it can detonate later. WeaponState.AddPlaced(player, charge.model, charge.armedAt) end end end Packets.ReqPlaceC4.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, position: Vector3, normal: Vector3) return onPlaceC4(player, position, normal) end Packets.ReqDetonateC4.OnServerEvent:Connect(onDetonateC4) Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) -- WeaponState.Clear (called by WeaponServer's WeaponState.Initialize) destroys -- remaining props; nothing extra needed here. end)   CFrame.lookAlong(position, normal) orients the prop's look vector along the surface normal. If you want the C4 to lie flat (face-on the wall) adjust the offset CFrame when building the prop. The detonate handler re-adds not-yet-armed charges so an early trigger doesn't waste them.   Step 2 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors; server output clean on play. Step 3 (commit):  git add src/ServerScriptService/C4Server.server.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add C4Server placement + detonation authority"

searchDocs.title: Task 9: Studio setup + end-to-end verification​
searchDocs.content: Step 1 (prop): In ServerStorage, create a Folder named WeaponProps containing a Model named C4 (a small block with a PrimaryPart set; anchored, CanCollide = false). Step 2 (tool): Build a Tool named C4 with a Handle, place it in StarterPack. Step 3 (place): Play, equip C4, aim at a wall/floor within 12 studs, click. Expected: a C4 prop appears stuck to the surface; place sound plays. Placing a 5th (over MaxActive = 4) is rejected. Step 4 (arm + detonate): Place 2–3 charges near a Damageable dummy, wait ≥1s (arm delay), press G. Expected: all armed charges explode (FX + sound via ExplosionAt), dummies within 22 studs take falloff damage (≈120 at center), props are removed. Step 5 (arm-delay gate): Place a charge and immediately press G (less than 1s). Expected: that charge does NOT detonate (still arming); pressing G again after the delay detonates it. Step 6 (out-of-range): Aim at a far surface (>12 studs) and click. Expected: no placement (server rejects with reason 1). Step 7 (leave cleanup): Place charges, then leave/stop. Expected: props are destroyed (no orphaned C4) via WeaponState.Clear.

searchDocs.content: Files: Modify src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/WeaponValidation.luau   Step 1: Before return WeaponValidation, add:  -- Linear AOE falloff: full `maxDamage` at the center, 0 at `radius` and beyond. function WeaponValidation.aoeFalloff(center: Vector3, hitPos: Vector3, radius: number, maxDamage: number): number if radius <= 0 then return 0 end local distance = (hitPos - center).Magnitude if distance >= radius then return 0 end return maxDamage * (1 - distance / radius) end -- Unique Humanoid-bearing Models whose root is within `radius` of `center`. -- Returns { { model, humanoid, distance } } for AOE damage application. export type AOETarget = { model: Model, humanoid: Humanoid, distance: number } function WeaponValidation.queryAOEModels(center: Vector3, radius: number, ignore: { Instance }): { AOETarget } local params = OverlapParams.new() params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore params.MaxParts = 200 local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(center, radius, params) local seen: { [Model]: true } = {} local result: { AOETarget } = {} for _, part in parts do local model, humanoid = WeaponValidation.resolveHumanoidModel(part) if model and humanoid and not seen[model] then seen[model] = true local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? local pos = root and root.Position or part.Position table.insert(result, { model = model, humanoid = humanoid, distance = (pos - center).Magnitude }) end end return result end    Step 2 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors. Step 3 (commit):  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/WeaponValidation.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add AOE falloff + sphere target query"

searchDocs.content: Files: Modify src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/CombatService.luau   Step 1: Before return CombatService, add:  -- Apply area damage with linear falloff to every damageable target within -- `radius` of `center`. `ignore` excludes e.g. the shooter's own character when -- friendly self-damage is undesired (pass {} to allow self-damage). function CombatService.ApplyAOE( center: Vector3, radius: number, maxDamage: number, attackType: WeaponTypes.DamageType, source: Player?, ignore: { Instance } ) local targets = WeaponValidation.queryAOEModels(center, radius, ignore) for _, target in targets do local amount = WeaponValidation.aoeFalloff(center, target.model:GetPivot().Position, radius, maxDamage) if amount > 0 then CombatService.ApplyToModel(target.model, target.humanoid, amount, attackType, source, "Explosion") end end end   attackType will be "AOE", and the hard-coded "Explosion" variant matches HealthManager's AOEVariant validation. model:GetPivot().Position is used for falloff distance (robust for both rigs and prop models).   Step 2 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors. Step 3 (commit):  git add src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/CombatService.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add CombatService.ApplyAOE with falloff"

searchDocs.title: Task 6: ProjectileVisuals (shared client cosmetic casters)​
searchDocs.pageTitle: Weapon System — Plan 3: Rocket Launcher + Grenade (FastCast2)
searchDocs.content: Files: Create src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/ProjectileVisuals.luau  One module, two reused serial casters (rocket + grenade), cosmetic-only. Used by the shooter's handler AND by WeaponEffectsController for other players, so the flight visual is identical everywhere. Explosion FX is NOT done here (it's driven by ExplosionAt); these casters only fly + self-clean the cosmetic on hit.   Step 1: Write the module:  --!strict --[=[ @class ProjectileVisuals @client Cosmetic-only FastCast2 projectile rendering shared by the local shooter and by WeaponEffectsController (for other players). Holds one reused serial caster per role (rocket, grenade). The cosmetic part flies the configured arc and is auto-cleaned on the cast's own surface hit (or after a safety lifetime). Damage and explosions are server-authoritative and NOT handled here. ]=] local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local FastCast2 = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("FastCast2")) local WeaponConfig = require(SharedModules.Configs:WaitForChild("WeaponConfig")) local WeaponTypes = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes")) local assetsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WeaponAssets") -- Cosmetic projectiles live here so they never get caught by gameplay raycasts. local container = Instance.new("Folder") container.Name = "ProjectileCosmetics" container.Parent = workspace local ProjectileVisuals = {} local function makeCaster(): any local caster = FastCast2.new() -- Cosmetic-only: nothing to do on Hit/Terminate beyond FastCast's own cleanup, -- which returns/destroys the cosmetic part automatically. caster:Init("BulkMoveTo", false) return caster end local rocketCaster = makeCaster() local grenadeCaster = makeCaster() local function baseBehavior(template: BasePart, acceleration: Vector3, maxDistance: number, ignore: { Instance }) local behavior = FastCast2.newBehavior() local params = RaycastParams.new() params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore behavior.RaycastParams = params behavior.Acceleration = acceleration behavior.MaxDistance = maxDistance behavior.CosmeticBulletTemplate = template behavior.CosmeticBulletContainer = container return behavior end local function getTemplate(name: string): BasePart? local t = assetsFolder:FindFirstChild(name) return (t and t:IsA("BasePart")) and t or nil end -- Fly a cosmetic rocket. `ignore` should include the shooter's character. function ProjectileVisuals.fireRocket(weaponName: string, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, ignore: { Instance }) local config = WeaponConfig[weaponName] :: WeaponTypes.GunWeaponConfig local template = getTemplate(config.CosmeticTemplate or "Rocket") if not template then return end local behavior = baseBehavior(template, config.Gravity or Vector3.zero, config.MaxDistance, ignore) rocketCaster:RaycastFire(origin, direction.Unit, config.ProjectileSpeed or 120, behavior) end -- Fly a cosmetic grenade arc. `ignore` should include the thrower's character. function ProjectileVisuals.fireGrenade(weaponName: string, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, ignore: { Instance }) local config = WeaponConfig[weaponName] :: WeaponTypes.ThrowableWeaponConfig local template = getTemplate(config.CosmeticTemplate or "Grenade") if not template then return end local behavior = baseBehavior(template, config.Gravity, 2000, ignore) grenadeCaster:SpherecastFire(origin, config.SpherecastRadius, direction.Unit, config.ThrowSpeed, behavior) end return ProjectileVisuals    Step 2 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors. (WeaponAssets folder created in Task 11; until then getTemplate returns nil and the calls no-op safely.) Step 3 (commit):  git add src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/ProjectileVisuals.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add ProjectileVisuals shared cosmetic casters"

ProjectileVisuals.fireRocket(config.ToolName, origin, direction, { character }) else -- Hitscan: predict the hit for tracer endpoint + hitmarker. local params = RaycastParams.new() params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character } local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * config.MaxDistance, params) local endpoint = result and result.Position or (origin + direction * config.MaxDistance) spawnTracer(origin, endpoint) if result then local model = WeaponValidation.resolveHumanoidModel(result.Instance) if model then Signals.WeaponLocalHit:Fire(model) end end end Packets.ReqFireWeapon:Fire(origin, direction)   (Delete the old standalone Packets.ReqFireWeapon:Fire(origin, direction) line that followed the removed block, since it is now inside this replacement.) searchDocs.title: Task 8: ThrowableHandler (client grenade)​
searchDocs.pageTitle: Weapon System — Plan 3: Rocket Launcher + Grenade (FastCast2)
searchDocs.content: Files: Create src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/ThrowableHandler.luau   Step 1: Write the module:  --!strict --[=[ @class ThrowableHandler @client Category handler for thrown weapons (grenade). On activate it gates on the throw cooldown, plays the throw sound, renders a local cosmetic arc via ProjectileVisuals, and sends `ReqThrowGrenade`. Damage + the authoritative detonation are server-side; the explosion FX arrives via `ExplosionAt`. ]=] local Players = game:GetService("Players") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local WeaponValidation = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponValidation")) local WeaponTypes = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes")) local Packets = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Packets")) local SoundManager = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("SoundManager")) local ProjectileVisuals = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("ProjectileVisuals")) local MeleeHandler = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MeleeHandler")) export type HandlerContext = MeleeHandler.HandlerContext local player = Players.LocalPlayer local lastThrow: { [string]: number } = {} local ThrowableHandler = {} local function getThrowOriginDir(character: Model, tool: Tool): (Vector3, Vector3) local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") :: BasePart? local origin = handle and handle.Position or character:GetPivot().Position local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera local viewport = camera.ViewportSize local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(viewport.X / 2, viewport.Y / 2) -- Bias the throw slightly upward for a natural lob. local direction = (ray.Direction + Vector3.new(0, 0.25, 0)).Unit return origin, direction end function ThrowableHandler.OnEquip(_context: HandlerContext) end function ThrowableHandler.OnActivate(context: HandlerContext) local config = context.config :: WeaponTypes.ThrowableWeaponConfig local now = os.clock() if not WeaponValidation.canFire(lastThrow[config.ToolName] or -math.huge, config.CooldownTime, now) then return end lastThrow[config.ToolName] = now local origin, direction = getThrowOriginDir(context.character, context.tool) SoundManager.PlaySFXAt(config.ThrowSound, origin, { Replicate = true }) ProjectileVisuals.fireGrenade(config.ToolName, origin, direction, { context.character }) Packets.ReqThrowGrenade:Fire(origin, direction) end function ThrowableHandler.OnUnequip(_context: HandlerContext) end return ThrowableHandler    Step 2 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors. Step 3 (commit):  git add src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/ThrowableHandler.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): add client ThrowableHandler (grenade)"

searchDocs.content: Files: Modify src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponEffectsController.client.luau   Step 1: Add requires near the top:  local ProjectileVisuals = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("ProjectileVisuals"))    Step 2: Add an explosion FX helper after spawnImpactSpark:  local function spawnExplosion(center: Vector3, radius: number) local blast = Instance.new("Part") blast.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball blast.Anchored = true blast.CanCollide = false blast.CanQuery = false blast.CanTouch = false blast.Material = Enum.Material.Neon blast.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 60) blast.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2) blast.CFrame = CFrame.new(center) blast.Parent = workspace local diameter = radius * 2 MotionMaster.Play(blast, { Size = Vector3.new(diameter, diameter, diameter), Transparency = 1 }, { Duration = 0.35, Model = "EaseOutQuad" }) task.delay(0.45, function() blast:Destroy() end) end    Step 3: Add the three packet handlers at the end of the file:  -- Other players' rockets → render a cosmetic projectile locally. Packets.ProjectileSpawned.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(shooter: Player, weaponName: string, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, _speed: number) if shooter == player then return -- shooter already rendered its own in GunHandler end local ignore = shooter.Character and { shooter.Character } or {} ProjectileVisuals.fireRocket(weaponName, origin, direction, ignore) end) -- Other players' grenades → render a cosmetic arc locally. Packets.GrenadeThrown.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(thrower: Player, weaponName: string, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, _speed: number) if thrower == player then return end local ignore = thrower.Character and { thrower.Character } or {} ProjectileVisuals.fireGrenade(weaponName, origin, direction, ignore) end) -- Single source of explosion FX for rocket/grenade/C4 (everyone, including the source). Packets.ExplosionAt.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(center: Vector3, radius: number, weaponName: string) spawnExplosion(center, radius) local config = WeaponConfig[weaponName] local sound = config and ((config :: any).ExplodeSound or (config :: any).ImpactSound) if sound then SoundManager.PlaySFXAt(sound, center) end end)    Step 4 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors. searchDocs.content: Files: Modify WeaponController.client.luau, WeaponServer.server.luau   Step 1 (controller): Add the require and register the handler. After the GunHandler require, add:  local ThrowableHandler = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("WeaponHandlers"):WaitForChild("ThrowableHandler"))   In the HANDLERS map, add:  	Throwable = ThrowableHandler,    Step 2 (server requires): In WeaponServer.server.luau, add near the requires:  local FastCast2 = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("FastCast2"))    Step 3 (server rocket caster): After the equip-watcher block, add the server rocket caster + projectile branch. First, the caster (module scope):  -- ── Server rocket caster (validation + AOE; no cosmetic) ──────────────────── local rocketServerCaster = FastCast2.new() rocketServerCaster.Hit = function(cast, result, _velocity, _cosmetic) local data = cast.UserData if not data or not result then return end local center = result.Position CombatService.ApplyAOE(center, data.radius, data.aoeDamage, "AOE", data.shooter, { data.character }) Packets.ExplosionAt:Fire(center, data.radius, data.weaponName) end rocketServerCaster:Init("BulkMoveTo", false)    Step 4 (server rocket branch): In onFireWeapon, replace the early-return:  	if gun.FireMode ~= "Hitscan" then return -- projectile guns (rocket) handled in Plan 3 end   with a projectile branch that runs the server cast and broadcasts the cosmetic spawn (place it AFTER the rate/reload/ammo/origin checks and the SetLastFire/SetAmmo so it shares the same gating — see the structured replacement below). Replace the whole body of onFireWeapon from the gun.FireMode guard onward with:  	-- Shared gating for both fire modes. local now = os.clock() local interval = 60 / gun.RPM if not WeaponValidation.canFire(WeaponState.GetLastFire(player, gun.ToolName), interval, now) then return end if WeaponState.IsReloading(player, gun.ToolName, now) then return end local mag, reserve = WeaponState.GetAmmo(player, gun.ToolName) if mag <= 0 then return end local character = player.Character local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? if not character or not root then return end if (origin - root.Position).Magnitude > MAX_ORIGIN_DISTANCE then return end WeaponState.SetLastFire(player, gun.ToolName, now) WeaponState.SetAmmo(player, gun.ToolName, WeaponValidation.ammoAfterShot(mag), reserve) local unit = direction.Unit if gun.FireMode == "Projectile" then -- Rocket: run the authoritative server cast; AOE applied in rocketServerCaster.Hit. local behavior = FastCast2.newBehavior() local params = RaycastParams.new() params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character } behavior.RaycastParams = params behavior.Acceleration = gun.Gravity or Vector3.zero behavior.MaxDistance = gun.MaxDistance behavior.UserData = { shooter = player, character = character, weaponName = gun.ToolName, radius = gun.AOERadius or 0, aoeDamage = gun.AOEDamage or 0, } rocketServerCaster:RaycastFire(origin, unit, gun.ProjectileSpeed or 120, behavior) Packets.ProjectileSpawned:Fire(player, gun.ToolName, origin, unit, gun.ProjectileSpeed or 120) else -- Hitscan path (Plan 2). local hitParams = RaycastParams.new() hitParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude hitParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character } local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, unit * gun.MaxDistance, hitParams) local endpoint = origin + unit * gun.MaxDistance local isHit = false if result then endpoint = result.Position local model, humanoid = WeaponValidation.resolveHumanoidModel(result.Instance) if model and humanoid then local amount = gun.Damage if result.Instance.Name == "Head" then amount *= (gun.HeadshotMultiplier or 1) end isHit = CombatService.ApplyToModel(model, humanoid, amount, gun.DamageType, player) end end Packets.WeaponFired:Fire(player, gun.ToolName, origin, endpoint, isHit) end local newMag, newReserve = WeaponState.GetAmmo(player, gun.ToolName) Packets.WeaponAmmoSync:FireClient(player, gun.ToolName, newMag, newReserve)    Step 5 (server grenade): Add the server grenade caster + ReqThrowGrenade handler. After the rocket caster block, add:  -- ── Server grenade caster (tracks position; AOE on fuse) ──────────────────── local grenadeServerCaster = FastCast2.new() grenadeServerCaster.LengthChanged = function(cast, lastPoint, _dir, _disp) if cast.UserData then cast.UserData.lastPos = lastPoint end end grenadeServerCaster.Hit = function(cast, result, _velocity, _cosmetic) if cast.UserData and result then cast.UserData.restPos = result.Position FastCast2:TerminateCast(cast) -- freeze at the surface; fuse handles detonation end end grenadeServerCaster:Init("BulkMoveTo", false) local GRENADE_MAX_ORIGIN_DISTANCE = 14 local function onThrowGrenade(player: Player, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3) local _tool, config = getEquippedWeapon(player) if not config or config.Category ~= "Throwable" then return end local grenade = config :: WeaponTypes.ThrowableWeaponConfig local now = os.clock() if not WeaponValidation.canFire(WeaponState.GetLastFire(player, grenade.ToolName), grenade.CooldownTime, now) then return end local character = player.Character local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? if not character or not root then return end if (origin - root.Position).Magnitude > GRENADE_MAX_ORIGIN_DISTANCE then return end WeaponState.SetLastFire(player, grenade.ToolName, now) local record = { lastPos = origin, restPos = nil :: Vector3?, character = character } local behavior = FastCast2.newBehavior() local params = RaycastParams.new() params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character } behavior.RaycastParams = params behavior.Acceleration = grenade.Gravity behavior.MaxDistance = 2000 behavior.UserData = record behavior.FastCastEventsConfig.UseLengthChanged = true -- needed to track lastPos grenadeServerCaster:SpherecastFire(origin, grenade.SpherecastRadius, direction.Unit, grenade.ThrowSpeed, behavior) Packets.GrenadeThrown:Fire(player, grenade.ToolName, origin, direction.Unit, grenade.ThrowSpeed) task.delay(grenade.FuseTime, function() local center = record.restPos or record.lastPos CombatService.ApplyAOE(center, grenade.AOERadius, grenade.AOEDamage, "AOE", player, {}) Packets.ExplosionAt:Fire(center, grenade.AOERadius, grenade.ToolName) end) end Packets.ReqThrowGrenade.OnServerEvent:Connect(onThrowGrenade)   Grenade AOE passes ignore = {} so the thrower can take self-damage (classic grenade behavior). Change to { character } if you want thrower immunity.   Step 6 (verify): Sync; no analyzer errors; server + client output clean on play. Step 7 (commit):  git add src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponController.client.luau \ src/ServerScriptService/WeaponServer.server.luau git commit -m "feat(weapons): server rocket cast + grenade fuse simulation; wire throwable"

searchDocs.title: Task 1: Create the Factions shared module​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Factions.luau Step 1: Write the module  --!strict --!native --[=[ @class Factions Combat faction policy shared by client and server. Resolves a Player or a Humanoid-bearing Model to a `Faction`, and decides whether one faction may damage another via a default-deny hostility table. Faction comes from: a Player (or a Model that is a player's character) → "Player"; a Model tagged `EnemyTag` → "Enemy"; a Model tagged `FriendlyTag` → "Friendly". These two tags REPLACE the former single "NPC" tag — being either tag marks a Model as a combatant (damageable + collision pass-through; see NpcCollisionService). Only Player<->Enemy damage is allowed. Every other ordered pair is denied, so there is no player-vs-player or enemy-vs-enemy damage, and friendly NPCs (e.g. the trader) cannot be damaged by anyone. The actual block is enforced server-side in CombatService; this module is shared so the client can reuse `resolve` for UI (e.g. hitmarker suppression). ]=] local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService") local Players = game:GetService("Players") export type Faction = "Player" | "Friendly" | "Enemy" local Factions = {} Factions.EnemyTag = "EnemyNPC" Factions.FriendlyTag = "FriendlyNPC" -- Faction tags that mark a Model as a combatant. Iterated by NpcCollisionService. Factions.NpcTags = { Factions.EnemyTag, Factions.FriendlyTag } -- Default-deny hostility table: canDamageTable[attacker][target] == true ⇒ allowed. local canDamageTable: { [Faction]: { [Faction]: boolean } } = { Player = { Enemy = true }, Enemy = { Player = true }, Friendly = {}, } -- Resolve a Player or Model to its Faction, or nil if it is not a combatant -- (nil actor, or a Model with neither faction tag and no backing player). function Factions.resolve(actor: (Player | Model)?): Faction? if actor == nil then return nil end if actor:IsA("Player") then return "Player" end -- actor is a Model from here. local model = actor :: Model if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then return "Player" end if CollectionService:HasTag(model, Factions.EnemyTag) then return "Enemy" end if CollectionService:HasTag(model, Factions.FriendlyTag) then return "Friendly" end return nil end -- True if `attacker` is permitted to deal combat damage to `target`. function Factions.canDamage(attacker: Faction, target: Faction): boolean local row = canDamageTable[attacker] return row ~= nil and row[target] == true end return Factions    Step 2: Verify canDamage by inspection  Confirm the table yields exactly: Player→Enemy = true, Enemy→Player = true, and all other ordered pairs false (including every Friendly pair and every same-faction pair). This is the entire policy — read each cell against the four spec rules.   Step 3: (Optional) Confirm it loads in Studio  With Rojo synced, in the Studio command bar:  local F = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Factions) print(F.canDamage("Player","Enemy"), F.canDamage("Player","Player"), F.canDamage("Enemy","Friendly")) -- Expected: true false false    Step 4: Commit  git add "src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Factions.luau" git commit -m "feat(combat): add Factions policy module (resolve + canDamage)"
