searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/CombatService.luau Step 1: Import Factions and drop the literal NPC tag  Replace the requires block + NPC_TAG constant. Find:  local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local WeaponValidation = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponValidation")) local WeaponTypes = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes")) local HealthManager = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("HealthManager")) local NPC_TAG = "NPC"   Replace with:  local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local WeaponValidation = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponValidation")) local WeaponTypes = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes")) local Factions = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Factions")) local HealthManager = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("HealthManager"))   Then delete the now-unused service require near the top of the file — CombatService no longer touches CollectionService directly (faction tag checks moved into Factions):  local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")   Leave the Players, ReplicatedStorage, and ServerStorage requires — they are still used.   Step 2: Rewrite ApplyToModel with the check + self-exemption  Find the whole ApplyToModel function:  function CombatService.ApplyToModel( model: Model, humanoid: Humanoid, amount: number, attackType: WeaponTypes.DamageType, source: Player?, aoeVariant: ("Gas" | "Explosion")? ): boolean if amount <= 0 then return false end local targetPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) if targetPlayer then HealthManager.ApplyDamage(targetPlayer, amount, attackType, source, aoeVariant) return true end if CollectionService:HasTag(model, NPC_TAG) then if humanoid.Health > 0 then humanoid:TakeDamage(amount) end return true end return false end   Replace with:  -- True when `model` is the attacker's own character/model. Self-damage is exempt -- from the faction block so a player's own AOE can still hurt them (governed by -- the weapon's `ignore` list), while still blocking damage to OTHER same-faction -- targets. local function isSelf(attacker: (Player | Model)?, model: Model): boolean if attacker == nil then return false end if attacker:IsA("Player") then return attacker.Character == model end return attacker == model end function CombatService.ApplyToModel( model: Model, humanoid: Humanoid, amount: number, attackType: WeaponTypes.DamageType, attacker: (Player | Model)?, aoeVariant: ("Gas" | "Explosion")? ): boolean if amount <= 0 then return false end -- Target must be a combatant (a player's character or a faction-tagged NPC). local targetFaction = Factions.resolve(model) if not targetFaction then return false end -- Faction gate. nil attacker = environment (fall damage, hazards) → bypass. -- Self is exempt so own-AOE self-damage still lands. local attackerFaction = Factions.resolve(attacker) if attackerFaction and not isSelf(attacker, model) and not Factions.canDamage(attackerFaction, targetFaction) then return false end -- Route a player's character through HealthManager (HUD-tracked record). local targetPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) if targetPlayer then local sourcePlayer = if attacker ~= nil and attacker:IsA("Player") then attacker else nil HealthManager.ApplyDamage(targetPlayer, amount, attackType, sourcePlayer, aoeVariant) return true end -- Otherwise it is a faction-tagged NPC: damage the Humanoid directly. if humanoid.Health > 0 then humanoid:TakeDamage(amount) end return true end    Step 3: Update ApplyToPart and ApplyAOE parameter names  In ApplyToPart, rename the source: Player? parameter to attacker: (Player | Model)? and pass attacker through to ApplyToModel. Find:  function CombatService.ApplyToPart( part: Instance, amount: number, attackType: WeaponTypes.DamageType, source: Player?, aoeVariant: ("Gas" | "Explosion")? ): boolean local model, humanoid = WeaponValidation.resolveHumanoidModel(part) if not model or not humanoid then return false end return CombatService.ApplyToModel(model, humanoid, amount, attackType, source, aoeVariant) end   Replace with:  function CombatService.ApplyToPart( part: Instance, amount: number, attackType: WeaponTypes.DamageType, attacker: (Player | Model)?, aoeVariant: ("Gas" | "Explosion")? ): boolean local model, humanoid = WeaponValidation.resolveHumanoidModel(part) if not model or not humanoid then return false end return CombatService.ApplyToModel(model, humanoid, amount, attackType, attacker, aoeVariant) end   In ApplyAOE, rename source: Player? → attacker: (Player | Model)? and pass attacker into the per-target ApplyToModel call. Find:  function CombatService.ApplyAOE( center: Vector3, radius: number, maxDamage: number, attackType: WeaponTypes.DamageType, source: Player?, ignore: { Instance } ) local targets = WeaponValidation.queryAOEModels(center, radius, ignore) for _, target in targets do local amount = WeaponValidation.aoeFalloff(center, target.model:GetPivot().Position, radius, maxDamage) if amount > 0 then CombatService.ApplyToModel(target.model, target.humanoid, amount, attackType, source, "Explosion") end end end   Replace with:  function CombatService.ApplyAOE( center: Vector3, radius: number, maxDamage: number, attackType: WeaponTypes.DamageType, attacker: (Player | Model)?, ignore: { Instance } ) local targets = WeaponValidation.queryAOEModels(center, radius, ignore) for _, target in targets do local amount = WeaponValidation.aoeFalloff(center, target.model:GetPivot().Position, radius, maxDamage) if amount > 0 then CombatService.ApplyToModel(target.model, target.humanoid, amount, attackType, attacker, "Explosion") end end end    Step 4: Update the @class docstring  Find the docstring lines describing the NPC contract:   NPC contract: a Model containing a Humanoid, tagged with the CollectionService tag `"NPC"`. That same tag also places the NPC's parts in the `Character` collision group (see NpcCollisionService), so thrown charges pass through it. Enemy AI/spawning is supplied elsewhere; this module only deals damage.   Replace with:   NPC contract: a Model containing a Humanoid, tagged with EITHER the CollectionService tag `"EnemyNPC"` or `"FriendlyNPC"` (see Factions). That same tag also places the NPC's parts in the `Character` collision group (see NpcCollisionService), so thrown charges pass through it. Friendly-fire is enforced here via Factions.canDamage: only Player<->Enemy damage lands, so players never hurt players or friendly NPCs and enemies never hurt enemies or friendly NPCs. Self-damage from one's own AOE is exempt. A nil attacker is treated as environmental and bypasses the faction gate. Enemy AI/spawning is supplied elsewhere; this module only deals damage.    Step 5: Verify in Studio  With Rojo synced, place two Humanoid dummy Models in Workspace, tag one EnemyNPC and one FriendlyNPC (CollectionService / the Tag Editor). As a player:  Melee/shoot the enemy → it takes damage. Melee/shoot the friendly → no damage, no health change. Throw a grenade so the blast covers both NPCs + yourself (empty ignore) → enemy takes damage, friendly does not, you take self-damage. With a second player present, attack them with each weapon → no damage. Step 6: Commit  git add "src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/CombatService.luau" git commit -m "feat(combat): enforce faction friendly-fire gate in CombatService"

searchDocs.title: Task 3: Watch both faction tags in NpcCollisionService​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/ServerScriptService/NpcCollisionService.server.luau Step 1: Require Factions and remove the literal tag constant  Find:  local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages:WaitForChild("Janitor")) local CollisionGroups = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("CollisionGroups")) local NPC_TAG = "NPC"   Replace with:  local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages:WaitForChild("Janitor")) local CollisionGroups = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("CollisionGroups")) local Factions = require(ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("Factions"))    Step 2: Wire both faction tags  Find the bottom wiring block:  CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(NPC_TAG):Connect(function(instance) if instance:IsA("Model") then watchModel(instance) end end) CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(NPC_TAG):Connect(function(instance) if instance:IsA("Model") then unwatchModel(instance) end end) for _, instance in CollectionService:GetTagged(NPC_TAG) do if instance:IsA("Model") then watchModel(instance) end end   Replace with:  for _, tag in Factions.NpcTags do CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(tag):Connect(function(instance) if instance:IsA("Model") then watchModel(instance) end end) CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(tag):Connect(function(instance) if instance:IsA("Model") then unwatchModel(instance) end end) for _, instance in CollectionService:GetTagged(tag) do if instance:IsA("Model") then watchModel(instance) end end end   Note: watchModel/unwatchModel are already idempotent (watched[model] guard), so a Model carrying one faction tag is handled exactly once. The unwatchModel on removal is safe because a model carries a single faction tag — removing it stops its watch. (If a model ever held both tags, removing one would unwatch while the other tag still applies; not a supported configuration, and out of scope.)   Step 3: Update the @class docstring  Find:   Places every BasePart of every `"NPC"`-tagged Model into the `Character` collision group (see CollisionGroups), so thrown charges (`WeaponProjectile`) and dropped materials (`DroppedMaterial`) pass through NPCs exactly as they pass through players. This is the non-player sibling of CharacterCollisionService: players are handled by Players events there, NPCs are handled by the CollectionService `"NPC"` tag here. The same `"NPC"` tag also gates direct Humanoid damage in CombatService, so a single tag makes a Model both projectile-pass-through and damageable.   Replace with:   Places every BasePart of every faction-tagged Model (`"EnemyNPC"` / `"FriendlyNPC"`, see Factions) into the `Character` collision group (see CollisionGroups), so thrown charges (`WeaponProjectile`) and dropped materials (`DroppedMaterial`) pass through NPCs exactly as they pass through players. This is the non-player sibling of CharacterCollisionService: players are handled by Players events there, NPCs are handled by the faction tags here. Those same faction tags gate direct Humanoid damage and friendly-fire in CombatService (see Factions), so one tag makes a Model both projectile-pass-through and damageable.    Step 4: Verify in Studio  With Rojo synced and the two tagged dummies from Task 2 present, throw a charge/grenade or drop material at each NPC → the projectile/material passes through both (no bounce/collision), confirming both faction tags still drive the Character collision group.   Step 5: Commit  git add "src/ServerScriptService/NpcCollisionService.server.luau" git commit -m "feat(combat): collision pass-through keys on faction tags, not NPC"

searchDocs.content: This project has no automated test suite — verification happens in Studio (per CLAUDE.md). Do not run selene, rojo build, or attempt headless tests. Each task ends with a Studio verification checkpoint (a concrete thing the user confirms) and a commit. Commits use the Claude Haiku model per project preference (dispatch the commit step to a Haiku subagent, or note the message for the user to commit).  Because this is a protocol refactor, the codebase is mid-refactor and will have unresolved references between Tasks 4 and 11 (e.g. packets are renamed in Task 4 before consumers update). Per-task commits remain valuable for review granularity; the single end-to-end Studio runtime verification is the final gate in Task 12. Intermediate Luau type errors during this window are expected.

searchDocs.title: Task 1: ServerProjectile module​
searchDocs.pageTitle: Replicated Server Projectiles + C4/Grenade Redesign — Implementation Plan
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/ServerProjectile.luau Step 1: Confirm the network-ownership API name  Per the project rule (training data is stale), confirm via Context7 that the current Roblox API for forcing server simulation of an unanchored part is BasePart:SetNetworkOwner(nil) (and that CFrame.lookAlong(position, direction) is current — it is already used in C4Server). Adjust the code below if the API differs.   Step 2: Write the module  Create src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/ServerProjectile.luau:  --!strict --[=[ @class ServerProjectile @server Spawns and owns server-authoritative, REPLICATED projectile instances cloned from ReplicatedStorage/WeaponAssets into workspace/ServerProjectiles. Two movers: a physics mover for throwables (unanchored, massless, server network ownership — free bounce/settle and smooth interpolation to every client) and a rocket spawner returning an anchored part the caller steps along its authoritative FastCast2 cast. Damage/explosions are handled by the caller (WeaponServer), never here. ]=] local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages:WaitForChild("Janitor")) -- Studs to spawn a thrown projectile ahead of the muzzle so it never self-collides -- with the thrower at launch (physics parts can't ignore an instance the way a -- raycast filter can). local SPAWN_OFFSET = 2.5 -- Resolved lazily (NOT a blocking top-level WaitForChild): the WeaponAssets folder -- is Studio-authored and may not exist yet. Until it does, spawns no-op safely. local assetsFolder: Instance? = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("WeaponAssets") -- All replicated projectiles live here so they stay out of unrelated systems' way. local container = Instance.new("Folder") container.Name = "ServerProjectiles" container.Parent = workspace local ServerProjectile = {} ServerProjectile.Container = container local function getTemplate(name: string): Instance? if not assetsFolder then assetsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("WeaponAssets") end if not assetsFolder then return nil end return assetsFolder:FindFirstChild(name) end -- Root assembly part: the part itself, or a Model's PrimaryPart. local function rootOf(inst: Instance): BasePart? if inst:IsA("BasePart") then return inst end if inst:IsA("Model") then return inst.PrimaryPart end return nil end local function setMassless(inst: Instance) if inst:IsA("BasePart") then inst.Massless = true end for _, d in inst:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Massless = true end end end local function placeAt(inst: Instance, cframe: CFrame) if inst:IsA("BasePart") then inst.CFrame = cframe elseif inst:IsA("Model") then inst:PivotTo(cframe) end end --[=[ Spawn a physics-driven, replicated throwable. Returns the cloned instance (BasePart or Model) or nil if the template is missing/invalid. @param rest "Bounce" lets it bounce + settle (grenade); "Stick" freezes it dead on first contact that isn't the thrower (C4). @param ignore instances whose descendants don't count as a "Stick" surface (e.g. the thrower's character). ]=] function ServerProjectile.spawnThrowable( templateName: string, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, speed: number, rest: string, ignore: { Instance } ): Instance? local template = getTemplate(templateName) if not template then warn("[ServerProjectile] Missing template:", templateName) return nil end local clone = template:Clone() local root = rootOf(clone) if not root then warn("[ServerProjectile] Template has no root part (set PrimaryPart on Models):", templateName) clone:Destroy() return nil end setMassless(clone) root.Anchored = false root.CanCollide = true placeAt(clone, CFrame.lookAlong(origin + direction * SPAWN_OFFSET, direction)) clone.Parent = container -- Keep the SERVER as network owner: authoritative position reads + an exploiter -- cannot seize ownership to teleport the charge. pcall(function() root:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end) root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = direction * speed if rest == "Stick" then local janitor = Janitor.new() janitor:Add(root.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart) for _, ig in ignore do if ig and hit:IsDescendantOf(ig) then return -- ignore the thrower's own body end end if not root.Anchored then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero root.Anchored = true -- rest immediately, no bounce; sticks where it hit end janitor:Cleanup() end), "Disconnect") -- Self-clean if the part is destroyed (detonated / player left) before contact. root.Destroying:Once(function() janitor:Destroy() end) end return clone end --[=[ Spawn an anchored, replicated rocket cosmetic at `cframe`. The caller (WeaponServer) steps its CFrame along the authoritative FastCast cast and destroys it on hit. CanQuery=false so the authoritative ray never hits the cosmetic itself. ]=] function ServerProjectile.spawnRocket(templateName: string, cframe: CFrame): BasePart? local template = getTemplate(templateName) if not (template and template:IsA("BasePart")) then warn("[ServerProjectile] Rocket template missing or not a BasePart:", templateName) return nil end local clone = template:Clone() :: BasePart clone.Anchored = true clone.CanCollide = false clone.CanQuery = false clone.CanTouch = false clone.CFrame = cframe clone.Parent = container return clone end return ServerProjectile    Step 3: Studio verification checkpoint  Sync, then in the command bar run:  local SP = require(game.ServerStorage.SharedModules.ServerProjectile) print(SP, workspace:FindFirstChild("ServerProjectiles"))   Expected: the module table prints and a ServerProjectiles folder exists in workspace. (No projectile is spawned yet — it's wired in Task 6.)   Step 4: Commit (Haiku)  Message:  feat(weapons): add ServerProjectile replicated-instance module

fuse handles detonation end end grenadeServerCaster:Init("BulkMoveTo", false)    Step 4: Spawn the replicated rocket in the Projectile fire branch  In onFireWeapon, replace the Projectile branch (currently lines 216-233):  	if gun.FireMode == "Projectile" then -- Rocket: authoritative server cast; AOE applied in rocketServerCaster.Hit. local behavior = FastCast2.newBehavior() local rocketParams = RaycastParams.new() rocketParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude rocketParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character } behavior.RaycastParams = rocketParams behavior.Acceleration = gun.Gravity or Vector3.zero behavior.MaxDistance = gun.MaxDistance behavior.UserData = { shooter = player, character = character, weaponName = gun.ToolName, radius = gun.AOERadius or 0, aoeDamage = gun.AOEDamage or 0, } rocketServerCaster:RaycastFire(origin, unit, gun.ProjectileSpeed or 120, behavior) Packets.ProjectileSpawned:Fire(player, gun.ToolName, origin, unit, gun.ProjectileSpeed or 120) else   with:  	if gun.FireMode == "Projectile" then -- Rocket: authoritative server cast drives AOE; a replicated cosmetic part is -- stepped along the cast (rocketServerCaster.LengthChanged) for all clients. local cosmetic = ServerProjectile.spawnRocket(gun.CosmeticTemplate or "Rocket", CFrame.lookAlong(origin, unit)) local behavior = FastCast2.newBehavior() local rocketParams = RaycastParams.new() rocketParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude rocketParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character } behavior.RaycastParams = rocketParams behavior.Acceleration = gun.Gravity or Vector3.zero behavior.MaxDistance = gun.MaxDistance behavior.UserData = { shooter = player, character = character, weaponName = gun.ToolName, radius = gun.AOERadius or 0, aoeDamage = gun.AOEDamage or 0, cosmetic = cosmetic, } behavior.FastCastEventsConfig.UseLengthChanged = true -- needed to step the cosmetic rocketServerCaster:RaycastFire(origin, unit, gun.ProjectileSpeed or 120, behavior) -- Safety cleanup: if the cast never reports a hit (flew to max distance), make -- sure the cosmetic is removed. if cosmetic then local lifetime = (gun.MaxDistance / (gun.ProjectileSpeed or 120)) + 1 task.delay(lifetime, function() if cosmetic.Parent then cosmetic:Destroy() end end) end else    Step 5: Replace onThrowGrenade with onThrowProjectile + onDetonate  Replace the entire throw section (currently lines 306-363, from the -- Authoritative grenade throw banner through Packets.ReqThrowGrenade.OnServerEvent:Connect(onThrowGrenade)):  -- ──────────────────────────────────────────── -- Authoritative grenade throw -- ──────────────────────────────────────────── local GRENADE_MAX_ORIGIN_DISTANCE = 14 local function onThrowGrenade(player: Player, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3) -- ... (entire existing body) ... end Packets.ReqThrowGrenade.OnServerEvent:Connect(onThrowGrenade)   with:  -- ──────────────────────────────────────────── -- Authoritative throwables (grenade fuse + C4 manual) -- ──────────────────────────────────────────── local THROW_MAX_ORIGIN_DISTANCE = 14 local function onThrowProjectile(player: Player, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3) local _tool, config = getEquippedWeapon(player) if not config or config.Category ~= "Throwable" then return end local throwable = config :: WeaponTypes.ThrowableWeaponConfig local now = os.clock() if not WeaponValidation.canFire(WeaponState.GetLastFire(player, throwable.ToolName), throwable.CooldownTime, now) then return end local character = player.Character local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? if not character or not root then return end -- Anti-exploit: finite origin near the character (NaN-safe). local originDist = (origin - root.Position).Magnitude if originDist ~= originDist or originDist > THROW_MAX_ORIGIN_DISTANCE then return end -- Reject non-finite / zero-length throw direction before normalizing. local dirMag = direction.Magnitude if dirMag ~= dirMag or dirMag < 1e-4 then return end local unit = direction / dirMag -- Manual (C4): enforce MaxActive before spawning. Yield-free until AddActive below. if throwable.Detonation == "Manual" then local maxActive = throwable.MaxActive or 1 if WeaponState.GetActiveCount(player) >= maxActive then return end end WeaponState.SetLastFire(player, throwable.ToolName, now) local part = ServerProjectile.spawnThrowable( throwable.CosmeticTemplate, origin, unit, throwable.ThrowSpeed, throwable.Rest, { character } ) if not part then return end if throwable.Detonation == "Fuse" then local fuse = throwable.FuseTime or 3 task.delay(fuse, function() if part.Parent == nil then return end local center = part:GetPivot().Position CombatService.ApplyAOE(center, throwable.AOERadius, throwable.AOEDamage, "AOE", player, {}) Packets.ExplosionAt:Fire(center, throwable.AOERadius, throwable.ToolName) part:Destroy() end) else WeaponState.AddActive(player, part) end end local function onDetonate(player: Player) local actives = WeaponState.TakeAllActive(player) local c4 = WeaponConfig.C4 :: WeaponTypes.ThrowableWeaponConfig for _, charge in actives do local part = charge.model if part and part.Parent then local center = part:GetPivot().Position CombatService.ApplyAOE(center, c4.AOERadius, c4.AOEDamage, "AOE", player, {}) Packets.ExplosionAt:Fire(center, c4.AOERadius, c4.ToolName) part:Destroy() end end end Packets.ReqThrowProjectile.OnServerEvent:Connect(onThrowProjectile) Packets.ReqDetonate.OnServerEvent:Connect(onDetonate)    Step 6: Studio verification checkpoint  Deferred — WeaponServer now references Packets.ReqThrowProjectile/ReqDetonate (added in Task 4) and ServerProjectile (Task 1), but the client still sends the old packets until Task 8. searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/ThrowableHandler.luau Step 1: Rewrite the module  Replace the whole file with:  --!strict --[=[ @class ThrowableHandler @client Category handler for thrown weapons (grenade + C4). On activate it gates on the throw cooldown, plays the throw sound, and sends `ReqThrowProjectile`. The projectile instance is server-spawned and replicates to every client (no local cosmetic). For manual-detonation throwables (C4), `OnDetonate` (bound to G by WeaponController) sends `ReqDetonate`. Damage + detonation are server-side. ]=] local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local WeaponValidation = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponValidation")) local WeaponTypes = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes")) local Packets = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Packets")) local SoundManager = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("SoundManager")) local MeleeHandler = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MeleeHandler")) export type HandlerContext = MeleeHandler.HandlerContext local lastThrow: { [string]: number } = {} local ThrowableHandler = {} local function getThrowOriginDir(character: Model, tool: Tool): (Vector3, Vector3) local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") :: BasePart? local origin = handle and handle.Position or character:GetPivot().Position local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera if not camera then -- No camera yet: throw straight along the character's facing. return origin, character:GetPivot().LookVector end local viewport = camera.ViewportSize local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(viewport.X / 2, viewport.Y / 2) -- Bias the throw slightly upward for a natural lob. local direction = (ray.Direction + Vector3.new(0, 0.25, 0)).Unit return origin, direction end function ThrowableHandler.OnEquip(_context: HandlerContext) end function ThrowableHandler.OnActivate(context: HandlerContext) local config = context.config :: WeaponTypes.ThrowableWeaponConfig local now = os.clock() if not WeaponValidation.canFire(lastThrow[config.ToolName] or -math.huge, config.CooldownTime, now) then return end lastThrow[config.ToolName] = now local origin, direction = getThrowOriginDir(context.character, context.tool) SoundManager.PlaySFXAt(config.ThrowSound, origin, { Replicate = true }) Packets.ReqThrowProjectile:Fire(origin, direction) end -- Manual-detonation throwables (C4): bound to G by WeaponController. function ThrowableHandler.OnDetonate(_context: HandlerContext) Packets.ReqDetonate:Fire() end function ThrowableHandler.OnUnequip(_context: HandlerContext) end return ThrowableHandler    Step 2: Studio verification checkpoint  Deferred to Task 12 (server + client must both be on the new protocol). Confirm the file no longer requires ProjectileVisuals and no longer references ReqThrowGrenade.   Step 3: Commit (Haiku)  feat(weapons): ThrowableHandler drives grenade + C4 throw/detonate

Add these rows:  | `ReqThrowProjectile` | `C->S` | RemoteEvent | Throw the equipped throwable (grenade or C4) `(origin: Vector3F32, direction: Vector3F32)`. searchDocs.title: Task 1: Create the NpcCollisionService bootstrap​
searchDocs.pageTitle: NPC Projectile Pass-Through & Tag Consolidation Implementation Plan
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ServerScriptService/NpcCollisionService.server.luau  This is a self-contained server bootstrap modeled on the existing CharacterCollisionService.server.luau (player equivalent). Because there is no unit-test harness, write the complete script, then verify in Studio (Task 4).   Step 1: Write the full script  Create src/ServerScriptService/NpcCollisionService.server.luau with exactly this content:  --!strict --[=[ @class NpcCollisionService @server Places every BasePart of every `"NPC"`-tagged Model into the `Character` collision group (see CollisionGroups), so thrown charges (`WeaponProjectile`) and dropped materials (`DroppedMaterial`) pass through NPCs exactly as they pass through players. This is the non-player sibling of CharacterCollisionService: players are handled by Players events there, NPCs are handled by the CollectionService `"NPC"` tag here. The same `"NPC"` tag also gates direct Humanoid damage in CombatService, so a single tag makes a Model both projectile-pass-through and damageable. Parts that stream in after tagging (R15 limbs, accessories) are caught via a per-model `DescendantAdded` connection owned by a per-model Janitor. The Janitor is torn down when the tag is removed OR the model is destroyed — `GetInstanceRemovedSignal` fires in both cases, so no separate `Destroying` backstop is needed. ]=] local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage") local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages:WaitForChild("Janitor")) local CollisionGroups = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("CollisionGroups")) local NPC_TAG = "NPC" -- One Janitor per watched model, holding that model's DescendantAdded connection. local watched: { [Model]: Janitor.Janitor } = {} local function assign(instance: Instance) if instance:IsA("BasePart") then instance.CollisionGroup = CollisionGroups.Character end end local function watchModel(model: Model) if watched[model] then return end for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do assign(descendant) end local janitor = Janitor.new() janitor:Add(model.DescendantAdded:Connect(assign), "Disconnect") watched[model] = janitor end local function unwatchModel(model: Model) local janitor = watched[model] if janitor then janitor:Destroy() watched[model] = nil end end -- Connect the add/remove signals BEFORE iterating existing tagged instances, so a -- tag applied during startup is never missed. CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(NPC_TAG):Connect(function(instance) if instance:IsA("Model") then watchModel(instance) end end) CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(NPC_TAG):Connect(function(instance) if instance:IsA("Model") then unwatchModel(instance) end end) for _, instance in CollectionService:GetTagged(NPC_TAG) do if instance:IsA("Model") then watchModel(instance) end end    Step 2: Commit  git add "src/ServerScriptService/NpcCollisionService.server.luau" git commit -m "feat(combat): assign NPC-tagged models to Character collision group"

searchDocs.title: Task 1: Create the TrajectoryPreview module (full implementation)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/TrajectoryPreview.luau  This is a self-contained module. Because there is no unit-test harness, write the complete module, then verify in Studio (Task 3). The module is small enough to land in one task.   Step 1: Write the full module  Create src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/TrajectoryPreview.luau with exactly this content:  --!strict --[=[ @class TrajectoryPreview @client Client-only predictive arc for thrown weapons (Grenade, C4). While a throwable is equipped, `show` starts a RenderStepped loop that recomputes the ballistic parabola each frame from the live camera + handle, raycasts each segment to stop at real geometry, and positions a fixed pool of reused green neon parts plus a landing marker. The arc starts at the SAME offset point the server spawns the real clone (SPAWN_OFFSET) and uses the SAME upward aim bias as ThrowableHandler, so the preview matches the projectile's actual free-flight path. Purely cosmetic and local — no networking. `hide` tears the whole pool down via one Janitor. ]=] local Players = game:GetService("Players") local RunService = game:GetService("RunService") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages:WaitForChild("Janitor")) local WeaponTypes = require(ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("WeaponTypes")) -- Must match ServerProjectile.SPAWN_OFFSET so the arc starts where the real clone spawns. local SPAWN_OFFSET = 2.5 -- Must match getThrowOriginDir's upward lob bias in ThrowableHandler. local AIM_BIAS = Vector3.new(0, 0.25, 0) -- 20 sample points -> 19 segments between them. local SAMPLE_COUNT = 20 local SEGMENT_COUNT = SAMPLE_COUNT - 1 -- Fixed flight-time horizon. The raycast truncates the arc at real geometry, so this -- only needs to be "long enough" for the longest throw — never computed analytically -- (an analytic 2*vy/g estimate collapses to ~0 when aiming downward). local HORIZON = 4.0 local SEGMENT_THICKNESS = 0.18 local ARC_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 140) local MARKER_SIZE = 1.6 local MARKER_THICKNESS = 0.1 -- Raycasts behave as if cast from this collision group, so they pass through player -- characters exactly like the real projectile (WeaponProjectile vs Character = false). local PROJECTILE_GROUP = "WeaponProjectile" local player = Players.LocalPlayer local TrajectoryPreview = {} -- Active-session state. Nil when nothing is showing. local janitor: Janitor.Janitor? = nil local folder: Folder? = nil local segments: { BasePart } = {} local marker: BasePart? = nil local raycastParams: RaycastParams? = nil local function makeSegment(parent: Instance): BasePart local part = Instance.new("Part") part.Anchored = true part.CanCollide = false part.CanQuery = false part.CanTouch = false part.CastShadow = false part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon part.Color = ARC_COLOR part.Size = Vector3.new(SEGMENT_THICKNESS, SEGMENT_THICKNESS, 1) part.Transparency = 1 part.Parent = parent return part end local function makeMarker(parent: Instance): BasePart local part = Instance.new("Part") part.Anchored = true part.CanCollide = false part.CanQuery = false part.CanTouch = false part.CastShadow = false part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon part.Color = ARC_COLOR part.Size = Vector3.new(MARKER_SIZE, MARKER_SIZE, MARKER_THICKNESS) part.Transparency = 1 part.Parent = parent return part end -- Hide every segment + the marker (used when we can't compute an arc this frame). local function hideAll() for _, seg in segments do seg.Transparency = 1 end if marker then marker.Transparency = 1 end end -- Place one segment spanning a->b and reveal it. local function placeSegment(seg: BasePart, a: Vector3, b: Vector3) local delta = b - a local length = delta.Magnitude if length < 1e-3 then seg.Transparency = 1 return end seg.Size = Vector3.new(SEGMENT_THICKNESS, SEGMENT_THICKNESS, length) seg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(a, b) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -length / 2) seg.Transparency = 0 end -- One frame: recompute origin/direction, sample the parabola, raycast-truncate, -- position the pool. `character`/`tool` captured by the show() closure. local function render(config: WeaponTypes.ThrowableWeaponConfig, character: Model, tool: Tool) local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") :: BasePart? if not camera or not character.Parent or not handle then hideAll() return end local viewport = camera.ViewportSize local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(viewport.X / 2, viewport.Y / 2) local direction = (ray.Direction + AIM_BIAS).Unit local startPos = handle.Position + direction * SPAWN_OFFSET local velocity = direction * config.ThrowSpeed local accel = Vector3.new(0, -workspace.Gravity, 0) local dt = HORIZON / SEGMENT_COUNT -- Sample the parabola: pos(t) = start + v*t + 0.5*a*t^2. local points: { Vector3 } = table.create(SAMPLE_COUNT) for i = 0, SEGMENT_COUNT do local t = i * dt points[i + 1] = startPos + velocity * t + 0.5 * accel * (t * t) end -- Walk segments in order; raycast each. First hit truncates the arc. local hitResult: RaycastResult? = nil local hitSegment: number? = nil for i = 1, SEGMENT_COUNT do local a = points[i] local b = points[i + 1] local result = workspace:Raycast(a, b - a, raycastParams) if result then hitResult = result hitSegment = i placeSegment(segments[i], a, result.Position) break end placeSegment(segments[i], a, b) end -- Hide every segment past the truncation point (if any). if hitSegment then for i = (hitSegment :: number) + 1, SEGMENT_COUNT do segments[i].Transparency = 1 end end -- Landing marker: at the hit (flat on the surface) or at the last sample. if marker then if hitResult then marker.CFrame = CFrame.lookAlong(hitResult.Position, hitResult.Normal) marker.Transparency = 0 else marker.CFrame = CFrame.new(points[SAMPLE_COUNT]) marker.Transparency = 0 end end end --[=[ @within TrajectoryPreview Start showing the arc for an equipped throwable. Idempotent: a second call tears the previous session down first. Captures `character`/`tool` for the per-frame origin + raycast filtering. ]=] function TrajectoryPreview.show(config: WeaponTypes.ThrowableWeaponConfig, character: Model, tool: Tool) TrajectoryPreview.hide() local jan = Janitor.new() janitor = jan local f = Instance.new("Folder") f.Name = "TrajectoryPreview" f.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera or workspace jan:Add(f, "Destroy") folder = f segments = table.create(SEGMENT_COUNT) for i = 1, SEGMENT_COUNT do segments[i] = makeSegment(f) end marker = makeMarker(f) local params = RaycastParams.new() params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, f } params.CollisionGroup = PROJECTILE_GROUP params.RespectCanCollide = true raycastParams = params jan:Add(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function() render(config, character, tool) end), "Disconnect") -- Clear module-level references when the Janitor is destroyed. jan:Add(function() segments = {} marker = nil folder = nil raycastParams = nil end, true) end --[=[ @within TrajectoryPreview Stop showing the arc and destroy the whole pool. Safe to call when nothing is showing. ]=] function TrajectoryPreview.hide() if janitor then janitor:Destroy() janitor = nil end end return TrajectoryPreview    Step 2: Commit  git add "src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeaponHandlers/TrajectoryPreview.luau" git commit -m "feat(weapons): add client TrajectoryPreview module for throwables"

searchDocs.title: Task 4: CoinManager (server authority)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/CoinManager.luau  Depends on Task 1 (CoinConfig) and Task 2 (CoinStateSync packet).   Step 1: Create the manager module  --!strict --[=[ @class CoinManager @server Place-agnostic authority for the player coin wallet. Owns the PlayerCoins ProfileStore profile lifecycle (one session per player, key = UserId), the earn/spend/read API, and per-player replication via `CoinStateSync`. Runs in BOTH the lobby and gameplay places. Coin *sources* (gameplay-session completion, daily/weekly challenges) and *sinks* (shop) are SEPARATE systems that call `AddCoins` / `DeductCoins`; they are not part of this module. Cross-place: `STORE_NAME` + `tostring(UserId)` key are identical in every place of the universe, so the same DataStore record is shared. ProfileStore session-locking serializes the lobby↔gameplay teleport handoff automatically. ]=] local Players = game:GetService("Players") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local CoinConfig = require(SharedModules.Configs:WaitForChild("CoinConfig")) local Packets = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("Packets")) local ProfileStore = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules:WaitForChild("ProfileStore")) local PROFILE_TEMPLATE = { Coins = CoinConfig.STARTING_BALANCE, } local PlayerStore = ProfileStore.New(CoinConfig.STORE_NAME, PROFILE_TEMPLATE) local Profiles: { [Player]: any } = {} local CoinManager = {} local initialized = false -- Fire the current balance to one player. local function replicate(player: Player) local profile = Profiles[player] if not profile then return end Packets.CoinStateSync:FireClient(player, profile.Data.Coins) end --[=[ @within CoinManager Return the player's current coin balance, or 0 if the profile is not loaded. ]=] function CoinManager.GetCoins(player: Player): number local profile = Profiles[player] if not profile then return 0 end return profile.Data.Coins end --[=[ @within CoinManager Award `amount` coins to a single player. No-op if `amount <= 0` or the profile is not loaded. Clamps the new balance to `CoinConfig.MAX_BALANCE`, then replicates. `reason` is an optional source tag recorded in the server log only (e.g. "DailyChallenge", "SessionComplete"). ]=] function CoinManager.AddCoins(player: Player, amount: number, reason: string?) if amount <= 0 then return end local profile = Profiles[player] if not profile then return end local newBalance = math.min(profile.Data.Coins + amount, CoinConfig.MAX_BALANCE) profile.Data.Coins = newBalance if reason then print(("[CoinManager] +%d coins to %s (%s) → %d"):format(amount, player.Name, reason, newBalance)) end replicate(player) end --[=[ @within CoinManager Atomically deduct `amount` coins from a single player. Returns `true` on success. Returns `false` with **no mutation** if `amount <= 0`, the profile is not loaded, or the balance is insufficient. This is the contract a future shop relies on. ]=] function CoinManager.DeductCoins(player: Player, amount: number): boolean if amount <= 0 then return false end local profile = Profiles[player] if not profile then return false end if profile.Data.Coins < amount then return false end profile.Data.Coins -= amount replicate(player) return true end local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player) local profile = PlayerStore:StartSessionAsync(tostring(player.UserId), { Cancel = function() return player.Parent ~= Players end, }) if profile == nil then player:Kick("Coin profile failed to load — please rejoin.") return end profile:AddUserId(player.UserId) -- GDPR compliance profile:Reconcile() -- fill missing fields from PROFILE_TEMPLATE profile.OnSessionEnd:Connect(function() Profiles[player] = nil player:Kick("Coin profile session ended — please rejoin.") end) if player.Parent == Players then Profiles[player] = profile replicate(player) else -- Player left before the session started. profile:EndSession() end end --[=[ @within CoinManager Wire up the profile lifecycle. Call exactly once per server (from a loader). ]=] function CoinManager.Initialize() if initialized then return end initialized = true -- Players who joined before this script ran. for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player) end Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded) Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) local profile = Profiles[player] if profile then profile:EndSession() end end) end return CoinManager    Step 2: Verify load + API behavior in a running playtest  Press F5 (Play Solo) so a profile loads for your player, then in the command bar (Server context) run:  local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage") local CoinManager = require(ServerStorage.SharedModules.CoinManager) local p = game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] print("start:", CoinManager.GetCoins(p)) -- 0 CoinManager.AddCoins(p, 250, "ManualTest") print("after add:", CoinManager.GetCoins(p)) -- 250 print("deduct 100:", CoinManager.DeductCoins(p, 100)) -- true print("after deduct:", CoinManager.GetCoins(p)) -- 150 print("overdraw 999:", CoinManager.DeductCoins(p, 999)) -- false print("unchanged:", CoinManager.GetCoins(p)) -- 150 print("zero add:", CoinManager.AddCoins(p, 0)) -- no-op (nil)   Expected: 0, 250, true, 150, false, 150. The "ManualTest" reason line prints once.   Step 3: Commit (use Haiku)  git add src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/CoinManager.luau git commit -m "feat(economy): add CoinManager wallet authority"

searchDocs.title: Task 7: Documentation​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Modify: docs/reference/networking-map.md (append one row to the packet table) Modify: docs/reference/signals-map.md (append one row to the signal table) Create: docs/systems/economy.md Step 1: Add the networking-map row  Append this row to the end of the packet table in docs/reference/networking-map.md (immediately after the XPLevelUp row, which is currently the last row):  | `CoinStateSync` | `S->C` | RemoteEvent | Authoritative coin balance to the owning client `(balance: U32)`. Sent on profile load and every balance change; bridged to `Signals.OnCoinsChanged` by `CoinController`. |    Step 2: Add the signals-map row  Append this row to the end of the signal table in docs/reference/signals-map.md (immediately after the OnXPChanged row, currently the last row):  | `OnCoinsChanged` | `CoinController` (on `CoinStateSync`) | *(reserved for a future coin HUD)* | Coin balance update `(balance)`. `Signal<number>`. |    Step 3: Create the economy system page  Create docs/systems/economy.md:  --- sidebar_position: 99 --- # Economy (Coins) Server-authoritative coin wallet persisted with **ProfileStore**, in a profile separate from XP. The balance is shared across the lobby and gameplay places. ## Data model The `PlayerCoins` profile stores a single value, `Coins`. `STORE_NAME` (`"PlayerCoins"`) and the `UserId` key are identical in every place of the universe, so the lobby and gameplay share one DataStore record; ProfileStore session-locking serializes the teleport handoff. All bounds live in `Configs/CoinConfig.luau` (`STARTING_BALANCE`, `MAX_BALANCE`). ## API (server-authoritative) `CoinManager` (ServerStorage) is the sole authority: - `CoinManager.GetCoins(player): number` — current balance, `0` if no profile. - `CoinManager.AddCoins(player, amount, reason?)` — award coins; no-op if `amount <= 0` or no profile; clamps to `MAX_BALANCE`. `reason` is an optional source tag logged server-side. - `CoinManager.DeductCoins(player, amount): boolean` — atomic spend; returns `false` with no mutation on `amount <= 0`, missing profile, or insufficient funds. - `CoinManager.Initialize()` — wires the profile lifecycle; called once by `CoinSystemLoader` in both places. ## Replication Every successful mutation fires `CoinStateSync (balance: U32)` to the owning client. `CoinController` re-fires it as `Signals.OnCoinsChanged(balance)` for a future coin HUD. There is no client→server packet — earning and spending are fully server-driven. ## Out of scope (future work) Earning sources (gameplay-session completion, daily/weekly challenges), sinks (shop + purchase packet), and the coin HUD are separate systems that call the `CoinManager` API; they are not part of the wallet module.    Step 4: Verify the docs render (optional, no build required)  Visual check only — confirm the two appended rows align with the existing table columns and economy.md has valid front-matter. (Do not run moonwave dev/rojo build unless you want to; not required for this plan.)   Step 5: Commit (use Haiku)  git add docs/reference/networking-map.md docs/reference/signals-map.md docs/systems/economy.md git commit -m "docs(economy): document coin wallet, packet, and signal"

searchDocs.content: Run a full Play Solo session and confirm, in order:  Fresh balance — a new player's GetCoins returns STARTING_BALANCE (0).Earn — AddCoins(p, N, "test") raises the balance by N and the client OnCoinsChanged fires with the new total.Guarded spend — DeductCoins succeeds when funded (returns true, balance drops) and fails cleanly when underfunded (returns false, balance unchanged).Clamp — AddCoins(p, CoinConfig.MAX_BALANCE + 1000) caps at MAX_BALANCE.Persistence — stop, re-enter Play Solo, and confirm the balance restored (Studio uses a mock DataStore; the value persists within the session's store). For real persistence, verify in a published place test.Cross-place (if feasible) — teleport lobby↔gameplay and confirm the same balance and a clean session handoff (no double-lock kick).  All six pass ⇒ the wallet module is complete and the earner/shop systems can build on CoinManager.

searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: docs/systems/tech-tree.md Read for accuracy (do not modify): src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/TechTreeConfig.luau, src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/TechTreeState.luau, src/ServerScriptService/TechTreeService.server.luau, src/ServerScriptService/TechEffectsDispatcher.server.luau, src/ServerStorage/SharedModules/MaterialEjector.luau, src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/TechTreeGuiController.client.luau Reference for style: docs/systems/train-fuel.md, docs/systems/shredder.md Step 1: Read the source modules to confirm current behavior  Read each of the six source files listed above. Specifically confirm before writing:  TechTreeState exported function names and signatures (the page names them): expect isUnlocked, isEligible, remaining, validateSubmit. Use the actual names found.TechTreeService packet handler names and the unlock/cancel sequence (consume Tools → pool delta → OnNodeUnlocked → broadcast; cancel → MaterialEjector.Eject).MaterialEjector public function name + signature (expect Eject(benchModel, counts) — confirm).The result codes in src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/TechTreeResultCodes.luau (used in the Gotchas, e.g. ALREADY_UNLOCKED, NOTHING_TO_REFUND).  If any actual name differs from the expected name above, use the actual one and note the discrepancy in the final report.   Step 2: Write docs/systems/tech-tree.md  Frontmatter and title:  --- sidebar_position: 13 --- # Tech Tree   Author these sections (prose in the train-fuel.md voice; all data below is verified and must appear):  Intro (2–4 sentences): Cooperative, server-wide, session-only (no DataStore) tech tree. Players pool crafted materials (Wood/Metal) into nodes at one fixed bench. Eligibility is always-open (any node whose prereq is unlocked and which is not yet unlocked accepts submissions); a node auto-unlocks the instant its full cost is met. Because refunds go to a shared ground pile, there is no per-player contribution tracking — one shared pool per node.  ## Data flow — ASCII diagram, Server column ↔ Client column, packet names on arrows. Cover four flows:  Submit: GUI stepper → ReqTechSubmit(nodeId, materialType, amount) → server validates proximity (INTERACT_DISTANCE + INTERACT_DISTANCE_TOLERANCE) + TechTreeState.validateSubmit + player actually holds amount Tools → consume exactly amount → pools[id][mat] += amount → if every material now meets cost: clear pool, unlocked[id]=true, fire OnNodeUnlocked, broadcast TechNodeUpdate(..., isUnlocked=true); else broadcast updated counts → respond (success, reasonCode).Auto-unlock effect: OnNodeUnlocked(nodeId) → TechEffectsDispatcher reads Effect from config → applies it (StatBuff wired; others warn + no-op) → next tier lights up because isEligible now passes.Cancel: ReqTechCancel(nodeId) → validate proximity + pool > 0 → snapshot + zero pool → broadcast TechNodeUpdate(..., 0, 0, false) → MaterialEjector.Eject(bench, snapshot) arcs materials to a ProximityPickup floor pile. Node stays open.Join: client → ReqTechSnapshot() → server returns full { unlocked, pools }.  ## Client / Server / Shared — one bold-headed paragraph each:  Shared — TechTreeState.luau (pure validator; single rule source — client greys buttons, server authorizes; the four functions confirmed in Step 1).Server — TechTreeService.server.luau (owns unlocked / pools, handles ReqTechSubmit / ReqTechCancel / ReqTechSnapshot, consumes Tools, fires OnNodeUnlocked, broadcasts deltas).Server — TechEffectsDispatcher.server.luau (connects OnNodeUnlocked; switches on Effect.Type; one StatBuff wired; unknown types warn + no-op so future nodes are declarable now).Server — MaterialEjector.luau (shared mechanism: MotionMaster.SplineMove arc from the bench TrajectoryPoints → registers each piece with ProximityPickupServer, auto-collect fallback; no tech-tree knowledge).Client — TechTreeGuiController.client.luau (drives authored StarterGui.TechTreeGui, proximity-opens, steppers max = min(held, remaining), repaints on OnTechTreeStateChanged; server is truth).  ## Key files — bullet list:  src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/TechTreeConfig.luausrc/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/TechTreeState.luausrc/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/TechTreeResultCodes.luausrc/ServerScriptService/TechTreeService.server.luausrc/ServerScriptService/TechEffectsDispatcher.server.luausrc/ServerStorage/SharedModules/MaterialEjector.luausrc/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/TechTreeGuiController.client.luau  ## Studio setup — one Model tagged TechTreeBench with PrimaryPart set; child Model TrajectoryPoints (tagged PlacementIgnore) holding SpawnPoint + LandingPoint BaseParts (refund arc); child BasePart TechPromptPart holding a ProximityPrompt; ReplicatedStorage/CraftingMaterials holds Wood + Metal Tool templates (shared with the Shredder).  ## Config knobs — verbatim table (defaults from TechTreeConfig.luau):  | Field | Default | Effect | |---|---|---| | `BENCH_TAG` | `"TechTreeBench"` | CollectionService tag on the bench Model | | `INTERACT_DISTANCE` | `12` | Studs within which the GUI opens / submits are accepted | | `INTERACT_DISTANCE_TOLERANCE` | `5` | Server-side slack added to the distance check | | `TRAJECTORY_MODEL_NAME` | `"TrajectoryPoints"` | Child Model holding the refund-arc endpoints | | `SPAWN_POINT_NAME` | `"SpawnPoint"` | Arc start (output mouth) BasePart name | | `LANDING_POINT_NAME` | `"LandingPoint"` | Arc end (floor) BasePart name | | `PROMPT_PART_NAME` | `"TechPromptPart"` | Child BasePart holding the open-GUI `ProximityPrompt` | | `MATERIALS_FOLDER` | `"CraftingMaterials"` | ReplicatedStorage folder of Wood/Metal Tool templates | | `DROPPED_FOLDER_NAME` | `"DroppedMaterials"` | Workspace folder for refunded pieces (reuses Shredder's) | | `ARC_DURATION` | `0.55` | Seconds per refunded-piece arc | | `ARC_HEIGHT_BOOST` | `5` | Extra arc apex height (studs) | | `LANDING_SCATTER_RADIUS` | `1.5` | Random landing spread around `LandingPoint` | | `ITEM_EJECT_DELAY` | `0.06` | Stagger between animated ejected pieces | | `MAX_ANIMATED_EJECT_ITEMS` | `60` | Cap on animated pieces; beyond this, direct-grant | | `DIRECT_GRANT_BATCH_SIZE` | `25` | Batch size for the non-animated overflow path | | `AUTO_COLLECT_DELAY` | `45` | Seconds before un-collected refund pile auto-collects |   Plus a sentence describing the Nodes schema: each node has Branch, Tier, DisplayName, Description, Cost (material→amount), Prereq (prior-tier nodeId or nil at T1), and Effect ({ Type, ... }). Mention the shipped example nodes Durability_T1 / Durability_T2 (StatBuff MaxHP, wired) and Fuel_T1 (FuelEfficiency, declared but dispatcher no-ops for now).  ## Gotchas — :::caution blocks + prose:  Server re-checks proximity on every submit/cancel; client GUI proximity is never trusted. Over-submission is clamped server-side (validateSubmit rejects amount that would exceed remaining) — the stepper max is enforced authoritatively, not just in UI. Validate-then-consume: the server counts the player's Tools first and consumes nothing on rejection. Concurrent last-unit submit: server events are single-threaded; the second submit sees the node already unlocked → ALREADY_UNLOCKED, consumes nothing. Effect idempotency: the unlocked guard means OnNodeUnlocked fires exactly once per node — StatBuff cannot double-apply. TechNodeUpdate is typed to the two current materials (metalSubmitted, woodSubmitted); adding a third craft material requires widening this packet (to an Any material→count map). Cancel with an empty pool is rejected (NOTHING_TO_REFUND), no arc. Missing bench / TrajectoryPoints degrades gracefully (drop at origin), never errors the cancel. Step 3: Verify structure and accuracy  Run: grep -nE "^#|^##|sidebar_position" docs/systems/tech-tree.mdExpected: sidebar_position: 13, # Tech Tree, and the six ## sections (Data flow, Client / Server / Shared, Key files, Studio setup, Config knobs, Gotchas).  Run: grep -nE "ReqTechSubmit|ReqTechCancel|TechNodeUpdate|ReqTechSnapshot|OnNodeUnlocked|OnTechTreeStateChanged" docs/systems/tech-tree.mdExpected: all four packets and both signals appear.  Cross-check: re-open TechTreeConfig.luau and confirm every default in the Config knobs table matches the source exactly. Fix any mismatch.   Step 4: Commit  git add docs/systems/tech-tree.md git commit -m "docs(systems): add Tech Tree system page"

Step 2: Write docs/systems/weapons.md  Frontmatter and title:  --- sidebar_position: 14 --- # Weapons   Sections (health.md / train-fuel.md voice; data below verified):  Intro: Client-predicts / server-authoritative combat with a shared validator (WeaponValidation). All damage is applied server-side; client hit claims are never trusted. Weapons are Roblox Tools equipped from the Backpack; the server infers the weapon from the equipped Tool, so fire packets carry only origin/direction.  ## Categories — verbatim table (from WeaponConfig.luau):  | Category | Weapons | Delivery | Damage type | |---|---|---|---| | Melee | ClassicSword (combo: 3 hits + finisher) | server re-runs hitbox from server CFrame | `Melee` | | Gun (hitscan) | Pistol, SMG, AR, SR | server `workspace:Raycast`, server hit wins | `Bullet` | | Gun (projectile) | RocketLauncher | server-owned replicated `ServerProjectile`; AOE on impact | `AOE` | | Throwable (fuse) | Grenade | replicated `ServerProjectile`, bounces, AOE on fuse expiry | `AOE` | | Throwable (manual) | C4 | replicated `ServerProjectile`, sticks; AOE on `ReqDetonate` | `AOE` |   ## Data flow — ASCII, Server ↔ Client, packet names on arrows. Cover:  Melee: input → canFire gate → swing anim (MotionMaster) + predicted FX → ReqMeleeSwing(aimDir) → server fire-rate (WeaponState) + meleeHitbox from server CFrame → CombatService.ApplyHit (Melee) → broadcast WeaponImpact.Hitscan gun: canFire + local ammo predict → muzzle flash + tracer → ReqFireWeapon(origin, dir) → server validates fire-rate + ammo + origin tolerance + spread bound → workspace:Raycast capped at MaxDistance → CombatService.ApplyHit (Bullet, ×HeadshotMultiplier on Head) → broadcast WeaponFired + WeaponAmmoSync to owner.Rocket / Throwable: ReqFireWeapon (rocket) / ReqThrowProjectile(origin, dir) (grenade, C4) → server validates → spawns replicated ServerProjectile → on impact/fuse CombatService.ApplyAOE (aoeFalloff to AOERadius) → broadcast ExplosionAt.C4 detonate: ReqDetonate() → server detonates all of that player's active C4, AOE per charge, destroys instances.  ## Client / Server / Shared — bold-headed paragraphs:  Client — WeaponController.client.luau (watches equipped Tool, reads WeaponConfig[name].Category, owns input/lifecycle, dispatches to a handler).Client — WeaponHandlers/ (MeleeHandler combo stepping, GunHandler hitscan + rocket cosmetic + ammo prediction, ThrowableHandler grenade/C4, TrajectoryPreview client-local green-neon arc while a throwable is equipped — no packets).Client — WeaponEffectsController.client.luau (consumes WeaponFired / WeaponImpact / ExplosionAt; ignores the local shooter, who draws its own tracer).Shared — WeaponValidation.luau (pure math both sides run; functions confirmed in Step 1).Server — WeaponServer.server.luau (receives packets, per-category validation, applies damage).Server — CombatService.luau (damage router: Player → HealthManager.ApplyDamage, "NPC"-tagged Humanoid → direct, else ignore; friendly-fire prevention).Server — WeaponState.luau (per-player authoritative mag / reserve / cooldown / reload window).Server — ServerProjectile.luau (server-owned replicated physics projectile for rocket / grenade / C4).  ## HUD integration contract — state plainly: this system ships no UI. A HUD consumes WeaponAmmoSync (packet) plus client signals WeaponEquipped, WeaponUnequipped, WeaponAmmoChanged, WeaponReloadStarted, WeaponReloadComplete, WeaponLocalHit, WeaponComboChanged. Link to Signals Map.  ## Key files — bullet every module read in Step 1 with a one-line role.  ## Config knobs — describe WeaponConfig as the per-weapon registry (tuning lives here, never in code). Give the field groups verbatim:  Common: Category, DisplayName, ToolName, Damage, DamageType, HeadshotMultiplier?.Melee: Range, HitboxSize, SwingSound, ImpactSound, SwingAnimId?, Combos (Primary.Steps[] each { Recovery, ChainWindow, Damage?, Range? }, ResetCooldown).Gun: FireMode ("Hitscan" / "Projectile"), RPM, Automatic, MagazineSize, ReserveMax, ReloadTime, Spread, MaxDistance, FireSound, ReloadSound, DrySound, ImpactSound; projectile adds ProjectileSpeed, Gravity, AOERadius, AOEDamage, CosmeticTemplate.Throwable: Detonation ("Fuse" / "Manual"), Rest ("Bounce" / "Stick"), ThrowSpeed, FuseTime (fuse), MaxActive (manual), AOERadius, AOEDamage, CarryCount, CooldownTime, CosmeticTemplate, ThrowSound, ExplodeSound.  Include a short "shipped weapons at a glance" table with the standout stats (verify each against WeaponConfig.luau):  | Weapon | Category | Damage | RPM / Fuse | Mag / Carry | AOE | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | ClassicSword | Melee | 25 (45 finisher) | — | — | — | | Pistol | Gun (hitscan) | 18 | 360 | 12 / 72 | — | | SMG | Gun (hitscan) | 14 | 850 | 30 / 180 | — | | AR | Gun (hitscan) | 22 | 600 | 30 / 150 | — | | SR | Gun (hitscan) | 90 | 45 | 5 / 30 | — | | RocketLauncher | Gun (projectile) | AOE only | 40 | 1 / 8 | 85 @ r18 | | Grenade | Throwable (fuse) | AOE only | 3.0s fuse | carry 3 | 75 @ r16 | | C4 | Throwable (manual) | AOE only | manual | carry 6, 4 active | 120 @ r22 |   ## Gotchas / anti-exploit — :::caution + prose:  Server enforces fire-rate (60/RPM for guns, melee ChainWindow/Recovery/ResetCooldown); early requests dropped. Ammo + reload timing are server-authoritative (WeaponState); fire at empty mag rejected; mid-reload fire rejected. Claimed origin must be within tolerance of the player's muzzle/character; spread dir must lie within Spread of aim; hitscan acceptance + ray length capped at MaxDistance. LOS is implicit (server does its own cast). Friendly-fire prevention: players do not damage teammates (confirm exact rule in CombatService). NPC pass-through: the "NPC" CollectionService tag both gates Humanoid damage and places NPC parts in the Character collision group so thrown charges pass through (see NpcCollisionService). No tag → no damage, no pass-through. HealthManager mirrors its record → Humanoid.Health but does not read Humanoid → record; route player damage through HealthManager.ApplyDamage (via CombatService), never raw Humanoid writes. Server re-checks bench proximity + `TechTreeState.validateSubmit` + that the player holds `amount` Tools, then consumes exactly that many. Returns `(success: Boolean8, reason: NumberU8)` (`TechTreeResultCodes`). On full funding the node auto-unlocks. | | `ReqTechCancel` | `C->S` (response) | RemoteFunction | Cancel a node's funding `(nodeId: String)` — anyone at the bench may cancel. Refunds the pooled materials as a `ProximityPickup` ground pile via `MaterialEjector`. Returns `(success: Boolean8, reason: NumberU8)`. | | `TechNodeUpdate` | `S->All` | RemoteEvent | Per-node delta broadcast on every change `(nodeId: String, metalSubmitted: NumberU16, woodSubmitted: NumberU16, isUnlocked: Boolean8)`. Typed to the two current materials; widens if a third is added. | | `ReqTechSnapshot` | `C->S` (response) | RemoteFunction | Request the full tech-tree snapshot on GUI init / join. No payload. Returns `(state: Any)` — serialized `{ unlocked, pools }`. |    Step 2: Add the 2 Tech Tree signal rows to signals-map.md  Append to the signal table (| Signal | Producer | Consumers | Purpose |). Fires exactly once per node (guarded by the `unlocked` set). | | `OnTechTreeStateChanged` | `TechTreeGuiController` (client, when cached tree state changes) | `TechTreeGuiController` (repaints the authored `TechTreeGui`) | Client-side repaint trigger for the Tech Tree GUI. |    Step 3: Add the WeaponConfig + TechTreeConfig rows to config-map.md  Append to the config table (| Config | Primary Controls |):  | `WeaponConfig` | Per-weapon registry keyed by Tool name: category, damage + `DamageType`, melee combo steps (`Recovery`/`ChainWindow`/finisher), gun fire-rate (`RPM`/`Automatic`)/ammo (`MagazineSize`/`ReserveMax`/`ReloadTime`)/`Spread`/`MaxDistance`/`HeadshotMultiplier`, projectile + throwable AOE (`AOERadius`/`AOEDamage`), `FuseTime`/`Detonation`/`CarryCount`/`MaxActive`, and per-weapon SoundConfig keys. searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/Configs/TechTreeConfig.luau Step 1: Write the config module.  --!strict -- ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ -- │ TechTreeConfig │ -- │ All tunable constants + node/branch definitions for the Tech Tree. │ -- │ │ -- │ Studio Setup Required: │ -- │ 1. One Model tagged "TechTreeBench" with its PrimaryPart set. │ -- │ 2. A child Model "TrajectoryPoints" (tag "PlacementIgnore") with │ -- │ BaseParts "SpawnPoint" (output mouth) and "LandingPoint" (floor) │ -- │ for the refund arc. │ -- │ 3. A child BasePart "TechPromptPart" holding a ProximityPrompt used │ -- │ to open the GUI. │ -- │ 4. ReplicatedStorage/CraftingMaterials must hold "Wood" and "Metal" │ -- │ Tool templates (shared with the Shredder). │ -- └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ export type Effect = { Type: string, [string]: any } export type Node = { Branch: string, Tier: number, DisplayName: string, Description: string, Cost: { [string]: number }, -- material ItemType -> amount Prereq: string?, -- nodeId of the prior tier, or nil for tier 1 Effect: Effect, } local TechTreeConfig = {} -- [[ BENCH / INTERACTION ]] TechTreeConfig.BENCH_TAG = "TechTreeBench" TechTreeConfig.INTERACT_DISTANCE = 12 TechTreeConfig.INTERACT_DISTANCE_TOLERANCE = 5 -- [[ TRAJECTORY (refund arc) ]] TechTreeConfig.TRAJECTORY_MODEL_NAME = "TrajectoryPoints" TechTreeConfig.SPAWN_POINT_NAME = "SpawnPoint" TechTreeConfig.LANDING_POINT_NAME = "LandingPoint" TechTreeConfig.PROMPT_PART_NAME = "TechPromptPart" -- [[ MATERIAL TEMPLATES ]] TechTreeConfig.MATERIALS_FOLDER = "CraftingMaterials" TechTreeConfig.DROPPED_FOLDER_NAME = "DroppedMaterials" -- reuse the Shredder's folder -- [[ REFUND ARC TUNING ]] (mirrors ShredderConfig semantics) TechTreeConfig.ARC_DURATION = 0.55 TechTreeConfig.ARC_HEIGHT_BOOST = 5 TechTreeConfig.LANDING_SCATTER_RADIUS = 1.5 TechTreeConfig.ITEM_EJECT_DELAY = 0.06 TechTreeConfig.MAX_ANIMATED_EJECT_ITEMS = 60 TechTreeConfig.DIRECT_GRANT_BATCH_SIZE = 25 TechTreeConfig.AUTO_COLLECT_DELAY = 45 -- [[ NODES ]] -- Linear tiers: a node's Prereq is the prior tier in its branch (or nil at T1). TechTreeConfig.Nodes = { Durability_T1 = { Branch = "Durability", Tier = 1, DisplayName = "Scrap Plating", Description = "Adds +50 Max HP to the ship core.", Cost = { Metal = 25 }, Prereq = nil, Effect = { Type = "StatBuff", Stat = "MaxHP", Amount = 50 }, }, Durability_T2 = { Branch = "Durability", Tier = 2, DisplayName = "Iron Barricades", Description = "Adds +150 Max HP.", Cost = { Metal = 100 }, Prereq = "Durability_T1", Effect = { Type = "StatBuff", Stat = "MaxHP", Amount = 150 }, }, Fuel_T1 = { Branch = "Fuel", Tier = 1, DisplayName = "Combustion Engine", Description = "Improves fuel efficiency (wired in a later spec).", Cost = { Metal = 80, Wood = 10 }, Prereq = nil, Effect = { Type = "FuelEfficiency", Multiplier = 2 }, -- declared; dispatcher no-ops for now }, } :: { [string]: Node } return TechTreeConfig    Step 2: Acceptance check. Kept small (U8). local TechTreeResultCodes = { NONE = 0, UNKNOWN_NODE = 1, ALREADY_UNLOCKED = 2, PREREQ_NOT_MET = 3, INVALID_MATERIAL = 4, -- material not part of this node's cost INVALID_AMOUNT = 5, -- amount <= 0 EXCEEDS_REMAINING = 6, -- amount would overshoot the node's cost INSUFFICIENT_MATERIALS = 7, -- player doesn't actually hold that many tools TOO_FAR = 8, NO_BENCH = 9, -- no tagged bench found in the world NOTHING_TO_REFUND = 10, -- cancel requested on an empty pool } return TechTreeResultCodes    Step 2: Acceptance check. searchDocs.title: Task 4: TechTreeState (pure shared validator)​
searchDocs.content: Files:  Create: src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/TechTreeState.luau  This module has no side effects — both client and server call it. State is a plain table the caller owns.   Step 1: Write the module.  --!strict local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local SharedModules = ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules local TechTreeConfig = require(SharedModules.Configs:WaitForChild("TechTreeConfig")) local Codes = require(SharedModules:WaitForChild("TechTreeResultCodes")) export type State = { unlocked: { [string]: boolean }, pools: { [string]: { [string]: number } }, -- nodeId -> matType -> submitted } local TechTreeState = {} function TechTreeState.newState(): State return { unlocked = {}, pools = {} } end function TechTreeState.getNode(id: string): TechTreeConfig.Node? return TechTreeConfig.Nodes[id] end function TechTreeState.isUnlocked(state: State, id: string): boolean return state.unlocked[id] == true end -- Eligible = node exists, not yet unlocked, and prereq is nil or unlocked. function TechTreeState.isEligible(state: State, id: string): boolean local node = TechTreeConfig.Nodes[id] if not node then return false end if state.unlocked[id] then return false end if node.Prereq ~= nil and not state.unlocked[node.Prereq] then return false end return true end function TechTreeState.submitted(state: State, id: string, matType: string): number local pool = state.pools[id] return (pool and pool[matType]) or 0 end -- Remaining amount of one material before the node is fully funded. function TechTreeState.remaining(state: State, id: string, matType: string): number local node = TechTreeConfig.Nodes[id] if not node then return 0 end local need = node.Cost[matType] or 0 return math.max(0, need - TechTreeState.submitted(state, id, matType)) end -- True when every material in the node's cost is fully submitted. function TechTreeState.isComplete(state: State, id: string): boolean local node = TechTreeConfig.Nodes[id] if not node then return false end for matType in node.Cost do if TechTreeState.remaining(state, id, matType) > 0 then return false end end return true end -- Authoritative submit validation. Returns (ok, reasonCode). -- Does NOT check whether the player physically holds the materials — that is a -- server-only concern layered on top (the client can't be trusted for it anyway). function TechTreeState.validateSubmit(state: State, id: string, matType: string, amount: number): (boolean, number) local node = TechTreeConfig.Nodes[id] if not node then return false, Codes.UNKNOWN_NODE end if state.unlocked[id] then return false, Codes.ALREADY_UNLOCKED end if not TechTreeState.isEligible(state, id) then return false, Codes.PREREQ_NOT_MET end if node.Cost[matType] == nil then return false, Codes.INVALID_MATERIAL end if amount <= 0 then return false, Codes.INVALID_AMOUNT end if amount > TechTreeState.remaining(state, id, matType) then return false, Codes.EXCEEDS_REMAINING end return true, Codes.NONE end return TechTreeState    Step 2: Acceptance check (trace by hand). newState() → {unlocked={}, pools={}}.With fresh state: isEligible(state, "Durability_T1") → true; isEligible(state, "Durability_T2") → false (prereq not unlocked).validateSubmit(state, "Durability_T1", "Metal", 25) → (true, 0); ..., "Metal", 26) → (false, EXCEEDS_REMAINING); ..., "Wood", 5) → (false, INVALID_MATERIAL) (T1 cost is Metal only).After setting state.unlocked.Durability_T1 = true: isEligible(state,"Durability_T2") → true. Step 3: Commit.  git add "src/ReplicatedStorage/SharedModules/TechTreeState.luau" git commit -m 'feat(tech-tree): add pure shared TechTreeState validator'
