searchDocs.title: Gotchas​
searchDocs.content: Frozen-start phase While hasStarted = false (before the first brake release), the drain rate is forced to 0 and no task.delay stall timer is scheduled. Any code path that reads currentRate or calls getFuel() before the first un-brake will see a frozen value — this is intentional. Do not bypass the hasStarted gate.  Game-over is a placeholder onGameOver() currently only prints to the output. No round reset, respawn, or UI is triggered. Do not ship this system without replacing the placeholder with a real mechanic.  Algebraic drift note: commitEvent captures now() once and uses it for both lastEventTime and the serverTime field broadcast in TrainStateSync. If you add any task.wait or async work between the snapshot and the broadcast, the client's extrapolation baseline will drift. Keep commitEvent synchronous.  Nonce guard: every commitEvent increments scheduleNonce. Stall and game-over task.delay callbacks capture the nonce at schedule time and return early if it has changed. Do not call reschedule directly — always go through commitEvent.  Refuel mutex (isRefueling): the mutex is a simple boolean, not a queue. A second refuel request while one is in-flight returns NO_ENERGY even if the player has tools. This is intentional to avoid double-spending; the player can try again immediately after.  Studio model requirements: the TrainEngine-tagged and TrainBrakeLever-tagged roots (each a Model or BasePart) must contain a BasePart named "ProxPromptPart" with a child ProximityPrompt. The prompt's MaxActivationDistance and the engine's ActionText are authored in Studio; only the lever's ActionText is set by script. Both client and server resolve the prompt via PROMPT_PART_NAME, so the Studio name must match config.

searchDocs.title: Client / Server / Shared​
searchDocs.content: Client — WeaponController.client.luauBootstrap that watches the local character for Tool equip/unequip events. Looks up WeaponConfig[tool.Name].Category and dispatches to the matching category handler (MeleeHandler, GunHandler, or ThrowableHandler). Creates one Janitor per equipped Tool (and one per character) so all connections clean up correctly on unequip, death, or weapon switch. Fires Signals.WeaponEquipped / Signals.WeaponUnequipped for the HUD, and Signals.RequestShootingCamera on equip/unequip to toggle the aim camera mode. Binds R to OnReload and G to OnDetonate for handlers that declare those callbacks.  Client — WeaponHandlers/MeleeHandler.luauCombo stepping: on each left-click it calls WeaponValidation.resolveComboSwing (tolerance 0) to determine the next step. If the click arrives during recovery it buffers one keyed retry via Janitor rather than dropping the input. Executes the predicted step: swing sound (SoundManager), optional AnimationTrack, local hitbox query (WeaponValidation.queryMeleeTargets) for an instant hitmarker (Signals.WeaponLocalHit), debug box draw, Signals.WeaponComboChanged, then fires payload-less ReqMeleeSwing. Client combo state is cleared on unequip.  Client — WeaponHandlers/GunHandler.luauHitscan + rocket cosmetic + ammo prediction. On activate, gates on a client-local fire-rate check and predicted ammo count, then fires ReqFireWeapon(origin, dir). Draws the shooter's own tracer (hitscan only; rocket has no local projectile). Supports semi and automatic fire. OnReload fires ReqReloadWeapon and predicts the ammo transition after the server-confirmed reload window. Authoritative ammo is reconciled via WeaponAmmoSync → Signals.WeaponAmmoChanged.  Client — WeaponHandlers/ThrowableHandler.luauGrenade and C4. On activate, gates on the throw cooldown, plays throw sound, and fires ReqThrowProjectile(origin, dir). No local projectile cosmetic — the server-spawned instance replicates to all clients. For C4 (Detonation == "Manual"), OnDetonate fires ReqDetonate. Grenade ignores G.  Client — WeaponHandlers/TrajectoryPreview.luauClient-local green-neon ballistic arc shown while any throwable is equipped. Uses a fixed pool of reused BasePart segments updated every RenderStepped. Origin offset (SPAWN_OFFSET = 2.5) and upward aim bias match ServerProjectile / ThrowableHandler exactly so the preview arc matches the real projectile path. Purely cosmetic — no packets sent.  Client — WeaponEffectsController.client.luauConsumes replicated combat FX packets. WeaponFired: ignored for the local shooter (who already drew its own tracer); renders tracer + impact spark for other players' shots. WeaponImpact: impact spark + sound for all melee/gun hits. ExplosionAt: expanding neon sphere + sound for rocket, grenade, and C4 detonations — fires for everyone, including the shooter.  Shared — WeaponValidation.luauPure math run on both client (prediction) and server (authority):  canFire(lastFireTime, cooldown, now) — fire-rate gate.meleeHitbox(rootCFrame, range, hitboxSize) — single source of truth for the oriented swing box CFrame and size.queryMeleeTargets(rootCFrame, range, hitboxSize, ignore) — box overlap returning unique Humanoid-bearing Models.resolveComboSwing(state, combo, now, tolerance) — pure combo step resolution; shared so client and server stay in sync.resolveStep(config, step) — merges step overrides with weapon-level defaults into a ResolvedStep.applySpread(direction, spreadDegrees) — applies a random spread cone to an aim direction (cosmetic on client; server does its own authoritative ray).isWithinRange(origin, hitPos, maxDistance) — range cap check.ammoAfterShot(mag) / ammoAfterReload(mag, reserve, magazineSize) — pure ammo transitions.aoeFalloff(center, hitPos, radius, maxDamage) — linear AOE falloff.queryAOEModels(center, radius, ignore) — sphere overlap returning { model, humanoid, distance } for AOE application.  Server — WeaponServer.server.luauReceives all weapon packets. Per-category validation (fire-rate, ammo, origin tolerance, direction validity) before any damage or projectile spawn. Manages gun ammo initialisation on equip via WeaponState.EnsureAmmo + WeaponAmmoSync. Drives the FastCast2 rocket caster (rocketServerCaster) — its LengthChanged callback steps the cosmetic part, its Hit callback calls CombatService.ApplyAOE and broadcasts ExplosionAt. Handles throwable throw (onThrowProjectile) and detonate (onDetonate).  Server — CombatService.luauSingle damage router. Two primary entry points:  ApplyToModel(model, humanoid, amount, attackType, attacker, aoeVariant?) — applies damage to a resolved Model. Players route through HealthManager.ApplyDamage (keeping the HUD-tracked record correct); faction-tagged NPCs ("EnemyNPC" / "FriendlyNPC") take direct humanoid:TakeDamage. Anything without a recognized faction is ignored. Friendly-fire is enforced via Factions.canDamage: only Player↔Enemy damage lands; players never hurt players or friendly NPCs. A nil attacker is treated as environmental and bypasses the faction gate. Self-damage from one's own AOE is exempt.ApplyAOE(center, radius, maxDamage, attackType, attacker, ignore) — calls queryAOEModels, applies aoeFalloff to each target, and routes through ApplyToModel with aoeVariant = "Explosion".  Also available: ApplyToPart(part, amount, attackType, attacker, aoeVariant?) — resolves a hit part to its Humanoid-bearing Model then calls ApplyToModel.  Server — WeaponState.luauPer-player authoritative state. Fields per player record:  lastFire: { [weaponName]: number } — os.clock() of last shot/swing per weapon; gates fire-rate.combo: { [weaponName]: { index, lastHitTime } } — authoritative combo progress.ammo: { [weaponName]: { mag, reserve, reloadEndsAt } } — ammo counts and reload window (reloadEndsAt is the os.clock() timestamp when a reload finishes; 0 means not reloading).active: { ActiveCharge } — active manual throwables (C4) awaiting detonation.  Key functions: EnsureAmmo, GetAmmo/SetAmmo, GetLastFire/SetLastFire, GetCombo/SetCombo, IsReloading, SetReloadEnd, GetActiveCount, AddActive, TakeAllActive. Clear destroys all active charges and removes the player's record on PlayerRemoving.  Server — ServerProjectile.luauSpawns and owns server-authoritative, replicated projectile instances cloned from ReplicatedStorage/WeaponAssets into workspace/ServerProjectiles. Two spawn paths:  spawnRocket(templateName, cframe) — anchored, non-collidable cosmetic part; the caller (WeaponServer) steps its CFrame along the FastCast2 cast.spawnThrowable(templateName, origin, direction, speed, rest, ignore) — server-owned physics rigid body. prepareAssembly un-anchors all parts, sets the WeaponProjectile collision group (passes through characters), and applies per-mode elasticity: "Stick" (C4) elasticity = 0 (lands dead); "Bounce" (Grenade) elasticity = 0.15 (one small hop). installSettle polls until the charge has contacted a world surface and come to rest, then anchors it flat. Network ownership is kept server-side via root:SetNetworkOwner(nil).

searchDocs.title: HUD integration contract​
searchDocs.content: This system ships no UI. A HUD widget that wants to display ammo or combat feedback must consume:  Packet: WeaponAmmoSync — authoritative (weaponName, mag, reserve) sent to the owning client on equip, after each shot, and after reload completion.Signals (client-side): WeaponEquipped(toolName, category) — fired on equip.WeaponUnequipped(toolName) — fired on unequip.WeaponAmmoChanged(weaponName, mag, reserve) — fired by GunHandler on predicted ammo update and on WeaponAmmoSync reconciliation.WeaponReloadStarted(weaponName, reloadTime) — fired when a reload request is sent.WeaponReloadComplete(weaponName) — fired when the reload window elapses or reload is rejected.WeaponLocalHit(model) — fired on a predicted melee/hitscan hit for hitmarker display.WeaponComboChanged(toolName, stepIndex, totalSteps) — fired on each combo step advance.  See Signals Map for the full signal registry.

searchDocs.title: Config knobs​
searchDocs.content: WeaponConfig.luau is the per-weapon registry. Edit stats here — never in handler or server code.  Common fields (all weapons):  Category — "Melee" | "Gun" | "Throwable".DisplayName — human-readable label.ToolName — must match the in-game Tool's Name exactly (used as a packet/state key).Damage — base damage per hit (melee: default per-step; gun: per bullet; throwable: 0, AOE only).DamageType — "Melee" | "Bullet" | "AOE".HeadshotMultiplier? — optional multiplier applied by the server when the ray hits a part named "Head" (gun only).  Melee fields:  Range — forward reach in studs (also hitbox depth).HitboxSize — Vector3 width × height (Z ignored; depth = Range).SwingSound / ImpactSound — SoundConfig.Sfx keys.SwingAnimId? — optional rbxassetid for a swing animation track.Combos — map keyed by input ("Primary" = left-click; "Secondary" reserved). Each ComboDef has: Steps[] — ordered ComboStep array; combo length = #Steps. Each step: Recovery (min seconds before next hit), ChainWindow (seconds to keep combo alive past this hit), optional overrides Damage?, Range?, HitboxSize?, AnimId?, SwingSound?, ImpactSound?.ResetCooldown — brief lockout after the finisher before restarting at hit 1.  Gun fields:  FireMode — "Hitscan" | "Projectile".RPM — rounds per minute; fire interval = 60 / RPM.Automatic — true = hold-to-fire; false = semi-auto.MagazineSize / ReserveMax — ammo counts.ReloadTime — seconds.Spread — max cone half-angle in degrees.MaxDistance — hit range cap (studs).FireSound / ReloadSound / DrySound / ImpactSound — SoundConfig.Sfx keys.Projectile-only additions: ProjectileSpeed (studs/sec), Gravity (Vector3 acceleration), AOERadius, AOEDamage (center damage, linear falloff to 0 at radius), CosmeticTemplate (name in ReplicatedStorage/WeaponAssets).  Throwable fields:  Detonation — "Fuse" (auto after FuseTime) | "Manual" (all charges detonate on ReqDetonate).Rest — "Bounce" (small hop, settles) | "Stick" (lands dead on first contact).ThrowSpeed — initial velocity (studs/sec).FuseTime — (Fuse only) seconds from throw to detonation.MaxActive — (Manual only) max simultaneously active charges per player.AOERadius / AOEDamage — explosion radius and center damage (linear falloff).CarryCount — how many the player carries.CooldownTime — seconds between throws.CosmeticTemplate — name in ReplicatedStorage/WeaponAssets.ThrowSound / ExplodeSound — SoundConfig.Sfx keys.

searchDocs.title: Gotchas / anti-exploit​
searchDocs.content: Fire-rate enforcement Guns enforce 60/RPM intervals via WeaponState.GetLastFire; melee enforces Recovery, ChainWindow, and ResetCooldown per combo step via WeaponValidation.resolveComboSwing (server tolerance = 0.05 s). Requests that arrive too early are silently dropped.  Server-authoritative ammo and reload Ammo counts and reload timing are owned by WeaponState on the server. Firing at an empty magazine is rejected. Firing while a reload window is active (reloadEndsAt > now) is rejected. Neither the magazine count nor the reload timer is read from the client.  Origin, spread, and distance validation The claimed muzzle origin for guns and throw origin for throwables must be within 14 studs of the server-side HumanoidRootPart position and must be a finite (non-NaN) vector. Claimed directions with zero or non-finite magnitude are rejected before normalization. The server caps hitscan range at MaxDistance on its authoritative ray; applySpread is applied client-side for feel only — the server recasts from the validated origin and does not verify the spread angle.  Friendly-fire prevention Enforced in CombatService.ApplyToModel via Factions.canDamage. Only Player↔Enemy damage lands. Players never damage other players or friendly NPCs; enemies never damage other enemies or friendly NPCs. Self-damage from one's own AOE is exempt — the self-check bypasses the faction gate so a player's own rocket can still hurt them if they walk into the blast.  NPC pass-through via CollectionService tag: the "EnemyNPC" / "FriendlyNPC" CollectionService tag is the dual-purpose NPC marker. It gates damage routing in CombatService (only tagged NPCs with a Humanoid take weapon damage) and, via NpcCollisionService, places NPC parts in the Character collision group so thrown charges physically pass through them. A Model without a recognized faction tag receives no damage and does not block thrown projectiles — tag it or it is invisible to the weapon system.  HealthManager routing via CombatService: HealthManager writes record.Health → humanoid.Health but never reads back from the Humanoid. Any external write that bypasses HealthManager.ApplyDamage (via CombatService) will leave the HUD showing a stale record value. Never write to humanoid.Health directly for player damage.
